```{r foundry_api, include=FALSE}
### API CONSTANTS ###
access_url <- 'https://viafoundry.umassmed.edu/vmeta/api/v1/users/login'
access_url_base <- 'https://viafoundry.umassmed.edu'
headers_post <- c('Content-Type' = 'application/json')

# build request body as JSON object
body <- list(
  email = email,
  password = password
)

# send a POST request with JSON content
post_resp <- POST(
  url = access_url,
  add_headers(.headers = headers_post),
  body = toJSON(body, auto_unbox = T)
)

# init. access token
foundry_token <- content(post_resp)$token

# init. headers for all future GET requests
headers_get <- c('Authorization' = str_glue('Bearer {foundry_token}'))

# init. time that data is pulled from Foundry
# current_tz <- Sys.timezone()
run_time_est <- with_tz(now(), "US/Eastern")
runt_time_est_fmt <- str_c("Last updated:", run_time_est, sep = " ")

# init. function to get Foundry data as DF
get_df <- function(api_link, header=headers_get) {
  url <- str_c(access_url_base, api_link)
  
  get_req <- GET(
    url = url,
    add_headers(.headers = header)
  )
  
  resp <- get_req %>%
    content(as = "text") %>%
    fromJSON()
  
  df <- resp %>%
    pluck("data", "data")
  
  return(df)
}
```

# Load Data

```{r load_pts, include=FALSE}
# read in patient data from Foundry
patients_raw <- get_df(api_link = "/vmeta/api/v1/projects/vigor_production/data/patient") %>%
  select(`_id`, patient_id, mdh_participant_id, everything()) %>%
  as_tibble()

# clean up 
patients_all <- patients_raw %>%
  rename(
    invitation_status = invitationstatus,
    enroll_date = enrollmentdate,
    invite_date = inserteddate,
    last_updated_date = lastUpdateDate
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # add "enrolled" to the status
    invitation_status = case_match(enrolled, T ~ "enrolled",
                                   .default = invitation_status),
    FamilyID = as.integer(str_extract(patient_id, fam_id_pat)),
    fam_pos = as.integer(str_extract(patient_id, fam_pos_pat)),
    # OLD FIELD - should be deprecated
    vit_status_exp = case_when(str_detect(patient_id, "_v$") ~ "vitiligo",
                           .default = "healthy"),
    # NEW VIT FIELDS 
    has_vitiligo_post_baseline = case_when(
      has_vitiligo == 1 ~ NA,
      has_vitiligo == 0 & is.na(has_vitiligo_post_baseline) ~ 0,
      .default = has_vitiligo_post_baseline
    ),
    # convert to datetime fields
    across(.cols = c(enroll_date, invite_date, last_updated_date),
           .fns = ~ with_tz(as_datetime(.x), tzone = current_tz))
  ) %>%
  # calculate each pt's current VIT status
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(vitiligo_status = sum(c_across(c(has_vitiligo, has_vitiligo_post_baseline)), na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # # TODO: Replace this with updated VIT fields
  # # count num of vit pt's in each fam
  # mutate(
  #   num_affected = sum(vit_status_exp == "vitiligo"),
  #   .by = FamilyID
  # ) %>%
  
  # count number of VIT-affected pts in each fam
  mutate(
    num_affected = sum(vitiligo_status),
    .by = FamilyID
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    # handle plex label
    plex = case_when(num_affected >= 2 ~ "multiplex",
                     num_affected == 1 ~ "simplex",
                     num_affected == 0 ~ "zeroplex"),
    # convert blood-opt-out to booleans
    # blood_opt_out = if_else(blood_opt_out == "1",
    #                         TRUE,
    #                         FALSE),
    blood_opt_out = case_when(blood_opt_out == "1" ~ TRUE,
                              .default = FALSE),
    # convert unresponsive to boolean
    # unresponsive = if_else(unresponsive == "TRUE",
    #                        TRUE,
    #                        FALSE)
    unresponsive = case_when(unresponsive == "TRUE" ~ TRUE,
                             .default = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id,
    mdh_participant_id,
    # last_updated_date_est,
    last_updated_date,
    age,
    FamilyID,
    fam_pos,
    vit_status_exp,
    vitiligo_status,
    has_vitiligo,
    has_vitiligo_post_baseline,
    plex,
    num_affected,
    invitation_status,
    enrolled,
    unresponsive,
    active_kitstatus,
    aou_complete,
    enroll_date,
    invite_date,
    shipment_group,
    blood_opt_out,
    compensation_points,
    compensation_tickets,
    studyendreason
  )



# filter for patients who withdrew from study
patients_dropped <- patients_all %>%
  filter(!studyendreason %in% c("", NA))

# all patients who haven't withdrew
patients_clean <- patients_all %>%
  filter(studyendreason %in% c("", NA))
```



```{r last_updated_pt, include=FALSE}
run_time_hms <- hms::as_hms(run_time_est)
update_time_hms <- hms::as_hms("5:00:00")

# IF script is ran after 5:00am EST, set `last_updated` to 5:00am EST TODAY
if (run_time_hms > update_time_hms) {
  last_updated_fdry <- as_datetime(str_c(today(), update_time_hms, sep = " "), tz = "America/New_York")
} else {
  # IF script is ran before 5:00am EST, set `last_updated` to 5:00am EST YESTERDAY
  last_updated_fdry <- as_datetime(str_c(today() - 1, update_time_hms, sep = " "), tz = "America/New_York")
}

last_updated_fdry_fmt <- str_c(
  "Last updated:", date(last_updated_fdry),
  hms::hms(
    seconds = round(second(last_updated_fdry)),
    minutes = minute(last_updated_fdry),
    hours = hour(last_updated_fdry)
  ),
  tz(last_updated_fdry),
  sep = " "
)
```

```{r load_shipments, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
shipments_raw <- get_df(api_link = shipments_url) %>%
  as_tibble()

shipments_clean_og <- shipments_raw %>%
  mutate(patient_id = str_extract(id, ".+(?=-\\d+)")) %>%
  rename(
    shipment_last_updated = lastUpdateDate,
    shipment_id = id,
    # patient_id = patient_id_patient_id,
    shipment_status = status
  ) %>%
  # fix data types
  mutate(
    across(.cols = c(shipment_received_date, shipment_sent_date),
           .fns = ~as_date(.x)),
    shipment_batch = as.integer(shipment_batch),
    shipment_last_updated = as_datetime(shipment_last_updated, tz = current_tz)
  ) %>%
  # organize cols
  select(
    `_id`, patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_last_updated,
    shipment_status, shipment_batch, shipment_cycle, barcode:ncol(.),
    -c(label_header, label_header_incoming)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(shipment_last_updated))

shipments_clean <- shipments_clean_og %>%
  # add shipment group from pt DF
  left_join(
    y = patients_clean,
    by = "patient_id",
    suffix = c("", "_pt")
  ) %>%
  select(
    1:shipment_cycle, shipment_group,
    `barcode`:ncol(shipments_clean_og)
  ) %>%
  # remove pt's who have withdrawn from the study
  semi_join(
    y = patients_clean,
    by = "patient_id"
  )


# join with participants DF
shipments_pt_join <- shipments_clean %>%
  left_join(
    y = patients_clean,
    by = "patient_id",
    suffix = c("", "_pt")
  ) %>%
  select(
    str_subset(colnames(.), "_pt", negate = T)
  )


# create DF of each pt's most recent shipment per shipment cycle 
max_batch_per_cycle <- shipments_clean %>%
  summarize(
    max_batch = max(shipment_batch),
    .by = c(patient_id, shipment_cycle)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_batch), patient_id)

# filter for the most recent shipment per pt per cycle (relevant for pts with 're-do' shipments)
shipments_clean_max_batch <- shipments_clean %>%
  semi_join(
    y = max_batch_per_cycle,
    by = c("patient_id", "shipment_cycle", "shipment_batch" = "max_batch")
  )
```



```{r load_surveys_new, include=FALSE}
surveys_raw <- get_df(api_link = surveys_url) %>%
  as_tibble()

# join with patient DF
surveys_clean <- surveys_raw %>%
  left_join(
    y = patients_clean,
    by = c("participantid" = "mdh_participant_id"),
    suffix = c("", "_pt")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) %>%
  mutate(
    # convert datetimes to EST 
    across(.cols = c(date, inserteddate, creationDate, lastUpdateDate),
           .fns = ~with_tz(as_datetime(.x), current_tz)),
    # create new field to store date (no timestamp)
    recorded_date = as_date(date),
    # extract readable answers from field
    answers = (str_extract(answers, ans_pat) %>%
                 str_to_lower() %>%
                 # split on every manufactured comma to create list of strings
                 str_split("\",\""))
  ) %>%
  rename(
    recorded_dttm = date,
    response_id = id
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id, recorded_dttm, recorded_date, response_id, everything(),
    -c(participantid:surveyid, inserteddate:DID)
  )

surveys_unnested <- surveys_clean %>%
  unnest(answers)


# init. last updated timestamp for surveys
last_updated_surveys <- surveys_unnested %>% pull(recorded_dttm) %>% max()
last_updated_surveys_fmt <- str_c("Last updated:", last_updated_surveys, current_tz, sep = " ")
```


```{r load_survey_tasks, include=FALSE}
survey_tasks_raw <- get_df(api_link = survey_tasks_url) %>%
  as_tibble()

# clean up survey task info
survey_tasks_clean <- survey_tasks_raw %>%
  rename(
    patient_id = participantidentifier,
    task_id = id,
    survey_id = surveyid,
    task_status = status,
    task_assigned_date = inserteddate,
    date_read_into_foundry = lastUpdateDate
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # convert datetimes to EST
    across(.cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "(D|d)ate"),
           .fns = ~with_tz(as_datetime(.x), current_tz)),
    # specify survey type
    survey_type = case_when(str_detect(surveyname, "(B|b)aseline") ~ "BL",
                            str_detect(surveyname, "(Q|q)uarterly") ~ "QT")
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id, task_id, task_status,
    surveyname, survey_type,
    task_assigned_date, startdate, enddate, hassavedprogress,
    schedule,
    `_id`, date_read_into_foundry, modifieddate, survey_id,
  ) %>%
  # handle schedule info
  mutate(
    # retrieve every unique item between escaped quotes
    schedule_text = str_extract_all(schedule, '"([^"]*)"')
  ) %>%
  hoist(
    schedule_text,
    task_sched_id = 2,
    task_sched_name = 4,
    task_sched_category = 6
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # remove extra escape characters
    across(.cols = task_sched_id:task_sched_category,
           .fns = ~str_replace_all(.x, "\"", ""))
  ) %>%
  select(-c(schedule, schedule_text)) %>%
  relocate(task_sched_id:task_sched_category, .after = hassavedprogress)
```

```{r load_saliva, include=FALSE}
saliva_raw <- get_df(api_link = saliva_url) %>%
  as_tibble()

saliva_clean <- saliva_raw %>%
  unnest(
    cols = shipments_id,
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  select(
    id, `_id`, spit_tube_barcode,
    shipments_id_status, shipments_id_spit_tube_stored, shipments_id_spit_tube_received, 
    shipments_id_shipment_received_date, shipments_id_id, shipments_id_shipment_batch, 
    shipments_id_shipment_cycle, shipments_id_shipment_received_comments, 
    fpro_comments:fpro_box_id,
    gencove_id, gencove_qc_status, gencove_qc_contamination,
    genetic_sex_error, genetic_sex_comments
  ) %>%
  rename(
    "spit_tube_id" = "id",
    "shipment_id" = "shipments_id_id"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(
    .cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "shipments_id_"),
    .fn = ~str_replace(string = .x, pattern = "shipments_id_", replace = "")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    shipment_received_date = as_date(shipment_received_date),
    fpro_processed_date = mdy(fpro_processed_date),
    fpro_updated_at = as_datetime(fpro_updated_at)
  )

# join saliva tubes on FreezerPro boxes by the box ID
saliva_joined <- saliva_clean %>%
  left_join(
    y = fpro_boxes_clean,
    by = "fpro_box_id",
    suffix = c("", "_box")
  )
```

```{r}
referral_key <- "&referral_id="

# DF of recent founders that are not in MDH yet
df_to_export <- recent_founders_recruited %>%
  mutate(
    url = str_c(u01_url, referral_key, `Referral ID`)
  ) %>%
  select(
    submission_time=`Survey Timestamp`, REDCap_ID=`Record ID`, `First Name`, `Last Name`, Sex, `Birth year`, 
    Email, phone=`Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):`, platform=`Where did you hear about this study from?`, 
    `Referral ID`, url
  ) %>%
  # filter for records that are not brand new
  filter(
    between(as_date(submission_time), today() - months(2), today() - weeks(1))
  )

# filter for records with 0 referred fam in Phase II
df_recent_founders_no_recruits <- df_to_export %>%
  anti_join(y = all_join, by = "Referral ID")
```

```{r}
# review families of recent recruits that aren't yet eligible for MDH
df_to_export %>%
  # remove founders not in MDH yet
  anti_join(
    y = patients_all,
    by = c("Referral ID" = "FamilyID")
  ) %>%
  # keep founders with referred family in Phase II
  filter(`Referral ID` %in% all_join$`Referral ID`)


all_join %>%
  # keep families from recent founders
  inner_join(
    y = df_to_export %>% select(`Referral ID`),
    by = "Referral ID"
  ) %>%
  # remove families invited to MDH
  anti_join(
    y = patients_all,
    by = c("Referral ID" = "FamilyID")
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Referral ID`, `Survey Timestamp`) %>%
  select(
    recID=`Record ID`, form, `VIGOR ID`, `Referral ID`,
    fn=`First Name`, ln=`Last Name`, `vit?`=`Do you have vitiligo?`,
    age=age_yr_end, sex=Sex
  )
```

```{r}
### VIEW the Family Enrollments of the YTD Fams with 1+ enrolled member ###


patients_clean %>%
  # filter for MDH pts from Founders recruited this calendar year
  semi_join(
    y = (p1_recruiters_existing_clean %>%
           filter(year(`Survey Timestamp`) == year(today()))),
    by = c("FamilyID" = "Referral ID")
  ) %>%
  # filter for families with at least 1 enrolled member
  semi_join(
    y = (patients_clean %>% semi_join(
      y = (p1_recruiters_existing_clean %>%
             filter(year(`Survey Timestamp`) == year(today()))),
      by = c("FamilyID" = "Referral ID")
    ) %>% filter(enrolled)),
    by = "FamilyID"
  ) %>%
  # only retain 1 record per family to see which families have an enrolled pt
  arrange(FamilyID, fam_pos) %>%
  select(patient_id, FamilyID:fam_pos, enrolled, enroll_date, invite_date) %>%
  summarize(
    num_enrolled = sum(enrolled),
    num_unenrolled = n() - num_enrolled,
    num_total = n(),
    .by = FamilyID
  )
```

## Plex

```{r}
patients_clean %>%
  arrange(FamilyID, fam_pos) %>%
  mutate(fam_size = n(), .by = FamilyID) %>%
  relocate(fam_size, enrolled, .after = plex) %>%
  select(patient_id:enrolled, -c(2:3)) %>%
  nest(c(patient_id, fam_pos, vit_status_exp, enrolled)) %>%
  count(fam_size, plex) %>%
  rename(num_fams = n) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = factor(fam_size),
    y = num_fams
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ plex) + 
  geom_text(
    aes(label = num_fams),
    vjust = -0.2
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of families invited to MDH",
    x = "family size",
    y = "number of families",
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
  )
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
mdh_plex_for_prs <- all_join %>%
```

## Cumulative


```{r cumul_enroll_df, include=FALSE}
# visualize cumulative invitation + enrollment 
(enroll_cumul_lines_df <- patients_clean %>%
  arrange(invite_date) %>%
  # calc cumulative size & prop. of cohort with every invitee
  mutate(
    cum_sum_inv = row_number(),
    cum_prop_inv = cum_sum_inv / max(cum_sum_inv)
  ) %>%
  # calc cumulative size and prop. of ENROLLED cohort with every invitee
  mutate(
    # cum_sum_enroll = case_when(enrolled ~ row_number(),
    #                            .default = 0),
    cum_sum_enroll = row_number(),
    .by = enrolled
  ) %>%
  # replace NAs with the previous value
  mutate(
    # cum_prop_enroll = (cum_prop_enroll %>%
    #                      na_if(NA) %>%
    #                      coalesce(cum_prop_enroll[-1]))
    
    # cum_prop_enroll = case_when(cum_sum_enroll != 0 ~ cum_sum_enroll / max(cum_sum_inv))
    cum_prop_enroll = cum_sum_enroll / max(cum_sum_inv)
    # cum_prop_enroll = cum_sum_enroll / cum_sum_inv
  ) %>%
  select(cum_sum_inv, cum_prop_inv, cum_sum_enroll, cum_prop_enroll, enrolled, everything()))
```

```{r plot_cumul_total_efforts, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# plot ALL cumulative Phase I + Phase II + Enrollment 


# function to handle DFs from different sources
prepare_cumul_df <- function(df, platform, pop) {
  ### INPUT PARAMS ###
  # ------------------
  # df: the dataframe to work on
  # platform:
  if (str_detect(str_to_lower(platform), "mdh")) {
    if (str_detect(str_to_lower(pop), "invitee")) {
      df <- df %>%
        arrange(invite_date) %>%
        mutate(
          date = as_date(invite_date),
          cumul_count = row_number(),
          pop = pop
        ) %>%
        select(cumul_count, date, pop)
    }
    else if (str_detect(str_to_lower(pop), "enrollee")) {
      df <- df %>%
        arrange(enroll_date) %>%
        mutate(
          date = as_date(enroll_date),
          cumul_count = row_number(),
          pop = pop
        ) %>%
        select(cumul_count, date, pop)
    }
  }
  
  else {
    df <- df %>%
      arrange(`Survey Timestamp`) %>%
      mutate(
        date = as_date(`Survey Timestamp`),
        cumul_count = row_number(),
        pop = pop
      ) %>%
      select(cumul_count, date, pop)
  }
  
  return(df)
}


# ALL responses from Phase I/II and MDH
p1_cumul_all <- prepare_cumul_df(p1_all, "RedCap", "phase1")
p2_cumul_all <- prepare_cumul_df(p2_clean, "RedCap", "phase2")
mdh_cumul_all <- prepare_cumul_df(patients_clean, "MDH", "mdh invitee")
mdh_cumul_enroll <- prepare_cumul_df(patients_clean %>% filter(!is.na(enroll_date)), "MDH", "mdh enrollee")

cumul_all_bind <- bind_rows(p1_cumul_all, p2_cumul_all, mdh_cumul_all, mdh_cumul_enroll)

cumul_plot_all <- cumul_all_bind %>%
  mutate(pop = factor(pop) %>% fct_inorder) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = cumul_count, color = pop)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  # add phase 1 label
  geom_label(
    data = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase1") %>% slice_max(date),
    label = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase1") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    x = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase1") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(date) %>% max(),
    y = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase1") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    hjust = -0.1,
    show.legend = F
  ) +
  # add phase 2 label
  geom_label(
    data = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase2") %>% slice_max(date),
    label = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase2") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    x = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase2") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(date) %>% max(),
    y = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "phase2") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 0,
    show.legend = F
  ) +
  # add mdh invitees
  geom_label(
    data = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh invitee") %>% slice_max(date),
    label = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh invitee") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    x = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh invitee") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(date) %>% max(),
    y = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh invitee") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    hjust = -0.1,
    vjust = 1,
    show.legend = F
  ) +
  # add mdh enrollees
  geom_label(
    data = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh enrollee") %>% slice_max(date),
    label = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh enrollee") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    x = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh enrollee") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(date) %>% max(),
    y = cumul_all_bind %>% filter(pop == "mdh enrollee") %>% slice_max(date) %>% pull(cumul_count) %>% max(),
    hjust = -0.1,
    show.legend = F
  ) +
  scale_x_date(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.125))) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative efforts of VIGOR recruitment + enrollment over time",
    y = "cumulative number of respondents",
    color = "population",
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# cumulative campaigns without notable dates
```

```{r enroll_status_distr_barplot_stacked, echo=FALSE}
# figure out which families are full/part/not enrolled
fam_size_enroll_status_summary_df <- fam_size_summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    # calculate each family's enroll%
    `enroll%` = case_when(enrolled ~ num_fam_members / fam_size,
                          !enrolled ~ 1 - (num_fam_members / fam_size))
  ) %>%
  # sort by family size and give priority to enrolled pt's
  arrange(fam_size, FamilyID, desc(enrolled)) %>%
  # each row corresponds to a unique family --> remove rows of unenrolled pt's from partial enrolled fams
  distinct(FamilyID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  # classify families by enrollment status
  mutate(
    enroll_status = case_when(`enroll%` == 1 ~ "full_enrolled",
                              `enroll%` == 0 ~ "none_enrolled",
                              .default = "part_enrolled"),
    # factorize with custom level order
    enroll_status = factor(enroll_status) %>% fct_relevel(c("none_enrolled", "part_enrolled", "full_enrolled"))
  ) %>%
  # count the number of families in each "status" for each family size
  summarize(num_fams = n(),
            .by = c(fam_size, enroll_status))


colors <- c("none_enrolled" = "#F8766D",
            "full_enrolled" = "#00BA38",
            "part_enrolled" = "#FFD700")

# stacked barplot
fam_enrollment_stacked_barplot <- fam_size_enroll_status_summary_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(fam_size), y = num_fams, fill = enroll_status)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(aes(label = num_fams),
            position = position_stack(0.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(
    # title = "Enrollment breakdown of VIGOR families",
```

The previous plots only show whether a family has all, some, or no members enrolled. But among those 'partially enrolled' families, how successful has enrollment been? The following plot is colored to show what percentage of the family is enrolled for each family size. This gives an even better snapshot of enrollment progress within partially enrolled families. 


```{r plot_enroll_prop_across_fam_size, echo=FALSE}
# figure out which families are full/part/not enrolled
fam_size_enroll_status_summary_df <- fam_size_summary_df %>%
  mutate(
    # calculate each family's enroll%
    `enroll%` = case_when(enrolled ~ num_fam_members / fam_size,
                          !enrolled ~ 1 - (num_fam_members / fam_size))
  ) %>%
  # sort by family size and give priority to enrolled pt's
  arrange(fam_size, FamilyID, desc(enrolled)) %>%
  # each row corresponds to a unique family --> remove rows of unenrolled pt's from partial enrolled fams
  distinct(FamilyID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  # classify families by enrollment status
  mutate(
    enroll_status = case_when(`enroll%` == 1 ~ "full_enrolled",
                              `enroll%` == 0 ~ "none_enrolled",
                              .default = "part_enrolled"),
    # factorize with custom level order
    enroll_status = factor(enroll_status) %>% fct_relevel(c("none_enrolled", "part_enrolled", "full_enrolled")),
    # round enroll%
    `enroll%` = round(`enroll%`, 2)
  ) %>%
  # count the number of families in each "status" for each family size
  summarize(num_fams = n(),
            .by = c(fam_size, enroll_status, `enroll%`))


colors <- c(
  "none_enrolled" = "#F8766D",
  "full_enrolled" = "#00BA38",
  # "none_enrolled" = "black",
  # "full_enrolled" = "black",
  # "part_enrolled" = "#FFD700"
  "part_enrolled" = "black"
)

fam_size_enroll_status_summary_df %>%
  arrange(fam_size, desc(`enroll%`)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(fam_size), y = num_fams, fill = `enroll%`)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_col(
    aes(x = factor(fam_size), y = num_fams, col = enroll_status),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(aes(label = num_fams),
            position = position_stack(0.5)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F8766D", high = "#00BA38") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.box = "vertical") +
  labs(
    # title = "Enrollment breakdown of VIGOR families",
    title = "How many families are enrolled in VIGOR?",
    subtitle = str_glue("{round(enroll_summary_stats$`pt_enroll%` * 100, 2)}% of all participants are enrolled 
                        Average Family Size enrolled: {round(enroll_summary_stats$avg_enrolled_fam_size, 2)}"),
    x = "family size",
    y = "number of families",
    # caption = last_updated_patients_fmt
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt,
    fill = "bar color corresponds \nto enroll%",
    col = "border color corresponds \nto enrollment status"
  )
```

```{r sankey_test_df, include=FALSE}
## TEST ## 
p1_all %>%
  # convert Referral ID to integer
  mutate(`Referral ID` = as.integer(`Referral ID`)) %>%
  # join all Phase II records
  bind_rows(p2_join) %>%
  mutate(
    phase = case_when(!is.na(p1_id) ~ "Phase I response",
                      is.na(p1_id) ~ "Phase II response")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Where did you hear about this study from?` = case_when(`Where did you hear about this study from?` != "" ~ `Where did you hear about this study from?`),
    complete_status = case_when(phase == "Phase II response" ~ NA,
                                `First Name` %in% c("", NA) & `Last Name` %in% c("", NA) &
                                  Email %in% c("", NA) & 
                                  `Phone Number (no spaces or dashes):` %in% c("", NA) ~ "Incomplete Response",
                                .default = "Complete Response"),
    founder_status = case_when(phase == "Phase II response" ~ "Recruited Family", 
                               `Referral ID` %in% all_join$`Referral ID` ~ "Founder",
                               !`Referral ID` %in% c("", NA) ~ "Dormant Founder",
                               .default = "Doesn't meet criteria")
  ) %>%
  count(
    phase,
    complete_status,
    `Where did you hear about this study from?`, founder_status
  ) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))
```


```{r age_data_processing, include=FALSE}
# init. cutoff age for minors
adult_age <- 18 

# retrieve participants' ages as reported in RedCap, and categorize them as adults or minors
patients_clean_age <- patients_clean %>%
  left_join(
    y = all_join_us_v2,
    by = c("patient_id" = "VIGOR ID"),
    suffix = c("", "_rc")
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(colnames(patients_clean)), age_yr_end) %>%
  mutate(
    age_yr_end = if_else(between(age_yr_end, 0, 120), age_yr_end, NA),
    adult_status = case_when(age_yr_end >= adult_age ~ "adult",
                             age_yr_end < adult_age ~ "minor",
                             .default = "unknown"),
    enrolled = factor(enrolled) %>% fct_relevel(c("TRUE", "FALSE")),
    founder_status = if_else(fam_pos == 1, "founder", "recruit")
  ) %>%
  # filter(between(age_yr_end, 0, 120)) %>%
  relocate(age_yr_end, adult_status, enrolled, founder_status, .before = 2)


# init. DF to store # of enrolled vs unenrolled
num_enrolled_adults <- patients_clean_age %>% count(enrolled, adult_status) %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "adult") %>% pull(n)
num_enrolled_minors <- patients_clean_age %>% count(enrolled, adult_status) %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "minor") %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_adults <- patients_clean_age %>% count(enrolled, adult_status) %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "adult") %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_minors <- patients_clean_age %>% count(enrolled, adult_status) %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "minor") %>% pull(n)
num_enrolled_age_na <- patients_clean_age %>% count(enrolled, adult_status) %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "unknown") %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_age_na <- patients_clean_age %>% count(enrolled, adult_status) %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "unknown") %>% pull(n)

num_enrolled_adult_founders <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "adult", founder_status == "founder") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_enrolled_adult_recruits <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "adult", founder_status == "recruit") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_enrolled_minor_founders <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "minor", founder_status == "founder") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_enrolled_minor_recruits <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == T, adult_status == "minor", founder_status == "recruit") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_adult_founders <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "adult", founder_status == "founder") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_adult_recruits <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "adult", founder_status == "recruit") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_minor_founders <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "minor", founder_status == "founder") %>% count() %>% pull(n)
num_unenrolled_minor_recruits <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(enrolled == F, adult_status == "minor", founder_status == "recruit") %>% count() %>% pull(n)

# init. DF for adults and minors separately
adults_clean_age <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(adult_status == "adult")
minors_clean_age <- patients_clean_age %>% filter(adult_status == "minor")

# enrollment summary for each age range
patients_age_bin_summary <- patients_clean_age %>%
  mutate(
    age_range = case_when(
      is.na(age_yr_end) ~ "unknown",
      between(age_yr_end, 0, 5) ~ "0-5",
      between(age_yr_end, 6, 9) ~ "6-9",
      between(age_yr_end, 10, 13) ~ "10-13",
      between(age_yr_end, 14, 17) ~ "14-17",
      between(age_yr_end, 18, 21) ~ "18-21",
      between(age_yr_end, 22, 24) ~ "22-24",
      between(age_yr_end, 25, 29) ~ "25-29",
      between(age_yr_end, 30, 34) ~ "30-34",
      between(age_yr_end, 35, 39) ~ "35-39",
      between(age_yr_end, 40, 44) ~ "40-44",
      between(age_yr_end, 45, 49) ~ "45-49",
      between(age_yr_end, 50, 54) ~ "50-54",
      between(age_yr_end, 55, 59) ~ "55-59",
      between(age_yr_end, 60, 64) ~ "60-64",
      between(age_yr_end, 65, 69) ~ "65-69",
      between(age_yr_end, 70, 74) ~ "70-74",
      between(age_yr_end, 75, 79) ~ "75-79",
      between(age_yr_end, 80, 84) ~ "80-84",
      between(age_yr_end, 85, 89) ~ "85-89",
      .default = "90+"
    ),
    age_range = factor(age_range) %>% fct_relevel(c("0-5", "6-9", "10-13", "14-17",
                                                    "18-21", "22-24", "25-29", "30-34", 
                                                    "35-39", "40-44", "45-49", "50-54", "55-59",
                                                    "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79",
                                                    "80-84", "85-89", "90+", "unknown"))
  ) %>%
  summarize(num_pts = n(), .by = c(age_range, enrolled, founder_status)) %>%
  mutate(prop_pts = num_pts / sum(num_pts), .by = c(age_range, founder_status)) %>%
  arrange(age_range, enrolled, founder_status)

# DF that includes proportions without accountinf for founder
patients_age_bin_summary_v2 <- patients_age_bin_summary %>%
  summarize(
    num_pts = sum(num_pts), 
    .by = c(age_range, enrolled)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    prop_pts = num_pts / sum(num_pts), 
    .by = age_range
  )
```

```{r barplot_of_enrollment_per_age_range, echo=FALSE}
                              "60-64", "65-69", "70-74", "75-79",
                              "80-84", "85-89", "90+")) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0.5,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 4.5,
    color = "blue",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    . ~ founder_status,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  # facet_grid(
  #   adult_status ~ founder_status,
  #   scales = "free_x"
  # ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of enrollees across age ranges in VIGOR cohort",
    subtitle = str_glue("adults enrolled: {num_enrolled_adults} | adults unenrolled: {num_unenrolled_adults}
                        minors enrolled: {num_enrolled_minors} | minors unenrolled: {num_unenrolled_minors}"),
    x = "age range",
    y = "number of participants",
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors)
```

```{r eval=FALSE} 
# stats for Michelle
all_join_race_v3 <- all_join %>% 
  # indicate Race as "Prefer not to answer" if everything is unchecked
  mutate(
    `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` = case_when(
      `Race (choice=American Indian or Alaskan Native)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Asian {race_asian})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Black or African American)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Hawaiian or Pacific Islander)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=White)` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Other {otherrace})` == "Unchecked" &
        `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)` == "Unchecked" ~ "Checked",
      .default = `Race (choice=Prefer not to answer)`
    )
  ) %>%
  # pivot race values (non-asian races)
  pivot_longer(
    cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "Race(?! Asian)"),
    names_to = "race",
    names_pattern = "(?<=\\=)([\\w\\s]+)",
    values_to = "race_val"
  ) %>%
  filter(race_val == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(race = str_squish(race))

all_join_race_v3 %>%
  # remove duplicate records with multiple races -> naturally removes "white" first
  distinct(`Record ID`, form, .keep_all = T)

# DF of every multiracial person in MDH
enrolled_multiracial <- all_join_race_v3 %>%
  semi_join(y = patients_clean %>% filter(enrolled),
            by = c("VIGOR ID" = "patient_id")) %>%
  filter(n() > 1, .by = `VIGOR ID`) %>%
  select(`VIGOR ID`, Ethnicity, Sex, race) %>%
  nest(race = race)

enrolled_multiracial %>%
  count(Ethnicity, Sex)


enrolled_races <- all_join_race_v3 %>%
  semi_join(y = patients_clean %>% filter(enrolled),
            by = c("VIGOR ID" = "patient_id")) %>%
  mutate(
    race = case_when(
      race %in% c("Other", NA, "Prefer not to answer") ~ "Other",
      .default = race
    ),
    # factorize race --> shorten labels of race values; assign "Prefer not to answer" to NA
    race = factor(
      race,
      labels = c("native", "asian",
                 "black", "other", "white")
    ) %>% fct_relevel(c("other", "native", "black", "asian", "white")),
    # factorize Ethnicity
    Ethnicity = case_match(Ethnicity, "" ~ "Prefer not to answer", .default = Ethnicity),
    Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity, labels = c("hispanic", "non-hispanic", "unknown")) %>%
      fct_relevel(c("non-hispanic", "hispanic", "unknown")),
    # factorize Sex
    Sex = case_when(!Sex %in% c("Male", "Female") ~ "Unknown", .default = Sex),
    Sex = factor(Sex) %>% fct_relevel(c("Female", "Male", "Unknown"))
  ) 


enrolled_races %>%
  # remove everyone who is multiracial
  anti_join(
    y = enrolled_multiracial,
    by = "VIGOR ID"
  ) %>%
  count(race, Ethnicity, Sex) %>%
  filter(race == "other")


enrolled_races %>% 
  distinct(`VIGOR ID`, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = race, fill = Ethnicity)) + 
  geom_bar(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ Sex, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

patients_clean %>% filter(enrolled) %>% anti_join(
  y = enrolled_races %>%
    mutate(
      race = if_else(
        `VIGOR ID` %in% enrolled_multiracial$`VIGOR ID`,
        "More than one race",
        race
      ),
      race = factor(
        race,
        labels = c(
          "Asian",
          "Black",
          "More than one race",
          "American Indian",
          "Unknown",
          "White"
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(`VIGOR ID`, .keep_all = T),
  by = c("patient_id" = "VIGOR ID")
)


export_pt_level_data <- enrolled_races %>%
  mutate(
    race = if_else(
      `VIGOR ID` %in% enrolled_multiracial$`VIGOR ID`,
      "More than one race",
      race
    ),
    race = factor(
      race,
      labels = c(
        "Asian",
        "Black",
        "More than one race",
        "American Indian",
        "Unknown",
        "White"
      )
    ),
    Ethnicity = factor(
      Ethnicity,
      labels = c("Not Hispanic or Latino", "Hispanic or Latino", "Unknown")
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(`VIGOR ID`, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(`VIGOR ID`, race, Ethnicity, Sex, age_yr_end) %>%
  add_row(
    p1_race_clean_v3 %>% filter(`Referral ID` == 1400) %>% mutate(
      "VIGOR ID" = "VIGOR_1400_1_v",
      race = factor(race, labels = "Black"),
      age_yr_end = year(today()) - `Birth year`
    ) %>% select("VIGOR ID", race, Ethnicity, Sex, age_yr_end)
  ) %>%
  rename(Age = age_yr_end,
         Race = race,
         Gender = Sex) %>%
  mutate(
    "Age Unit" = "Years",
    # handle unusual ages
    Age = if_else(between(Age, 0, 100),
                  as.character(Age),
                  "Unknown")
  )
```

```{r combine_race_data, include=FALSE}
# plot race of Phase I + Phase II respondents
p1_race_clean_v3 <- p1_race_clean_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    race = factor(race, labels = c("Asian", "Black or African American",
                                   "Latinx", "American Indian or Alaskan Native",
                                   "Other", "Pacific Islander", "White")) %>% as.character()
  )


p2_race_clean_v2 <- all_join_race_v2 %>%
  filter(is.na(p1_id)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(.cols = c(`Referral ID`, `Family Size`),
           .fns = ~as.character(.x))
  )

race_combined <- bind_rows(p1_race_clean_v3, p2_race_clean_v2, patients_race) %>%
  select(`Record ID`, form, `VIGOR ID`, patient_id, race, enroll_date)


race_combined_clean <- race_combined %>% 
  # remove NAs
  filter(!is.na(race)) %>%
  mutate(
    # denote platform
    pop = case_when(str_detect(form, "p1") ~ "phase1",
                    str_detect(form, "phase2") ~ "phase2",
                    !is.na(enroll_date) ~ "mdh_enrollee",
                    !is.na(patient_id) ~ "mdh_non_enrollee"),
    pop = factor(pop) %>% fct_relevel(c("phase1", "phase2", "mdh_enrollee", "mdh_non_enrollee")),
    patient_id = case_when(is.na(patient_id) ~ `VIGOR ID`,
                           .default = patient_id),
    # combine "pacific islander" and "hawaiian or pacific islander"
    race = if_else(str_detect(race, "(P|p)acific (I|i)sland"), "Pacific Islander", race),
    # factorize
    race = factor(race, labels = c("native", "asian", "black", "latinx", "other", "pacific_islander", "Prefer not to answer", "white")) %>% fct_other(drop = "pacific_islander", other_level = "other") %>% fct_na_level_to_value(extra_levels = "Prefer not to answer")
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, pop, race)
```

```{r combine_state_date, include=FALSE}
geo_location_df <- patients_clean %>%

      str_detect(form, "p1") ~ "phase1",
```

```{r}
# point -> ticket conversion

# how many unique winners per raffle?
```

```{r}
# assign tickets for pts with enough points
raffle_cohort_clean <- raffle_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    # set all NA ticket values to 0
    compensation_tickets = case_match(compensation_tickets,
                                      c(NA, "") ~ 0,
                                      .default = as.integer(compensation_tickets)),
    # convert points to tickets
    compensation_tickets = case_when(compensation_points > 99 & compensation_tickets < 1 ~ floor(compensation_points / PTS_TO_TIX),
                                     .default = compensation_tickets),
    # reset points after conversion
    compensation_points = case_when(compensation_points > 99 & compensation_tickets >= 1 ~ compensation_points - (compensation_tickets * PTS_TO_TIX),
                                    .default = compensation_points)
  )


raffle_cohort_clean %>%
  select(enroll_date, compensation_points, compensation_tickets)

raffle_cohort_clean %>%
  count(compensation_tickets)
```

```{r}
# how many unique winners per raffle?
NUM_WINNERS <- 50

# init. ticket pool -> 1 ID for each ticket a pt has
id_pool <- rep(raffle_cohort_clean$patient_id, raffle_cohort_clean$compensation_tickets)

# empty vec to store IDs of winners
win_ids <- c()

# draw winners randomly
for (i in 1:NUM_WINNERS) {
  # sim random raffle drawing
  winning_id <- sample(id_pool, 1, replace = F)
  
  if (winning_id %in% win_ids) {
    # keep drawing randomly until a new participant wins
    while (winning_id %in% win_ids) {
      winning_id <- sample(id_pool, 1, replace = F)
    }
  }
  
  # store winner ID in vector
  win_ids[i] <- winning_id
}

win_ids
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# read in CSV of outbound packages dropped off for transit

# export that as a CSV to upload to Foundry shipments table --> cols: shipments.id, shipments.shipment_sent_date
ob_kits_mdh <- read_csv(
  "~/U01_PROSPECTIVE_VITILIGO/data/mdh/exported_from_mdh/vigor_prod_outbound_package_in_transit_16APR2025.csv",
  show_col_types = F
)

# shipments that were put on hold due to Tasso shortage (78 second kits + 1 first kit [re-do])
pending_kits <- shipments_clean_max_batch %>%
  filter(shipment_sent_date > ymd("2025-3-1"))

# kits that were pending but have been dropped off
pending_kits_dropped_off <- pending_kits %>%
  select(patient_id:shipment_cycle, shipment_group, shipment_sent_date) %>%
  semi_join(y = ob_kits_mdh,
             by = c("patient_id" = "ParticipantIdentifier")) %>%
  mutate(shipment_sent_date = ymd("2025-4-15") + days(1))

pending_kits_dropped_off_export <- pending_kits_dropped_off %>%
  select(id=shipment_id, shipment_sent_date) %>%
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_c("shipments", .x, sep = "."),
              .cols = everything())


# pending shipments that will be sent out on April 18, 2025
pending_kits_not_dropped_off_export <- pending_kits %>%
  anti_join(y = pending_kits_dropped_off,
            by = "shipment_id") %>%
  select(id=shipment_id, shipment_sent_date) %>%
  mutate(shipment_sent_date = ymd("2025-4-18") + days(1)) %>%
  rename_with(.fn = ~str_c("shipments", .x, sep = "."),
              .col = everything())

pending_kits_combined_export <- bind_rows(pending_kits_dropped_off_export, pending_kits_not_dropped_off_export)


write_csv(
  x = pending_kits_combined_export,
  file = "~/U01_PROSPECTIVE_VITILIGO/data/foundry/shipping_labels/import_shipments_to_foundry/vigor_prod_outbound_shipments_updated_date_16APR2025.csv"
)
```

## Plots

```{r shipments_data_processing, echo=FALSE}
# visualize shipment progress
shipments_plot_df <- shipments_clean_max_batch %>%
  # re-order shipment groups numerically
  mutate(shipment_group = factor(shipment_group, levels = {
    # extract unique values
    unique_groups <- unique(shipment_group)
    
    # custom sorting function
    sort_groups <- function(x) {
      # extract the numeric part and convert to integer
      num <- as.integer(str_extract(x, "\\d+"))
      # sort based on the numeric part
      x[order(num)]
    }

    # apply custom sorting
    sort_groups(unique_groups)
    
  })) %>%
  # retrieve active kit status from pt DF
  left_join(
    y = patients_clean,
    by = "patient_id",
    suffix = c("", "_pt")
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(colnames(shipments_clean_max_batch)), active_kitstatus) %>%
  # new columns to add more context to shipments
  mutate(
    active_kitstatus_desc = case_match(
      active_kitstatus,
      "1" ~ "Beginning of cycle",
      "2" ~ "Needs package",
      "3" ~ "Outbound Transit",
      # "4" ~ "Mid-sample collection",
      # "5" ~ "Repackaged kit",
      c("4", "5") ~ "Kit with pt",
      "6" ~ "Inbound Transit",
      "7" ~ "Kit Received"
    ),
    # correct Foundry shipment status if MDH shows more accurate status (only for non-redo packages since re-do packages are handled outside MDH)
    # use the most accurate status between Foundry and MDH
    shipment_status_desc = case_when(
      # # OLD
      # shipment_status == "Barcode Generated" & between(as.integer(active_kitstatus), 3, 7) & shipment_batch == shipment_cycle ~ active_kitstatus_desc,
      # # a likely re-do package that hasn't been received at UMass
      # shipment_batch != shipment_cycle & active_kitstatus_desc != "Kit Received" ~ active_kitstatus_desc,
      # # likely 're-do' if active_kitstatus_desc="Kit Received"
      # shipment_status == "Barcode Generated" & shipment_batch != shipment_cycle ~ "Likely a 'Re-Do' (handled outside of MDH)",
      # .default = shipment_status
      
      # if Foundry shows a shipment was returned, return that Foundry shipment status as-is
      shipment_status != "Barcode Generated" ~ shipment_status,
      # if Foundry shows no return but MDH shows active_kitstatus = 1, its a likely re-do kit that has been sent 6+ months ago
      shipment_status == "Barcode Generated" & active_kitstatus == "1" ~ "Likely a 'Re-Do' (handled outside of MDH)",
      # if both Foundry and MDH show a shipment has not returned, set the status desc as MDH active kit status
      shipment_status == "Barcode Generated" & active_kitstatus != "7" ~ active_kitstatus_desc,
      # if Foundry shows no return but MDH shows kit returned, indicate a likely re-do kit
      shipment_status == "Barcode Generated" & active_kitstatus == "7" ~ "Likely a 'Re-Do' (handled outside of MDH)",
      .default = shipment_status
    ),
    shipment_status_desc = case_match(
      shipment_status_desc,
      "Beginning of cycle" ~ "1. Waiting to Confirm Address",
      c("Barcode Generated", "Needs package") ~ "2. Barcode Generated",
      "Outbound Transit" ~ "3. Outbound Transit",
      "Kit with pt" ~ "4-5. Kit with pt",
      "Inbound Transit" ~ "6. Inbound Transit",
      "Kit Received" ~ "7A. Shipment Received (MDH)",
      "Shipment Received" ~ "7B. Shipment Received (Foundry)",
      "Devices Stored" ~ "7C. Samples in FrzPro",
      "Likely a 'Re-Do' (handled outside of MDH)" ~ "0. Likely a 'Re-Do' (handled outside of MDH)"
    )
  ) %>%
  # remove shipments that aren't in a group or don't have a status
  filter(
    !is.na(active_kitstatus),
    !shipment_group %in% c(NA, "")
  ) %>%
  select(
    1:shipment_status, shipment_status_desc, active_kitstatus, active_kitstatus_desc, everything()
  ) %>%
  # simplify shipment status
  mutate(
    shipment_status_simp = case_when(str_detect(shipment_status_desc, "7") ~ "7. Shipment Received",
                                     .default = shipment_status_desc)
  )

# show the distribution of kits belonging to each step of the shipment pipeline
shipments_summary <- shipments_plot_df %>%
  count(shipment_status_desc, shipment_cycle) %>%
  rename(step = shipment_status_desc,
         num_kits = n) %>%
  mutate(total_kits = sum(num_kits), .by = shipment_cycle) 

shipments_summary
```

0. Re-Do - 3 pt -> 2 are confirmed re-dos and 3rd is unique and being handled outside of MDH


```{r}
kit_summary_per_cycle <- shipments_plot_df %>% 
  transmute(
    shipment_id = shipment_id,
    shipment_cycle = shipment_cycle,
    shipment_status_simp = case_when(
      str_detect(shipment_status_desc, "7") ~ "7. Returned",
      .default = shipment_status_desc
    ),
    # a kit was "sent" if it has code 0 or code 3-7
    sent = if_else(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "[0|3-7]"),
                   T,
                   F)
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    total = n(),
    sent = sum(sent),
    unsent = total - sent,
    returned = sum(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "7")),
    unreturned = sent - returned,
    .by = shipment_cycle
  ) %>%
  arrange(shipment_cycle)

kit_summary_per_cycle
```

^ This tibble only represents kits that are recorded in Foundry, it does not include 'potential' kits from people who require their next shipment

## Trendline

```{r}
# plot shipments sent vs returned and label them by re-do or not
redo_kits_v2 <- packages %>%
  select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_cycle, shipment_batch) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, shipment_batch) %>%
  mutate(equal = shipment_batch == shipment_cycle) %>%
  # mutate(
  #   num_unequal = sum(!equal),
  #   num_records = n(),
  #   .by = patient_id
  # ) %>%
  mutate(
    num_resent = shipment_batch - shipment_cycle
  ) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  arrange(shipment_batch, .by_group = T) %>%
  mutate(
    num_resent_diff = num_resent - lag(num_resent, default = NA_integer_),
    num_resent_diff = if_else(row_number() == 1,
                              num_resent,
                              coalesce(num_resent_diff, num_resent))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(is_redo = case_when(num_resent_diff == 0 ~ FALSE, num_resent_diff > 0 ~ TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(cycle_ver = case_when(num_resent_diff == 0 ~ 0, num_resent_diff > 0 ~ num_resent_diff + 1)) %>%
  mutate(ship_cycle_readable = case_when(cycle_ver == 0 ~ as.character(shipment_cycle),
                                         cycle_ver > 0 ~ str_c(shipment_cycle, cycle_ver, sep = "."))) %>%
  filter(is_redo)
```

```{r}
shipments_trend <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), date_shipped_end = today()) {
  
  # convert arguments to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  
  kit_summary <- shipments_plot_df %>%
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    transmute(
      shipment_id = shipment_id,
      shipment_cycle = shipment_cycle,
      shipment_status_simp = case_when(
        str_detect(shipment_status_desc, "7") ~ "7. Returned",
        .default = shipment_status_desc
      ),
      # a kit was "sent" if it has code 0 or code 3-7
      sent = if_else(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "[0|3-7]"),
                     T,
                     F)
    ) %>%
    summarize(
      total = n(),
      sent = sum(sent),
      unsent = total - sent,
      returned = sum(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "7")),
      unreturned = sent - returned,
      .by = shipment_cycle
    ) %>%
    arrange(shipment_cycle)
  
  subtitle <- kit_summary %>%
    mutate(percent_returned = round(returned / sent * 100, 1)) %>%
    mutate(
      cycle_summary = str_glue(
        "Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {returned} returned / {sent} kits sent ({percent_returned}%); {unreturned} kits not returned; {unsent} kits not sent"
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(cycle_summary) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n")
  
  
  packages_df <- packages %>%
    # filter out kits that were prepared but not sent out (on Aug 1, 2025)
    filter(shipment_sent_date != ymd("2025-8-1") | str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "^2. ", negate = T)) %>%
    # filter for shipments that were sent between the given dates
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    # identify re-do kits
    mutate(is_redo = shipment_id %in% redo_kits_v2$shipment_id) %>%
    # join readable shipment cycles for re-do kits
    left_join(y = redo_kits_v2 %>% select(shipment_id, ship_cycle_readable),
              by = "shipment_id") %>%
    # write new shipment cycle as a decimal for re-do kits
    mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = coalesce(ship_cycle_readable, as.character(shipment_cycle)))
    # mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = case_when(is_redo ~ str_c(as.character(shipment_cycle), ".2", sep = ""),
    #                                    !is_redo ~ as.character(shipment_cycle)))
  
  
  avg_days_in_transit <- packages_df %>%
    summarize(mean_transit = mean(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
              .by = returned) %>%
    filter(returned) %>%
    pull(mean_transit)
  
  
  # define stamp for printing dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025")
  
  
  # define caption
  plot_caption <- str_glue("Average time before package return: {round(mean(avg_days_in_transit, na.rm = T), 2)} days (excludes unreturned packages)")
  
  
  # init. coordinates for label
  # 70th percentile of all shipment sent dates
  # label_x <- packages_df %>%
  #   arrange(shipment_sent_date) %>%
  #   slice(packages_df %>% pull(row) %>% quantile(0.7) %>% round()) %>%
  #   pull(shipment_sent_date)
  
  # x_label <- packages_df %>%
  #   arrange(shipment_sent_date) %>%
  #   slice_head(prop = 0.7) %>% 
  #   slice_tail() %>%
  #   pull(shipment_sent_date)
  
  # 25th percentile of all shipment received dates
  # label_y <- packages_df %>%
  #   arrange(shipment_received_date) %>%
  #   slice(packages_df %>% pull(row) %>% quantile(0.25) %>% round()) %>%
  #   pull(shipment_received_date)
  
  # y_label <- packages_df %>%
  #   arrange(shipment_received_date) %>%
  #   slice_head(prop = 0.25) %>%
  #   slice_tail() %>%
  #   pull(shipment_received_date)
  
  
  # plot trends
  shipments_trend_plot <- packages_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = shipment_sent_date,
      y = shipment_received_date,
      color = factor(shipment_cycle_v2)
    )) +
    geom_point(aes(size = num_pkgs), alpha = 0.35) +
    # add line to show rate of same-day return
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # add lines and text to show today's date
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue(
        "Today's date: {plot_stamp(today())}"
      ),
      x = c(as_date(-Inf), today()),
      y = c(today(), as_date(-Inf)),
      hjust = c(-0.2,-0.5),
      vjust = c(-0.5,-0.2),
      angle = c(0, 90),
      color = "darkgreen"
    ) +
    # limit the x-axis to only show the dates specified by the function args
    xlim(c(
      date_shipped_start - days(2),
      # NA,
      date_shipped_end + days(2)
    )) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Shipment") +
    labs(
      # title = "VIGOR Shipment Trends: Shipping vs. Return Dates",
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipments From {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date",
      # caption = str_glue(
      #   "Average time before package return: {round(mean(avg_days_in_transit, na.rm = T), 2)} days (excludes unreturned packages)"
      # )
      caption = plot_caption
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
      plot.caption.position = "panel"
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
  
  
  
  # only show the dotted line text if plotting from start to finish
  if (date_shipped_start == ymd("2024-6-27") & date_shipped_end == today()) {
    shipments_trend_plot <- shipments_trend_plot  +
      annotate(
        geom = "label",
        label = "dotted line represents \npace of same-day return",
        # x = x_label,
        # y = y_label,
        x = as_date(Inf),
        y = as_date(-Inf),
        color = "black",
        vjust = -0.2,       # move slightly above the bottom
        hjust = 1.25        # move slightly inside the plot
      )
  } else {
    shipments_trend_plot <- shipments_trend_plot  +
      labs(caption = str_flatten(c(plot_caption, "Dotted line represents pace of same-day return"), collapse = "\n"))
  }
  
  
    
  
  return(list(
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    plot = shipments_trend_plot
  ))
}
```

```{r}
    )

  select(patient_id, shipment_status_desc, shipment_cycle)


# create a function to categorize shipment status into broader categories
categorize_status <- function(status) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^0\\.", status) ~ "Re-Do",
    grepl("^1\\.|^2\\.", status) ~ "Pre-shipment",
    grepl("^3\\.", status) ~ "Outbound",
    grepl("^4-5\\.", status) ~ "With Participant",
    grepl("^6\\.", status) ~ "Inbound",
    grepl("^7[ABC]\\.", status) ~ "Received",
    TRUE ~ "Unknown"
  )
}


# add broader category to DF
shipments_status_df <- shipments_status_df %>%
  mutate(
    status_category = categorize_status(as.character(shipment_status_desc)),
    status_category = factor(status_category,
                             levels = c("Pre-shipment", "Outbound", 
                                        "With Participant", "Inbound",
                                        "Received", "Re-Do", "Unknown"))
  )


# create a summary of kit status by participant 
kit_summary <- shipments_status_df %>%
  summarize(
    total_kits = n_distinct(shipment_cycle),
    kits_received = sum(grepl("^7[ABC]\\.", shipment_status_desc)),
    completion_rate = kits_received / total_kits,
    max_cycle = max(shipment_cycle),
    .by = patient_id
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(completion_rate), desc(total_kits))

print(kit_summary)
```

```{r warning=FALSE}
# define the minimum number of participants needed for a flow to be labelled
min_flow_count <- 10

# define colors
shipment_sankey_colors <- c(
  "Pre-shipment" = "#F8AFA8",
  "Outbound" = "#E2CD6D",
  "With Participant" = "#A1D6AA",
  "Inbound" = "#74C4CC",
  "Received" = "#94C4F5",
  "Ineligible" = "#E5A4DC",
  "Re-Do" = "#BBBBBB"
)

# dynamic version that works with any number of cycles
shipments_sankey <- shipments_status_df %>%
  arrange(patient_id, shipment_cycle) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = "patient_id",
    names_from = shipment_cycle,
    names_prefix = "cycle_",
    values_from = status_category
  ) %>%
  # dynamically apply fct_na_value_to_level to all cycle columns
  mutate(across(starts_with("cycle_"),
                ~fct_na_value_to_level(.x, level = "Ineligible"))) %>%
  # dynamically count all cycle combinations
  count(across(starts_with("cycle_")))


# get cycle column names for dynamic plotting
cycle_cols <- names(shipments_sankey)[str_detect(names(shipments_sankey), "^cycle_")]
n_cycles <- length(cycle_cols)


# create dyamic aesthetic mapping
aes_mapping <- list(y = quote(n))
for (i in seq_along(cycle_cols)) {
  aes_mapping[[paste0("axis", i)]] <- as.symbol(cycle_cols[i])
}


# create flow hover text with dynamic cycles
shipments_flow_hover <- shipments_sankey %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # create dynamic flow text showing all cycle transitions
    flow_text = paste(
      paste(cycle_cols, c_across(all_of(cycle_cols)), sep = ": ", collapse = "<br>"),
      paste("<br>Count:", n),
      paste("<br>Percentage:", round(n / sum(shipments_sankey$n) * 100, 1), "%"),
      sep = ""
    ),
    flow_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# create the plot with dynamic aesthetics
shipments_alluvial_plot <- shipments_flow_hover %>%
  ggplot(do.call(aes, aes_mapping)) +
  # use the last cycle for fill color
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = !!as.symbol(cycle_cols[length(cycle_cols)])),
    width = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.8,
    curve_type = "cubic",
    color = "gray25"
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.4,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 3.5,
    min.y = min_flow_count
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = cycle_cols,
    expand = c(0.05, 0.05),
    labels = paste("Cycle", str_extract(cycle_cols, "\\d+"))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    # values = c(
    #   "Pre-shipment" = "#F8AFA8",
    #   "Outbound" = "#E2CD6D",
    #   "With Participant" = "#A1D6AA",

    #   "Received" = "#94C4F5",
    #   "Ineligible" = "#E5A4DC",
    #   "Re-Do" = "#BBBBBB"
    # ),
    values = shipment_sankey_colors,
    name = paste("Cycle", str_extract(cycle_cols[length(cycle_cols)], "\\d+"), "Status")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Participant Flow Between Shipment Cycles",
    subtitle = str_glue("Only flows with {min_flow_count}+ participants are labelled"),
    y = "number of participants",
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
  ) +
  # theme_alluvial() +
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE}
shipments_trend_alluvial_v1 <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), date_shipped_end = today()) {
  
  # convert arguments to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  
  kit_summary <- shipments_plot_df %>%
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    transmute(
      shipment_id = shipment_id,
      shipment_cycle = shipment_cycle,
      shipment_status_simp = case_when(
        str_detect(shipment_status_desc, "7") ~ "7. Returned",
        .default = shipment_status_desc
      ),
      # a kit was "sent" if it has code 0 or code 3-7
      sent = if_else(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "[0|3-7]"),
                     T,
                     F)
    ) %>%
    summarize(
      total = n(),
      sent = sum(sent),
      unsent = total - sent,
      returned = sum(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "7")),
      unreturned = sent - returned,
      .by = shipment_cycle
    ) %>%
    arrange(shipment_cycle)
  
  subtitle <- kit_summary %>%
    mutate(percent_returned = round(returned / sent * 100, 1)) %>%
    mutate(
      cycle_summary = str_glue(
        "Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {returned} returned / {sent} kits sent ({percent_returned}%); {unreturned} kits not returned; {unsent} kits not sent"
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(cycle_summary) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n")
  
  
  packages_df <- packages %>%
    # # filter out kits that were prepared but not sent out (on Aug 1, 2025)
    # filter(shipment_sent_date != ymd("2025-8-1") | str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "^2. ", negate = T)) %>%
    # filter for shipments that were sent between the given dates
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    # identify re-do kits
    mutate(is_redo = shipment_id %in% redo_kits_v2$shipment_id) %>%
    mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = case_when(is_redo ~ str_c(as.character(shipment_cycle), ".2", sep = ""),
                                       !is_redo ~ as.character(shipment_cycle)))
  
  
  ### JOIN WITH STATUS CATEGORIES FROM ALLUVIAL PLOT DATA ###
  # get status categories from shipments_status_df
  status_categories <- shipments_status_df %>%
    # get shipment_id
    left_join(
      y = shipments_plot_df %>% select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_cycle),
      by = c("patient_id", "shipment_cycle")
    ) %>%
    select(shipment_id, shipment_cycle, status_category) %>%
    distinct()
  
  
  # join status categories with packages_df
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    left_join(
      y = status_categories,
      by = c("shipment_id", "shipment_cycle")
    ) %>%
    # handle any missing status categories
    mutate(
      status_categories = if_else(
        is.na(status_category),
        "Ineligible",
        status_category
      )
    )
  
  # define color palette from alluvial plot
  status_colors <- shipment_sankey_colors
  
  
  # define shapes for cycles (using solid shapes for better visibility)
  cycle_shapes <- c(
    "1" = 16,    # solid circle
    "1.2" = 1,   # hollow circle
    "2" = 17,    # solid triangle
    "2.2" = 2,   # hollow triangle
    "3" = 15,    # solid square
    "3.2" = 0    # hollow square
  )
  
  
  avg_days_in_transit <- packages_df %>%
    summarize(mean_transit = mean(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
              .by = returned) %>%
    filter(returned) %>%
    pull(mean_transit)
  
  
  # define stamp for printing dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025")
  
  
  # plot trends
  shipments_trend_plot <- packages_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = shipment_sent_date,
      y = shipment_received_date,
      # color = factor(shipment_cycle_v2)
      color = status_category,
      shape = shipment_cycle_v2
    )) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = num_pkgs), 
      alpha = 0.35
      # alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # add line to show rate of same-day return
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # add lines and text to show today's date
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today's date: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      x = c(as_date(-Inf), today()),
      y = c(today(), as_date(-Inf)),
      hjust = c(-0.2,-0.5),
      vjust = c(-0.5,-0.2),
      angle = c(0, 90),
      color = "darkgreen"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "label",
      label = "dotted line represents \npace of same-day return",
      # x = x_label,
      # y = y_label,
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      color = "black",
      vjust = -0.2,       # move slightly above the bottom
      hjust = 1.25        # move slightly inside the plot
    ) +
    # limit the x-axis to only show the dates specified by the function args
    xlim(c(
      date_shipped_start - days(2),
      # NA,
      date_shipped_end + days(2)
    )) +
    # facet_wrap(
    #   ~shipment_cycle_v2
    # ) +
    # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Shipment") +
    # apply alluvial plot color palette
    scale_color_manual(
      values = status_colors,
      name = "Status Category"
    ) +
    # apply shape scale for cycles
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = cycle_shapes,
      name = "Shipment Cycle",
      labels = c(
        "1" = "Cycle 1",
        "1.2" = "Cycle 1 (Re-do)",
        "2" = "Cycle 2",
        "2.2" = "Cycle 2 (Re-do)",
        "3" = "Cycle 3",
        "3.2" = "Cycle 3 (Re-do)"
      )
    ) +
    # size legend
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Number of Packages",
      breaks = c(10, 30, 50),
      range = c(2, 8)
    ) +
    labs(
      # title = "VIGOR Shipment Trends: Shipping vs. Return Dates",
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipments From {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date",
      caption = str_glue(
        "Average time before package return: {round(mean(avg_days_in_transit, na.rm = T), 2)} days (excludes unreturned packages)"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
    ) +
    guides(
      # override alpha for legend clarity
      color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), order = 1),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), order = 2),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3)
    )
    
  
  return(list(
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    plot = shipments_trend_plot
  ))
}

shipments_trend_alluvial_v1() %>% pluck("plot")
```

```{r eval=FALSE, message=FALSE}
shipments_trend_alluvial_v2 <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), date_shipped_end = today()) {
  
  # convert arguments to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  
  kit_summary <- shipments_plot_df %>%
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    transmute(
      shipment_id = shipment_id,
      shipment_cycle = shipment_cycle,
      shipment_status_simp = case_when(
        str_detect(shipment_status_desc, "7") ~ "7. Returned",
        .default = shipment_status_desc
      ),
      # a kit was "sent" if it has code 0 or code 3-7
      sent = if_else(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "[0|3-7]"),
                     T,
                     F)
    ) %>%
    summarize(
      total = n(),
      sent = sum(sent),
      unsent = total - sent,
      returned = sum(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "7")),
      unreturned = sent - returned,
      .by = shipment_cycle
    ) %>%
    arrange(shipment_cycle)
  
  subtitle <- kit_summary %>%
    mutate(percent_returned = round(returned / sent * 100, 1)) %>%
    mutate(
      cycle_summary = str_glue(
        "Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {returned} returned / {sent} kits sent ({percent_returned}%); {unreturned} kits not returned; {unsent} kits not sent"
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(cycle_summary) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n")
  
  
  packages_df <- packages %>%
    # # filter out kits that were prepared but not sent out (on Aug 1, 2025)
    # filter(shipment_sent_date != ymd("2025-8-1") | str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "^2. ", negate = T)) %>%
    # filter for shipments that were sent between the given dates
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    # identify re-do kits
    mutate(is_redo = shipment_id %in% redo_kits_v2$shipment_id) %>%
    mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = case_when(is_redo ~ str_c(as.character(shipment_cycle), ".2", sep = ""),
                                       !is_redo ~ as.character(shipment_cycle)))
  
  
  ### JOIN WITH STATUS CATEGORIES FROM ALLUVIAL PLOT DATA ###
  # get status categories from shipments_status_df
  status_categories <- shipments_status_df %>%
    # get shipment_id
    left_join(
      y = shipments_plot_df %>% select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_cycle),
      by = c("patient_id", "shipment_cycle")
    ) %>%
    select(shipment_id, shipment_cycle, status_category) %>%
    distinct()
  
  
  # join status categories with packages_df
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    left_join(
      y = status_categories,
      by = c("shipment_id", "shipment_cycle")
    ) %>%
    # handle any missing status categories
    mutate(
      status_categories = if_else(
        is.na(status_category),
        "Ineligible",
        status_category
      )
    )
  
  # OPTION 1: Create a combined color variable that includes both status and cycle
  # This creates unique colors for each status-cycle combination
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract base cycle number (1, 2, or 3) from shipment_cycle_v2
      base_cycle = str_extract(shipment_cycle_v2, "^\\d"),
      # Create combined category for coloring
      status_cycle_combo = paste(status_category, "- Cycle", base_cycle)
    )
  
  # Define expanded color palette with cycle variations
  # Using different shades/tints of the base colors for each cycle
  status_cycle_colors <- c(
    # Pre-shipment variations
    "Pre-shipment - Cycle 1" = "#F8AFA8",  # Original pink
    "Pre-shipment - Cycle 2" = "#F5928A",  # Darker pink
    "Pre-shipment - Cycle 3" = "#F2756C",  # Even darker pink
    
    # Outbound variations
    "Outbound - Cycle 1" = "#E2CD6D",      # Original yellow
    "Outbound - Cycle 2" = "#D4B94F",      # Darker yellow
    "Outbound - Cycle 3" = "#C6A531",      # Even darker yellow
    
    # With Participant variations
    "With Participant - Cycle 1" = "#A1D6AA",  # Original green
    "With Participant - Cycle 2" = "#7FC68B",  # Darker green
    "With Participant - Cycle 3" = "#5DB66C",  # Even darker green
    
    # Inbound variations
    "Inbound - Cycle 1" = "#74C4CC",       # Original cyan
    "Inbound - Cycle 2" = "#52B4BD",       # Darker cyan
    "Inbound - Cycle 3" = "#30A4AE",       # Even darker cyan
    
    # Received variations (most important to distinguish)
    "Received - Cycle 1" = "#94C4F5",      # Original blue
    "Received - Cycle 2" = "#6BA9EC",      # Darker blue
    "Received - Cycle 3" = "#428EE3",      # Even darker blue
    
    # Ineligible variations
    "Ineligible - Cycle 1" = "#E5A4DC",    # Original purple
    "Ineligible - Cycle 2" = "#DC85D0",    # Darker purple
    "Ineligible - Cycle 3" = "#D366C4",    # Even darker purple
    
    # Re-Do (keeping single color as it's rare)
    "Re-Do - Cycle 1" = "#BBBBBB",
    "Re-Do - Cycle 2" = "#999999",
    "Re-Do - Cycle 3" = "#777777"
  )
  
  # define shapes for cycles (using solid shapes for better visibility)
  cycle_shapes <- c(
    "1" = 16,    # solid circle
    "1.2" = 1,   # hollow circle
    "2" = 17,    # solid triangle
    "2.2" = 2,   # hollow triangle
    "3" = 15,    # solid square
    "3.2" = 0    # hollow square
  )
  
  # Add jitter to help with overlapping points
  set.seed(42)  # For reproducibility
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    mutate(
      # Add small jitter to shipping dates (±0.5 days)
      shipment_sent_date_jittered = shipment_sent_date + runif(n(), -0.5, 0.5),
      # Add small jitter to return dates if not NA (±0.5 days)
      shipment_received_date_jittered = if_else(
        !is.na(shipment_received_date),
        shipment_received_date + runif(n(), -0.5, 0.5),
        NA_Date_
      )
    )
  
  
  avg_days_in_transit <- packages_df %>%
    summarize(mean_transit = mean(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
              .by = returned) %>%
    filter(returned) %>%
    pull(mean_transit)
  
  
  # define stamp for printing dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025")
  
  
  # plot trends
  shipments_trend_plot <- packages_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      # use jittered dates
      x = shipment_sent_date_jittered,
      y = shipment_received_date_jittered,
      # color = factor(shipment_cycle_v2)
      color = status_cycle_combo,
      shape = shipment_cycle_v2
    )) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = num_pkgs), 
      alpha = 0.35,
      stroke = 0.5          # add subtle outline to points
      # alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # add line to show rate of same-day return
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # add lines and text to show today's date
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today's date: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      x = c(as_date(-Inf), today()),
      y = c(today(), as_date(-Inf)),
      hjust = c(-0.2,-0.5),
      vjust = c(-0.5,-0.2),
      angle = c(0, 90),
      color = "darkgreen"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "label",
      label = "dotted line represents \npace of same-day return",
      # x = x_label,
      # y = y_label,
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      color = "black",
      vjust = -0.2,       # move slightly above the bottom
      hjust = 1.25        # move slightly inside the plot
    ) +
    # limit the x-axis to only show the dates specified by the function args
    xlim(c(
      date_shipped_start - days(2),
      # NA,
      date_shipped_end + days(2)
    )) +
    # facet_wrap(
    #   ~shipment_cycle_v2
    # ) +
    # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Shipment") +
    # apply alluvial plot color palette
    scale_color_manual(
      values = status_cycle_colors,
      name = "Status by Cycle",
      # group the legend by status category
      guide = guide_legend(
        ncol = 3, # display in 3 columns for better organization
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)
      )
    ) +
    # apply shape scale for cycles (remove this if too cluttered)
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = cycle_shapes,
      name = "Shipment Type",
      labels = c(
        "1" = "Regular",
        "1.2" = "Re-do",
        "2" = "Regular",
        "2.2" = "Re-do",
        "3" = "Regular",
        "3.2" = "Re-do"
      ),
      guide = "none"        # hide shape legend to reduce clutter (optional)
    ) +
    # size legend
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Packages",
      breaks = c(10, 30, 50),
      range = c(1.5, 6),        # slightly smaller range for less overlap
      guide = "none",           # hide size legend to reduce clutter (optional)
    ) +
    labs(
      # title = "VIGOR Shipment Trends: Shipping vs. Return Dates",
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipments From {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date",
      caption = str_glue(
        "Average time before package return: {round(mean(avg_days_in_transit, na.rm = T), 2)} days (excludes unreturned packages)\nPoints are jittered ±0.5 days to reduce overlap"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      # legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
  
  # +
  #   guides(
  #     # override alpha for legend clarity
  #     color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), order = 1),
  #     shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), order = 2),
  #     size = guide_legend(order = 3)
  #   )
    
  
  return(list(
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    plot = shipments_trend_plot
  ))
}
```
