```{r message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
shipments_trend_alluvial_v3 <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), date_shipped_end = today()) {
  
  # convert arguments to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  
  kit_summary <- shipments_plot_df %>%
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    transmute(
      shipment_id = shipment_id,
      shipment_cycle = shipment_cycle,
      shipment_status_simp = case_when(
        str_detect(shipment_status_desc, "7") ~ "7. Returned",
        .default = shipment_status_desc
      ),
      # a kit was "sent" if it has code 0 or code 3-7
      sent = if_else(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "[0|3-7]"),
                     T,
                     F)
    ) %>%
    summarize(
      total = n(),
      sent = sum(sent),
      unsent = total - sent,
      returned = sum(str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "7")),
      unreturned = sent - returned,
      .by = shipment_cycle
    ) %>%
    arrange(shipment_cycle)
  
  subtitle <- kit_summary %>%
    mutate(percent_returned = round(returned / sent * 100, 1)) %>%
    mutate(
      cycle_summary = str_glue(
        "Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {returned} returned / {sent} kits sent ({percent_returned}%); {unreturned} kits not returned; {unsent} kits not sent"
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(cycle_summary) %>%
    paste(collapse = "\n")
  
  
  packages_df <- packages %>%
    # # filter out kits that were prepared but not sent out (on Aug 1, 2025)
    # filter(shipment_sent_date != ymd("2025-8-1") | str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "^2. ", negate = T)) %>%
    # filter for shipments that were sent between the given dates
    filter(between(shipment_sent_date, date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)) %>%
    # identify re-do kits
    mutate(is_redo = shipment_id %in% redo_kits_v2$shipment_id) %>%
    mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = case_when(is_redo ~ str_c(as.character(shipment_cycle), ".2", sep = ""),
                                       !is_redo ~ as.character(shipment_cycle)))
  
  
  ### JOIN WITH STATUS CATEGORIES FROM ALLUVIAL PLOT DATA ###
  # get status categories from shipments_status_df
  status_categories <- shipments_status_df %>%
    # get shipment_id
    left_join(
      y = shipments_plot_df %>% select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_cycle),
      by = c("patient_id", "shipment_cycle")
    ) %>%
    select(shipment_id, shipment_cycle, status_category) %>%
    distinct()
  
  
  # join status categories with packages_df
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    left_join(
      y = status_categories,
      by = c("shipment_id", "shipment_cycle")
    ) %>%
    # handle any missing status categories
    mutate(
      status_categories = if_else(
        is.na(status_category),
        "Ineligible",
        status_category
      )
    )
  
  # OPTION 1: Create a combined color variable that includes both status and cycle
  # This creates unique colors for each status-cycle combination
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    mutate(
      # Extract base cycle number (1, 2, or 3) from shipment_cycle_v2
      base_cycle = str_extract(shipment_cycle_v2, "^\\d"),
      # Create combined category for coloring
      status_cycle_combo = paste(status_category, "- Cycle", base_cycle)
    )
  
  # Define expanded color palette with cycle variations
  # Using different shades/tints of the base colors for each cycle
  status_cycle_colors <- c(
    # Pre-shipment variations
    "Pre-shipment - Cycle 1" = "#F8AFA8",  # Original pink
    "Pre-shipment - Cycle 2" = "#F5928A",  # Darker pink
    "Pre-shipment - Cycle 3" = "#F2756C",  # Even darker pink
    
    # Outbound variations
    "Outbound - Cycle 1" = "#E2CD6D",      # Original yellow
    "Outbound - Cycle 2" = "#D4B94F",      # Darker yellow
    "Outbound - Cycle 3" = "#C6A531",      # Even darker yellow
    
    # With Participant variations
    "With Participant - Cycle 1" = "#A1D6AA",  # Original green
    "With Participant - Cycle 2" = "#7FC68B",  # Darker green
    "With Participant - Cycle 3" = "#5DB66C",  # Even darker green
    
    # Inbound variations
    "Inbound - Cycle 1" = "#74C4CC",       # Original cyan
    "Inbound - Cycle 2" = "#52B4BD",       # Darker cyan
    "Inbound - Cycle 3" = "#30A4AE",       # Even darker cyan
    
    # Received variations (most important to distinguish)
    "Received - Cycle 1" = "#94C4F5",      # Original blue
    "Received - Cycle 2" = "#6BA9EC",      # Darker blue
    "Received - Cycle 3" = "#428EE3",      # Even darker blue
    
    # Ineligible variations
    "Ineligible - Cycle 1" = "#E5A4DC",    # Original purple
    "Ineligible - Cycle 2" = "#DC85D0",    # Darker purple
    "Ineligible - Cycle 3" = "#D366C4",    # Even darker purple
    
    # Re-Do (keeping single color as it's rare)
    "Re-Do - Cycle 1" = "#BBBBBB",
    "Re-Do - Cycle 2" = "#999999",
    "Re-Do - Cycle 3" = "#777777"
  )
  
  # define shapes for cycles (using solid shapes for better visibility)
  cycle_shapes <- c(
    "1" = 16,    # solid circle
    "1.2" = 1,   # hollow circle
    "2" = 17,    # solid triangle
    "2.2" = 2,   # hollow triangle
    "3" = 15,    # solid square
    "3.2" = 0    # hollow square
  )
  
  # Add jitter to help with overlapping points
  set.seed(42)  # For reproducibility
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    mutate(
      # Add small jitter to shipping dates (±0.5 days)
      shipment_sent_date_jittered = shipment_sent_date + runif(n(), -0.5, 0.5),
      # Add small jitter to return dates if not NA (±0.5 days)
      shipment_received_date_jittered = if_else(
        !is.na(shipment_received_date),
        shipment_received_date + runif(n(), -0.5, 0.5),
        NA_Date_
      )
    )
  
  
  avg_days_in_transit <- packages_df %>%
    summarize(mean_transit = mean(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
              .by = returned) %>%
    filter(returned) %>%
    pull(mean_transit)
  
  
  # define stamp for printing dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025")
  
  
  # plot trends
  shipments_trend_plot <- packages_df %>%
    mutate(Cycle = paste("Cycle", base_cycle)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = shipment_sent_date,
      y = shipment_received_date,
      color = status_category
    )) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = num_pkgs), 
      alpha = 0.35,
      stroke = 0.5          # add subtle outline to points
      # alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Cycle,
      ncol = 3
    ) +
    # add line to show rate of same-day return
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    # add lines and text to show today's date
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen") +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today's date: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      x = c(as_date(-Inf), today()),
      y = c(today(), as_date(-Inf)),
      hjust = c(-0.2,-0.5),
      vjust = c(-0.5,-0.2),
      angle = c(0, 90),
      color = "darkgreen"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "label",
      label = "dotted line represents \npace of same-day return",
      # x = x_label,
      # y = y_label,
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      color = "black",
      vjust = -0.2,       # move slightly above the bottom
      hjust = 1.25        # move slightly inside the plot
    ) +
    # limit the x-axis to only show the dates specified by the function args
    xlim(c(
      date_shipped_start - days(2),
      # NA,
      date_shipped_end + days(2)
    )) +
    # scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Shipment") +
    # apply alluvial plot color palette
    scale_color_manual(
      values = status_cycle_colors,
      name = "Status by Cycle",
      # group the legend by status category
      guide = guide_legend(
        ncol = 3, # display in 3 columns for better organization
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)
      )
    ) +
    # apply shape scale for cycles (remove this if too cluttered)
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = cycle_shapes,
      name = "Shipment Type",
      labels = c(
        "1" = "Regular",
        "1.2" = "Re-do",
        "2" = "Regular",
        "2.2" = "Re-do",
        "3" = "Regular",
        "3.2" = "Re-do"
      ),
      guide = "none"        # hide shape legend to reduce clutter (optional)
    ) +
    # size legend
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Packages",
      breaks = c(10, 30, 50),
      range = c(1.5, 6),        # slightly smaller range for less overlap
      guide = "none",           # hide size legend to reduce clutter (optional)
    ) +
    labs(
      # title = "VIGOR Shipment Trends: Shipping vs. Return Dates",
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipments From {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date",
      caption = str_glue(
        "Average time before package return: {round(mean(avg_days_in_transit, na.rm = T), 2)} days (excludes unreturned packages)\nPoints are jittered ±0.5 days to reduce overlap"
      )
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      # legend.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
  
  # +
  #   guides(
  #     # override alpha for legend clarity
  #     color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), order = 1),
  #     shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3), order = 2),
  #     size = guide_legend(order = 3)
  #   )
    
  
  return(list(
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    plot = shipments_trend_plot
  ))
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
shipments_overdue_analysis <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), 
                                       date_shipped_end = today(), 
                                       percentile_threshold = 0.95) {
  # # function params with default args
  # date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27")
  # date_shipped_end = today()
  # percentile_threshold = 0.95
  
  
  
  # ---------------------- Re-use from original function ---------------------- #
  
  # convert ags to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  
  # get kit summary from `shipments_trend_alluvial_v4()`
  kit_summary <- shipments_trend_alluvial_v4(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)$kit_summary
  
  # create subtitle
  subtitle <- shipments_trend_alluvial_v4(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)$subtitle
  
  # prepare packages DF
  packages_df <- shipments_trend_alluvial_v4(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)$packages
  
  # get shipment status categories
  status_categories <- shipments_trend_alluvial_v4(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)$ship_status
  
  
  
  # ------------------- Statistical Analysis of Return Times ------------------- #
  
  # subset packages that have returned
  # TODO: modify this function to take ALL shipments as a sample regardless of what the input params were
  returned_shipments <- packages_df %>% filter(returned)
  
  # calculate percentiles and statistics for return times
  return_time_stats <- returned_shipments %>%
    summarize(
      mean_days = mean(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
      median_days = median(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
      sd_days = sd(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
      q25 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.25, na.rm = T),
      q50 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.5, na.rm = T),
      q75 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      q99 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_days = max(days_in_transit, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # calculate cycle-specific stats (optional - for more granular analysis)
  return_time_stats_by_cycle <- returned_shipments %>%
    # rounded shipment cycle
    group_by(base_cycle) %>%
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      mean_days = mean(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
      median_days = median(days_in_transit, na.rm = T),
      q75 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.75, na.rm = T),
      q90 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(days_in_transit, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # for unreturned shipments, calculate days since shipment
  packages_df <- packages_df %>%
    mutate(
      # TODO: For unreturned shipments, their y-value in the plot should be number of days since package was shipped
      days_since_shipment = as.numeric(today() - shipment_sent_date),
      # calculate percentile for each shipment based on historical distribution
      # using empirical CDF to assign probabilities
      percentile_position = case_when(
        returned ~ NA_real_,      # don't calculate for returned shipments
        !returned ~ ecdf(returned_shipments$days_in_transit)(days_since_shipment)
      ),
      # classify unreturned shipments based on percentile
      # TODO: Re-do these categories
      overdue_status = case_when(
        returned ~ "Returned",
        !returned & percentile_position <= 0.5 ~ "On Track (<50th percentile)",
        !returned & percentile_position <= 0.75 ~ "Normal (50-75th percentile)",
        !returned & percentile_position <= 0.9 ~ "Getting Late (75-90th percentile)",
        !returned & percentile_position <= 0.95 ~ "Late (90-95th percentile)",
        !returned & percentile_position <= 0.99 ~ "Very Late (95-99th percentile)",
        !returned & percentile_position > 0.99 ~ "Extremely Overdue (>99th percentile)",
      )
    )
  
  # %>%
  #   select(
  #     patient_id, shipment_id,
  #     status=shipment_status_desc,
  #     batch=shipment_batch,
  #     cycle=shipment_cycle,
  #     returned,
  #     d_trans=days_in_transit,
  #     is_redo,
  #     cat=status_category,
  #     d_since=days_since_shipment,
  #     percentile_position,
  #     overdue_status
  #   )
  
  
  # -------------------------- Create Plot -------------------------- #
  
  # create color palette for overdue status
  overdue_colors <- c(
      "Returned" = "#94C4F5",                    # Blue (from original)
      "On Track (<50th percentile)" = "#2E8B57", # Sea green - good
      "Normal (50-75th percentile)" = "#90EE90", # Light green - okay
      "Getting Late (75-90th percentile)" = "#FFD700", # Gold - caution
      "Late (90-95th percentile)" = "#FF8C00",   # Dark orange - warning
      "Very Late (95-99th percentile)" = "#FF4500", # Orange red - concern
      "Extremely Overdue (>99th percentile)" = "#8B0000" # Dark red - critical
      # "Unknown" = "#808080"                       # Gray
    )
  
  
  # define stamp for printing dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025", quiet = T)
  
  # calculate summary stats for caption
  overdue_summary <- packages_df %>%
    filter(!returned) %>%
    count(overdue_status) %>%
    mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))
  
  # create enhanced caption with overdue stats
  plot_caption <- str_glue(
      "Return time statistics: Median {round(return_time_stats$median_days, 1)} days | ",
      "75th percentile: {round(return_time_stats$q75, 1)} days | ",
      "90th percentile: {round(return_time_stats$q90, 1)} days | ",
      "95th percentile: {round(return_time_stats$q95, 1)} days\n",
      "Unreturned shipments: ",
      "{sum(overdue_summary$n[overdue_summary$overdue_status %in% c('Late (90-95th percentile)', 'Very Late (95-99th percentile)', 'Extremely Overdue (>99th percentile)')])} ",
      "overdue (>90th percentile) out of {sum(overdue_summary$n)} total unreturned"
    )
  
  
  # create the plot
  overdue_plot <- packages_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = shipment_sent_date,
      y = shipment_received_date,
      color = overdue_status
    )) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = num_pkgs,
        shape = is_redo,
        alpha = overdue_status
      ),
      stroke = 0.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Cycle,
      ncol = length(cycle_cols),
      scales = "free"
    ) +
    # add reference lines for key percentiles
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$median_days,
      linetype = "dotted",
      alpha = 0.3,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$q90,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.3,
      color = "orange"
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$q95,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.3,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    # Today's date indicators
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(),
               color = "darkgreen",
               alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(),
               color = "darkgreen",
               alpha = 0.7) +
    # Annotations
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      x = as_date(-Inf),
      y = today(),
      hjust = -0.2,
      vjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      x = today(),
      angle = 90,
      vjust = -0.2,
      hjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    # color scale
    scale_color_manual(
      values = overdue_colors,
      name = "Return Status",
      breaks = c("Returned", "On Track (<50th percentile)", "Normal (50-75th percentile)",
                   "Getting Late (75-90th percentile)", "Late (90-95th percentile)",
                   "Very Late (95-99th percentile)", "Extremely Overdue (>99th percentile)")
    ) +
    # Alpha scale to emphasize overdue shipments
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(
        "Returned" = 0.3,
        "On Track (<50th percentile)" = 0.6,
        "Normal (50-75th percentile)" = 0.7,
        "Getting Late (75-90th percentile)" = 0.8,
        "Late (90-95th percentile)" = 0.9,
        "Very Late (95-99th percentile)" = 1.0,
        "Extremely Overdue (>99th percentile)" = 1.0
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    # shape scale
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 1),
      name = "Shipment Type",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "Regular", "TRUE" = "Re-do")
    ) +
    # Size scale
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Number of Packages",
                          breaks = c(10, 30, 50),
                          range = c(1, 6)) +
    # labels
    labs(
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipment Return Status: {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = str_c("Highlighting unreturned shipments by likelihood of return based on historical data\n\n", subtitle),
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date",
      caption = plot_caption
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8),
      plot.caption.position = "panel",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3),
        order = 1,
        ncol = 3
      ),
      shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3),
                           order = 2),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3)
    )
  
  
  # create a summary table of overdue shipments for follow-up 
  overdue_for_followup <- packages_df %>%
    # unreturned shipments greater than the 90th percentile of time-to-return 
    filter(!returned,
           percentile_position > 0.9) %>%
    select(
      patient_id,
      shipment_id,
      shipment_batch,
      shipment_cycle,
      shipment_sent_date,
      days_since_shipment,
      percentile_position,
      overdue_status
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(days_since_shipment))
  
  # TODO: Output a message or something for the user to know what this function can return. A print statement? Or something better?
  return(list(
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    return_time_stats = return_time_stats,
    return_time_stats_by_cycle = return_time_stats_by_cycle,
    overdue_summary = overdue_summary,
    overdue_for_followup = overdue_for_followup,
    plot = overdue_plot
  ))
}
```

### v3


```{r eval=FALSE}
shipments_overdue_analysis <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), 
                                       date_shipped_end = today(), 
                                       percentile_threshold = 0.95) {
  
  # Convert arguments to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  # Handle the conflicting shipment
  patient_id_to_remove <- "VIGOR_247_1_v"
  shipment_id_to_remove <- "VIGOR_247_1_v-1"
  shipment_sent_date_to_remove <- ymd("2024-7-25")
  shipment_cycle_to_remove <- 1
  shipment_status_category_to_remove <- "Pre-shipment"
  
  if (shipments_plot_df %>% 
      filter(shipment_id == shipment_id_to_remove) %>% 
      pull(shipment_sent_date) == shipment_sent_date_to_remove) {
    
    shipments_plot_df <- shipments_plot_df %>% 
      filter(shipment_id != shipment_id_to_remove |
             shipment_sent_date != shipment_sent_date_to_remove)
    
    packages <- packages %>% 
      filter(shipment_id != shipment_id_to_remove |
             shipment_sent_date != shipment_sent_date_to_remove)
    
    shipments_status_df <- shipments_status_df %>% 
      filter(patient_id != patient_id_to_remove |
             shipment_cycle != shipment_cycle_to_remove |
             status_category != shipment_status_category_to_remove)
  }
  
  # Get base data from v4 function
  plot_data_results <- shipments_trend_alluvial_v4(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)
  kit_summary <- plot_data_results$kit_summary
  subtitle <- plot_data_results$subtitle
  packages_df_filtered <- plot_data_results$packages
  
  # Get ALL packages for statistical analysis
  all_packages <- packages %>%
    filter(shipment_id != shipment_id_to_remove | 
           shipment_sent_date != shipment_sent_date_to_remove) %>%
    mutate(is_redo = shipment_id %in% redo_kits_v2$shipment_id) %>%
    mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = case_when(
      is_redo ~ str_c(as.character(shipment_cycle), ".2", sep = ""),
      !is_redo ~ as.character(shipment_cycle)
    ))
  
  # Get ALL returned shipments for calculating statistics
  # Exclude unsent packages from statistical analysis
  all_returned_shipments <- all_packages %>% 
    filter(returned == TRUE,
           shipment_status_simp != "2. Barcode Generated") %>%
    mutate(return_time_days = as.numeric(shipment_received_date - shipment_sent_date))
  
  # Calculate return time statistics
  return_time_stats <- all_returned_shipments %>%
    summarize(
      n_total = n(),
      mean_days = mean(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_days = median(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_days = sd(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mad_days = mad(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q50 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      q99 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q75 - q25,
      max_days = max(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Calculate Tukey's outlier boundaries
  tukey_mild_threshold <- return_time_stats$q75 + 1.5 * return_time_stats$iqr
  tukey_extreme_threshold <- return_time_stats$q75 + 3 * return_time_stats$iqr
  
  # Cycle-specific statistics
  return_time_stats_by_cycle <- all_returned_shipments %>%
    mutate(base_cycle = as.character(shipment_cycle)) %>%
    group_by(base_cycle) %>%
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      mean_days = mean(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_days = median(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mad_days = mad(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Classify shipments with robust statistics
  packages_df <- packages_df_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      # Check if package was never sent
      is_unsent = (shipment_status_simp == "2. Barcode Generated"),
      
      # Calculate days since shipment for unreturned packages
      days_since_shipment = as.numeric(today() - shipment_sent_date),
      
      # For plotting: set y-value
      shipment_received_date_adjusted = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ shipment_received_date,
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ shipment_sent_date + days(5),  # Place unsent packages near the bottom
        returned == FALSE ~ shipment_sent_date + days(days_since_shipment)
      ),
      
      # Calculate percentile position (excluding unsent)
      percentile_position = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        returned == FALSE ~ ecdf(all_returned_shipments$return_time_days)(days_since_shipment)
      ),
      
      # Calculate Modified Z-score (excluding unsent)
      modified_z_score = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        returned == FALSE ~ 0.6745 * (days_since_shipment - return_time_stats$median_days) / return_time_stats$mad_days
      ),
      
      # Classify using Tukey's method
      tukey_classification = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ "Returned",
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ "Unsent",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$median_days ~ "Within Median",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$q75 ~ "Above Median",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_mild_threshold ~ "Approaching Outlier",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Mild Outlier",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment > tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Extreme Outlier",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      
      # Simplified status for coloring
      overdue_status_simple = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ "Returned",
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ "Unsent",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$q75 ~ "Normal",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_mild_threshold ~ "Getting Late",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Overdue (Mild)",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment > tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Overdue (Extreme)",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      
      # Detailed status for reference
      overdue_status = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ "Returned",
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ "Unsent (Barcode Generated)",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$q75 ~ 
          paste0("Normal (≤75th %ile, ", round(days_since_shipment), " days)"),
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_mild_threshold ~ 
          paste0("Getting Late (", round(percentile_position * 100), "th %ile)"),
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_extreme_threshold ~ 
          paste0("Overdue - Mild Outlier (", round(percentile_position * 100), "th %ile)"),
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment > tukey_extreme_threshold ~ 
          paste0("Overdue - Extreme Outlier (", round(percentile_position * 100), "th %ile)"),
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    )
  
  # Color palette including "Unsent" category
  overdue_colors <- c(
    "Returned" = "#94C4F5",           # Blue
    "Unsent" = "#C494F5",              # Light purple for unsent packages
    "Normal" = "#2E8B57",              # Sea green
    "Getting Late" = "#FFD700",        # Gold
    "Overdue (Mild)" = "#FF8C00",     # Dark orange
    "Overdue (Extreme)" = "#DC143C",  # Crimson
    "Unknown" = "#808080"              # Gray
  )
  
  # Define stamp for dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025", quiet = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate summary for caption
  overdue_summary <- packages_df %>%
    filter(returned == FALSE, is_unsent == FALSE) %>%
    summarize(
      total_unreturned_sent = n(),
      n_overdue_mild = sum(str_detect(overdue_status_simple, "Overdue \\(Mild\\)"), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_overdue_extreme = sum(str_detect(overdue_status_simple, "Overdue \\(Extreme\\)"), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_total_overdue = n_overdue_mild + n_overdue_extreme
    )
  
  # Count unsent packages
  n_unsent <- sum(packages_df$is_unsent, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Enhanced caption
  plot_caption <- str_glue(
    "Statistical Thresholds: Median {round(return_time_stats$median_days, 1)} days | ",
    "75th %ile: {round(return_time_stats$q75, 1)} days | ",
    "Mild Outlier: >{round(tukey_mild_threshold, 1)} days (Tukey's Q3+1.5*IQR) | ",
    "Extreme Outlier: >{round(tukey_extreme_threshold, 1)} days (Q3+3*IQR)\n",
    "Packages: {n_unsent} unsent (barcode generated) | ",
    "{overdue_summary$total_unreturned_sent} unreturned sent packages, of which ",
    "{overdue_summary$n_total_overdue} are outliers ",
    "({overdue_summary$n_overdue_mild} mild, {overdue_summary$n_overdue_extreme} extreme)"
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  overdue_plot <- packages_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = shipment_sent_date,
      y = shipment_received_date_adjusted,
      color = overdue_status_simple
    )) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = num_pkgs,
        shape = is_redo,
        alpha = overdue_status_simple
      ),
      stroke = 0.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Cycle,
      ncol = 3,
      scales = "free"
    ) +
    # Reference lines for statistical thresholds
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$median_days,
      # linetype = "dotted",
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$q75,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "darkgreen"
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = tukey_mild_threshold,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "orange"
    ) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = tukey_extreme_threshold,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    # Today's date indicators
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    # Annotations
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      x = as_date(-Inf),
      y = today(),
      hjust = -0.2,
      vjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      x = today(),
      angle = 90,
      vjust = -0.2,
      hjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    # Color scale with "Unsent" included
    scale_color_manual(
      values = overdue_colors,
      name = "Return Status",
      breaks = c("Returned", "Unsent", "Normal", "Getting Late", 
                 "Overdue (Mild)", "Overdue (Extreme)")
    ) +
    # Alpha scale with "Unsent" included
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(
        "Returned" = 0.5,
        "Unsent" = 0.5,
        "Normal" = 0.6,
        "Getting Late" = 0.65,
        "Overdue (Mild)" = 0.65,
        "Overdue (Extreme)" = 0.7,
        "Unknown" = 0.5
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    # Shape scale
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 1),
      name = "Shipment Type",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "Regular", "TRUE" = "Re-do")
    ) +
    # Size scale
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Number of Packages",
      breaks = c(10, 30, 50),
      range = c(1, 6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipment Return Status: {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = str_c("Outlier detection using Tukey's method (IQR-based) on historical return times\n\n", subtitle),
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date / Days Since Shipment (for unreturned)",
      caption = plot_caption
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8),
      plot.caption.position = "panel",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3),
        order = 1,
        ncol = 2
      ),
      shape = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3),
        order = 2
      ),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3)
    )
  
  # Table of shipments needing follow-up (excluding unsent)
  overdue_for_followup <- packages_df %>%
    filter(
      returned == FALSE,
      is_unsent == FALSE,  # Exclude unsent packages
      days_since_shipment > tukey_mild_threshold
    ) %>%
    select(
      patient_id,
      shipment_id,
      shipment_batch,
      shipment_cycle,
      shipment_sent_date,
      days_since_shipment,
      percentile_position,
      modified_z_score,
      overdue_status_simple,
      overdue_status
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(days_since_shipment))
  
  # Store thresholds for reference
  thresholds <- list(
    median = return_time_stats$median_days,
    q75 = return_time_stats$q75,
    tukey_mild = tukey_mild_threshold,
    tukey_extreme = tukey_extreme_threshold,
    mad = return_time_stats$mad_days
  )
  
  # Print informative message
  cat("\n========== FUNCTION RETURNS ==========\n")
  cat("This function returns a list with the following components:\n")
  cat("  $plot                      - Main visualization of shipment return status\n")
  cat("  $kit_summary               - Summary statistics by cycle\n")
  cat("  $packages                  - Full dataset with classifications\n")
  cat("  $return_time_stats         - Overall return time statistics\n")
  cat("  $return_time_stats_by_cycle - Return statistics broken down by cycle\n")
  cat("  $overdue_summary           - Count of unreturned shipments by status\n")
  cat("  $overdue_for_followup      - Table of statistical outliers needing attention\n")
  cat("  $thresholds                - Statistical thresholds used for classification\n")
  cat("\nAccess components using: result$plot, result$overdue_for_followup, etc.\n")
  cat("======================================\n\n")
  
  return(list(
    plot = overdue_plot,
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    return_time_stats = return_time_stats,
    return_time_stats_by_cycle = return_time_stats_by_cycle,
    overdue_summary = overdue_summary,
    overdue_for_followup = overdue_for_followup,
    thresholds = thresholds
  ))
}

result <- shipments_overdue_analysis()
```

```{r}
shipments_overdue_analysis_v2 <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), 
                                       date_shipped_end = today(), 
                                       percentile_threshold = 0.95) {
  
  # Convert arguments to date format
  if (class(date_shipped_start) != "Date" | class(date_shipped_end) != "Date") {
    date_shipped_start <- as_date(date_shipped_start)
    date_shipped_end <- as_date(date_shipped_end)
  }
  
  # # Handle the conflicting shipment
  # patient_id_to_remove <- "VIGOR_247_1_v"
  # shipment_id_to_remove <- "VIGOR_247_1_v-1"
  # shipment_sent_date_to_remove <- ymd("2024-7-25")
  # shipment_cycle_to_remove <- 1
  # shipment_status_category_to_remove <- "Pre-shipment"
  # 
  # if (shipments_plot_df %>% 
  #     filter(shipment_id == shipment_id_to_remove) %>% 
  #     pull(shipment_sent_date) == shipment_sent_date_to_remove) {
  #   
  #   shipments_plot_df <- shipments_plot_df %>% 
  #     filter(shipment_id != shipment_id_to_remove |
  #              shipment_sent_date != shipment_sent_date_to_remove)
  #   
  #   packages <- packages %>% 
  #     filter(shipment_id != shipment_id_to_remove |
  #              shipment_sent_date != shipment_sent_date_to_remove)
  #   
  #   shipments_status_df <- shipments_status_df %>% 
  #     filter(patient_id != patient_id_to_remove |
  #              shipment_cycle != shipment_cycle_to_remove |
  #              status_category != shipment_status_category_to_remove)
  # }
  
  # Get base data from v4 function
  plot_data_results <- shipments_trend_alluvial_v4(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)
  kit_summary <- plot_data_results$kit_summary
  original_subtitle <- plot_data_results$subtitle
  packages_df_filtered <- plot_data_results$packages
  
  # Get ALL packages for statistical analysis
  all_packages <- packages %>%
    # filter(shipment_id != shipment_id_to_remove | shipment_sent_date != shipment_sent_date_to_remove) %>%
    
    # identify re-do kits
    mutate(is_redo = shipment_id %in% redo_kits_v2$shipment_id) %>%
    # join readable shipment cycles for re-do kits
    left_join(y = redo_kits_v2 %>% select(shipment_id, ship_cycle_readable),
              by = "shipment_id") %>%
    # write new shipment cycle as a decimal for re-do kits
    mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = coalesce(ship_cycle_readable, as.character(shipment_cycle)))
    # mutate(shipment_cycle_v2 = case_when(
    #   is_redo ~ str_c(as.character(shipment_cycle), ".2", sep = ""),
    #   !is_redo ~ as.character(shipment_cycle)
    # ))
  
  
  # Get ALL returned shipments for calculating statistics
  # Exclude unsent packages from statistical analysis
  all_returned_shipments <- all_packages %>% 
    filter(returned == TRUE,
           shipment_status_simp != "2. Barcode Generated") %>%
    mutate(return_time_days = as.numeric(shipment_received_date - shipment_sent_date))
  
  # Calculate return time statistics
  return_time_stats <- all_returned_shipments %>%
    summarize(
      n_total = n(),
      mean_days = mean(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_days = median(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_days = sd(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mad_days = mad(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q50 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      q99 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
      iqr = q75 - q25,
      max_days = max(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Calculate Tukey's outlier boundaries
  tukey_mild_threshold <- return_time_stats$q75 + 1.5 * return_time_stats$iqr
  tukey_extreme_threshold <- return_time_stats$q75 + 3 * return_time_stats$iqr
  
  # Cycle-specific statistics
  return_time_stats_by_cycle <- all_returned_shipments %>%
    mutate(base_cycle = as.character(shipment_cycle)) %>%
    group_by(base_cycle) %>%
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      mean_days = mean(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_days = median(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mad_days = mad(return_time_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
      q95 = quantile(return_time_days, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Classify shipments with robust statistics
  packages_df <- packages_df_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      # Check if package was never sent
      is_unsent = (shipment_status_simp == "2. Barcode Generated"),
      
      # Calculate days since shipment for unreturned packages
      days_since_shipment = as.numeric(today() - shipment_sent_date),
      
      # For plotting: set y-value
      shipment_received_date_adjusted = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ shipment_received_date,
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ shipment_sent_date + days(5),  # Place unsent packages near the bottom
        returned == FALSE ~ shipment_sent_date + days(days_since_shipment)
      ),
      
      # Calculate percentile position (excluding unsent)
      percentile_position = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        returned == FALSE ~ ecdf(all_returned_shipments$return_time_days)(days_since_shipment)
      ),
      
      # Calculate Modified Z-score (excluding unsent)
      modified_z_score = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ NA_real_,
        returned == FALSE ~ 0.6745 * (days_since_shipment - return_time_stats$median_days) / return_time_stats$mad_days
      ),
      
      # Classify using Tukey's method
      tukey_classification = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ "Returned",
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ "Unsent",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$median_days ~ "Within Median",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$q75 ~ "Above Median",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_mild_threshold ~ "Approaching Outlier",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Mild Outlier",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment > tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Extreme Outlier",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      
      # Simplified status for coloring
      overdue_status_simple = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ "Returned",
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ "Unsent",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$q75 ~ "Normal",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_mild_threshold ~ "Getting Late",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Overdue (Mild)",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment > tukey_extreme_threshold ~ "Overdue (Extreme)",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      
      # Detailed status for reference
      overdue_status = case_when(
        returned == TRUE ~ "Returned",
        is_unsent == TRUE ~ "Unsent (Barcode Generated)",
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= return_time_stats$q75 ~ 
          paste0("Normal (≤75th %ile, ", round(days_since_shipment), " days)"),
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_mild_threshold ~ 
          paste0("Getting Late (", round(percentile_position * 100), "th %ile)"),
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment <= tukey_extreme_threshold ~ 
          paste0("Overdue - Mild Outlier (", round(percentile_position * 100), "th %ile)"),
        returned == FALSE & days_since_shipment > tukey_extreme_threshold ~ 
          paste0("Overdue - Extreme Outlier (", round(percentile_position * 100), "th %ile)"),
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    )
  
  # Calculate overdue statistics by cycle for enhanced subtitle
  overdue_by_cycle <- packages_df %>%
    filter(returned == FALSE, is_unsent == FALSE) %>%
    group_by(shipment_cycle) %>%
    summarize(
      total_unreturned = n(),
      n_overdue = sum(days_since_shipment > tukey_mild_threshold),
      pct_overdue = round(n_overdue / total_unreturned * 100, 1)
    )
  
  # # Create enhanced subtitle with overdue information
  # enhanced_subtitle_parts <- overdue_by_cycle %>%
  #   mutate(
  #     cycle_overdue_text = str_glue(
  #       "Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {n_overdue} overdue ({pct_overdue}%)"
  #     )
  #   ) %>%
  #   pull(cycle_overdue_text)
  # 
  # # Combine original subtitle with overdue information
  # subtitle <- paste(
  #   original_subtitle,
  #   "\nOverdue (outliers): ",
  #   paste(enhanced_subtitle_parts, collapse = " | ")
  # )
  
  # split the subtitle into lines
  original_subtitle_lines <- str_split_1(original_subtitle, "\n")
  
  # modify each line using the info in overdue_by_cycle
  subtitle_mod <- map_chr(1:nrow(overdue_by_cycle), function(i) {
    # find the matching line
    line <- original_subtitle_lines[i]
    
    # construct the replacement text
    not_returned <- overdue_by_cycle$total_unreturned[i]
    overdue <- overdue_by_cycle$n_overdue[i]
    
    # replace the 'XX kits not returned' text with 'XX kits not returned (YY are overdue)'
    str_replace(
      line,
      paste0(not_returned, " kits not returned"),
      paste0(not_returned, " kits not returned (", overdue, " are overdue)")
    )
  })
  
  subtitle <- str_c(subtitle_mod, collapse = "\n")
  
  # Color palette including "Unsent" category
  overdue_colors <- c(
    "Returned" = "#94C4F5",           # Blue
    "Unsent" = "#C494F5",              # Light purple for unsent packages
    "Normal" = "#2E8B57",              # Sea green
    "Getting Late" = "#FFD700",        # Gold
    "Overdue (Mild)" = "#FF8C00",     # Dark orange
    "Overdue (Extreme)" = "#DC143C",  # Crimson
    "Unknown" = "#808080"              # Gray
  )
  
  # Define stamp for dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025", quiet = TRUE)
  
  # Calculate summary for caption
  overdue_summary <- packages_df %>%
    filter(returned == FALSE, is_unsent == FALSE) %>%
    summarize(
      total_unreturned_sent = n(),
      n_overdue_mild = sum(str_detect(overdue_status_simple, "Overdue \\(Mild\\)"), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_overdue_extreme = sum(str_detect(overdue_status_simple, "Overdue \\(Extreme\\)"), na.rm = TRUE),
      n_total_overdue = n_overdue_mild + n_overdue_extreme
    )
  
  # Count unsent packages
  n_unsent <- sum(packages_df$is_unsent, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Enhanced caption
  plot_caption <- str_glue(
    "Statistical Thresholds: Median {round(return_time_stats$median_days, 1)} days | ",
    "75th %ile: {round(return_time_stats$q75, 1)} days | ",
    "Mild Outlier: >{round(tukey_mild_threshold, 1)} days (Tukey's Q3+1.5*IQR) | ",
    "Extreme Outlier: >{round(tukey_extreme_threshold, 1)} days (Q3+3*IQR)\n",
    "Packages: {n_unsent} unsent (barcode generated) | ",
    "{overdue_summary$total_unreturned_sent} unreturned sent packages, of which ",
    "{overdue_summary$n_total_overdue} are outliers ",
    "({overdue_summary$n_overdue_mild} mild, {overdue_summary$n_overdue_extreme} extreme)"
  )
  
  # Create the plot
  overdue_plot <- packages_df %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = shipment_sent_date,
      y = shipment_received_date_adjusted,
      color = overdue_status_simple
    )) +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = num_pkgs,
        shape = is_redo,
        alpha = overdue_status_simple
      ),
      stroke = 0.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ Cycle,
      ncol = 3,
      scales = "free"
    ) +
    # Reference lines for statistical thresholds with labels
    # Median line
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$median_days,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    # 75th percentile line
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = return_time_stats$q75,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "darkgreen"
    ) +
    # Mild outlier threshold
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = tukey_mild_threshold,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "orange"
    ) +
    # Extreme outlier threshold
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1,
      intercept = tukey_extreme_threshold,
      linetype = "dashed",
      alpha = 0.6,
      color = "red"
    ) +
    # Add text labels for the threshold lines
    # These annotations will appear once per facet
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      label = paste0("Median (", round(return_time_stats$median_days), " days)"),
      hjust = 1.3,
      vjust = -5.5,
      color = "black",
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      label = paste0("75th %ile (", round(return_time_stats$q75), " days)"),
      hjust = 1.3,
      vjust = -4,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      label = paste0("Mild outlier (>", round(tukey_mild_threshold), " days)"),
      hjust = 1.3,
      vjust = -2.5,
      color = "orange",
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      x = as_date(Inf),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      label = paste0("Extreme outlier (>", round(tukey_extreme_threshold), " days)"),
      hjust = 1.3,
      vjust = -1,
      color = "red",
      size = 2.5,
      fontface = "italic"
    ) +
    # Today's date indicators
    geom_hline(yintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = today(), color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7) +
    # Today's date annotations
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      x = as_date(-Inf),
      y = today(),
      hjust = -0.2,
      vjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    annotate(
      geom = "text",
      label = str_glue("Today: {plot_stamp(today())}"),
      y = as_date(-Inf),
      x = today(),
      angle = 90,
      vjust = -0.2,
      hjust = -0.5,
      color = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    # Color scale with "Unsent" included
    scale_color_manual(
      values = overdue_colors,
      name = "Return Status",
      breaks = c("Returned", "Unsent", "Normal", "Getting Late", 
                 "Overdue (Mild)", "Overdue (Extreme)")
    ) +
    # Alpha scale with "Unsent" included
    scale_alpha_manual(
      values = c(
        "Returned" = 0.5,
        "Unsent" = 0.5,
        "Normal" = 0.6,
        "Getting Late" = 0.65,
        "Overdue (Mild)" = 0.65,
        "Overdue (Extreme)" = 0.7,
        "Unknown" = 0.5
      ),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    # Shape scale
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = 16, "TRUE" = 1),
      name = "Shipment Type",
      labels = c("FALSE" = "Regular", "TRUE" = "Re-do")
    ) +
    # Size scale
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "Number of Packages",
      breaks = c(10, 30, 50),
      range = c(1, 6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = str_glue("VIGOR Shipment Return Status: {plot_stamp(date_shipped_start)} to {plot_stamp(date_shipped_end)}"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Shipping Date",
      y = "Return Date / Days Since Shipment (for unreturned)",
      caption = plot_caption
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8),
      plot.caption.position = "panel",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3),
        order = 1,
        ncol = 2
      ),
      shape = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3),
        order = 2
      ),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3)
    )
  
  # Table of shipments needing follow-up (excluding unsent)
  overdue_for_followup <- packages_df %>%
    filter(
      returned == FALSE,
      is_unsent == FALSE,  # Exclude unsent packages
      days_since_shipment > tukey_mild_threshold
    ) %>%
    select(
      patient_id,
      shipment_id,
      shipment_batch,
      shipment_cycle,
      shipment_sent_date,
      days_since_shipment,
      percentile_position,
      modified_z_score,
      overdue_status_simple,
      overdue_status
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(days_since_shipment))
  
  # Store thresholds for reference
  thresholds <- list(
    median = return_time_stats$median_days,
    q75 = return_time_stats$q75,
    tukey_mild = tukey_mild_threshold,
    tukey_extreme = tukey_extreme_threshold,
    mad = return_time_stats$mad_days
  )
  
  # Print informative message
  cat("\n========== FUNCTION RETURNS ==========\n")
  cat("This function returns a list with the following components:\n")
  cat("  $plot                      - Main visualization of shipment return status\n")
  cat("  $kit_summary               - Summary statistics by cycle\n")
  cat("  $packages                  - Full dataset with classifications\n")
  cat("  $packages_returned         - DF of just returned packages with their percentile metrics\n")
  cat("  $return_time_stats         - Overall return time statistics\n")
  cat("  $return_time_stats_by_cycle - Return statistics broken down by cycle\n")
  cat("  $overdue_summary           - Count of unreturned shipments by status\n")
  cat("  $overdue_for_followup      - Table of statistical outliers needing attention\n")
  cat("  $thresholds                - Statistical thresholds used for classification\n")
  cat("\nAccess components using: result$plot, result$overdue_for_followup, etc.\n")
  cat("======================================\n\n")
  
  return(list(
    plot = overdue_plot,
    kit_summary = kit_summary,
    packages = packages_df,
    packages_returned = all_returned_shipments,
    return_time_stats = return_time_stats,
    return_time_stats_by_cycle = return_time_stats_by_cycle,
    overdue_summary = overdue_summary,
    overdue_by_cycle = overdue_by_cycle,
    overdue_for_followup = overdue_for_followup,
    thresholds = thresholds
  ))
}

result <- shipments_overdue_analysis_v2()
```

### plotly



```{r eval=FALSE}
shipments_overdue_analysis_plotly <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), 
                                              date_shipped_end = today()) {
  
  # Run the main function to get all data
  result <- shipments_overdue_analysis_v2(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)
  
  # Extract necessary components
  packages_df <- result$packages
  thresholds <- result$thresholds
  
  # Create plotly version
  library(plotly)
  
  # Define stamp for dates
  plot_stamp <- lubridate::stamp("Jan 1, 2025", quiet = TRUE)
  
  # Create separate plots for each cycle (plotly handles facets differently)
  cycles <- unique(packages_df$Cycle)
  plot_list <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(cycles)) {
    cycle_data <- packages_df %>% filter(Cycle == cycles[i])
    
    # Calculate date ranges for this cycle
    min_date <- min(cycle_data$shipment_sent_date, na.rm = TRUE)
    max_date <- max(cycle_data$shipment_sent_date, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Calculate end points for diagonal lines using numeric addition
    median_end_x <- max_date + thresholds$median
    median_end_y <- max_date + thresholds$median
    
    q75_end_x <- max_date + thresholds$q75
    q75_end_y <- max_date + thresholds$q75
    
    mild_end_x <- max_date + thresholds$tukey_mild
    mild_end_y <- max_date + thresholds$tukey_mild
    
    extreme_end_x <- max_date + thresholds$tukey_extreme
    extreme_end_y <- max_date + thresholds$tukey_extreme
    
    p <- plot_ly(cycle_data) %>%
      add_trace(
        x = ~shipment_sent_date,
        y = ~shipment_received_date_adjusted,
        color = ~overdue_status_simple,
        colors = c(
          "Returned" = "#94C4F5",
          "Unsent" = "#C494F5",
          "Normal" = "#2E8B57",
          "Getting Late" = "#FFD700",
          "Overdue (Mild)" = "#FF8C00",
          "Overdue (Extreme)" = "#DC143C"
        ),
        type = 'scatter',
        mode = 'markers',
        marker = list(
          size = ~sqrt(num_pkgs) * 5,  # Adjust size scaling for plotly
          opacity = ~case_when(
            overdue_status_simple == "Returned" ~ 0.5,
            overdue_status_simple == "Unsent" ~ 0.5,
            overdue_status_simple == "Normal" ~ 0.6,
            overdue_status_simple == "Getting Late" ~ 0.65,
            overdue_status_simple == "Overdue (Mild)" ~ 0.65,
            overdue_status_simple == "Overdue (Extreme)" ~ 0.7,
            TRUE ~ 0.5
          ),
          line = list(width = 0.5)
        ),
        text = ~paste(
          "Patient:", patient_id,
          "<br>Shipment:", shipment_id,
          "<br>Status:", overdue_status,
          "<br>Sent:", format(shipment_sent_date, "%b %d, %Y"),
          "<br>Days since sent:", ifelse(is.na(days_since_shipment), "N/A", round(days_since_shipment)),
          "<br>Packages:", num_pkgs
        ),
        hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
        showlegend = (i == 1)  # Only show legend for first plot
      ) %>%
      # Add threshold lines - using numeric date calculations
      # Median line
      add_segments(
        x = min_date,
        xend = median_end_x,
        y = min_date + thresholds$median,
        yend = median_end_y + thresholds$median,
        line = list(color = "black", dash = "dash", width = 1),
        opacity = 0.6,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        text = paste0("Median: ", round(thresholds$median), " days"),
        name = "Median"
      ) %>%
      # 75th percentile line
      add_segments(
        x = min_date,
        xend = q75_end_x,
        y = min_date + thresholds$q75,
        yend = q75_end_y + thresholds$q75,
        line = list(color = "darkgreen", dash = "dash", width = 1),
        opacity = 0.6,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        text = paste0("75th percentile: ", round(thresholds$q75), " days"),
        name = "75th %ile"
      ) %>%
      # Mild outlier line
      add_segments(
        x = min_date,
        xend = mild_end_x,
        y = min_date + thresholds$tukey_mild,
        yend = mild_end_y + thresholds$tukey_mild,
        line = list(color = "orange", dash = "dash", width = 1),
        opacity = 0.6,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        text = paste0("Mild outlier: >", round(thresholds$tukey_mild), " days"),
        name = "Mild outlier"
      ) %>%
      # Extreme outlier line
      add_segments(
        x = min_date,
        xend = extreme_end_x,
        y = min_date + thresholds$tukey_extreme,
        yend = extreme_end_y + thresholds$tukey_extreme,
        line = list(color = "red", dash = "dash", width = 1),
        opacity = 0.6,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        text = paste0("Extreme outlier: >", round(thresholds$tukey_extreme), " days"),
        name = "Extreme outlier"
      ) %>%
      # Add today's date lines
      add_segments(
        x = today(),
        xend = today(),
        y = min(cycle_data$shipment_received_date_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
        yend = max(cycle_data$shipment_received_date_adjusted, na.rm = TRUE),
        line = list(color = "darkgreen", width = 1.5),
        opacity = 0.7,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        text = paste0("Today: ", plot_stamp(today())),
        name = "Today"
      ) %>%
      add_segments(
        x = min_date,
        xend = max_date,
        y = today(),
        yend = today(),
        line = list(color = "darkgreen", width = 1.5),
        opacity = 0.7,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "text",
        text = paste0("Today: ", plot_stamp(today())),
        name = "Today"
      ) %>%
      layout(
        xaxis = list(
          title = ifelse(i == 2, "Shipping Date", ""),
          type = "date"
        ),
        yaxis = list(
          title = ifelse(i == 1, "Return Date / Days Since Shipment", ""),
          type = "date"
        ),
        annotations = list(
          list(
            text = cycles[i],
            xref = "paper",
            yref = "paper",
            x = 0.5,
            y = 1.05,
            xanchor = "center",
            yanchor = "bottom",
            showarrow = FALSE,
            font = list(size = 14, color = "black", family = "bold")
          )
        )
      )
    
    plot_list[[i]] <- p
  }
  
  # Get subtitle from main function
  subtitle_text <- result$kit_summary %>%
    dplyr::mutate(percent_returned = round(returned / sent * 100, 1)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cycle_summary = str_glue(
        "Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {returned} returned / {sent} kits sent ({percent_returned}%)"
      )
    ) %>%
    pull(cycle_summary) %>%
    paste(collapse = " | ")
  
  overdue_text <- result$overdue_by_cycle %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      cycle_overdue = str_glue("Cycle {shipment_cycle}: {n_overdue} overdue ({pct_overdue}%)")
    ) %>%
    pull(cycle_overdue) %>%
    paste(collapse = " | ")
  
  # Combine plots
  combined_plot <- subplot(
    plot_list,
    nrows = 1,
    shareY = FALSE,
    shareX = FALSE,
    titleX = TRUE,
    titleY = TRUE,
    margin = 0.05
  ) %>%
    layout(
      title = list(
        text = paste0(
          "<b>VIGOR Shipment Return Status: ",
          plot_stamp(date_shipped_start), " to ", plot_stamp(date_shipped_end),
          "</b><br>",
          "<sup>", subtitle_text, "<br>",
          "Overdue (outliers): ", overdue_text, "<br>",
          "Hover over points for details. Diagonal lines show return time thresholds.</sup>"
        ),
        font = list(size = 14),
        x = 0.5,
        xanchor = "center"
      ),
      showlegend = TRUE,
      legend = list(
        orientation = "h",
        x = 0.5,
        xanchor = "center",
        y = -0.15,
        font = list(size = 10)
      ),
      margin = list(t = 120, b = 80),
      hovermode = "closest"
    )
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# Alternative simpler version if the above still has issues
shipments_overdue_analysis_plotly_simple <- function(date_shipped_start = ymd("2024-6-27"), 
                                                     date_shipped_end = today()) {
  
  # Run the main function to get all data
  result <- shipments_overdue_analysis(date_shipped_start, date_shipped_end)
  
  # Convert the ggplot to plotly directly
  library(plotly)
  
  # This is a simpler approach - directly convert the ggplot
  plotly_plot <- ggplotly(result$plot, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(
      legend = list(
        orientation = "h",
        x = 0.5,
        xanchor = "center",
        y = -0.2
      ),
      margin = list(b = 150)
    )
  
  # Add custom hover text
  for (i in 1:length(plotly_plot$x$data)) {
    if (!is.null(plotly_plot$x$data[[i]]$mode) && plotly_plot$x$data[[i]]$mode == "markers") {
      # This is a point trace
      plotly_plot$x$data[[i]]$text <- with(result$packages, 
        paste("Patient:", patient_id,
              "<br>Status:", overdue_status_simple,
              "<br>Days since sent:", round(days_since_shipment, 1))
      )
    }
  }
  
  return(plotly_plot)
}
```

## Late Address Confirmation

How many people are eligible for next shipment but haven't confirmed their address yet?

Criteria to confirm address for next shipment:

1. 6 months after first shipment date (per Foundry)
2. `Active_KitStatus` is 1
3. `StudyEndReason` is empty


```{r}
patients_clean %>% 
  filter(str_detect(shipment_group, "B")) %>%
  filter(active_kitstatus == 7)


shipments_clean_max_batch %>%
  arrange(patient_id) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = T) %>%
  arrange(shipment_id) %>%
  filter(shipment_cycle == 1)


late_addys_reg_package_contact <- shipments_clean_max_batch %>%
  # join on clean patient data to get active kit status and studyendreason fields
  left_join(
    y = patients_clean %>% select(patient_id, active_kitstatus, studyendreason),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  # filter for participants whose package has returned and they have NOT withdrawn
  filter(
    active_kitstatus == 1,
    studyendreason %in% c("", NA),
    shipment_status != "Barcode Generated"
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_cycle, shipment_group, shipment_status, shipment_sent_date, shipment_received_date, active_kitstatus, studyendreason)


late_addys_reg_package_contact_clean <- late_addys_reg_package_contact %>% 
  select(
    patient_id, shipment_group:shipment_received_date,
    -shipment_status
  )


# list of pts who haven't confirmed address for their FIRST package yet
patients_clean %>%
  filter(active_kitstatus == 1) %>%
  anti_join(y = shipments_clean_max_batch,
            by = "patient_id")
```

## Calendar

Create a calendar visualizing the number of shipments sent each day, colored by the number

```{r}
# DF that stores each pt's first shipment date and the expected 2nd shipment 6mos later
first_shipment_date_cycles <- shipments_clean_max_batch %>%
  select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_sent_date, shipment_cycle, shipment_batch) %>%
  filter(shipment_cycle == 1) %>%
  transmute(
    patient_id = patient_id,
    date_sent_1 = shipment_sent_date,
    # date_sent_2 = as_date(date_sent_1 + dmonths(6))
    date_sent_2 = date_sent_1 + months(6)
  ) %>%
  # resolve NAs in date_sent_2
  mutate(date_sent_2 = case_when(is.na(date_sent_2) ~ as_date(date_sent_1 + dmonths(6)),
                                 .default = date_sent_2)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(date_sent_1:date_sent_2),
    names_to = "shipment",
    values_to = "date_sent",
    names_transform = list(shipment = ~ recode(.x,
                                               "date_sent_1" = "shipment_1",
                                               "date_sent_2" = "shipment_2"))
  )
```


```{r}
# init. target year for calendar
calendar_year <- year(today())

shipment_calendar <- first_shipment_date_cycles %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(date_sent),
    day = day(date_sent)
  ) %>%
  count(month, day) %>%
  arrange(month, day) %>%
  # map to the chosen display year (current year by default)
  mutate(date = as_date(ymd(str_c(calendar_year, month, day, sep = "-"))))

# create a COMPLETE vector for all days of the year
all_days <- seq.Date(
  from = as_date(str_c(calendar_year, "01", "01", sep = "-")),
  to = as_date(str_c(calendar_year, "12", "31", sep = "-")),
  by = "day"
)

# create a named vector for calendR library
# shipment_counts <- set_names(shipment_calendar$n, as.character(shipment_calendar$date))
shipment_counts <- set_names(rep(0, length(all_days)), as.character(all_days))

# fill in actual shipment counts
for (i in 1:nrow(shipment_calendar)) {
  date_key <- as.character(shipment_calendar$date[i])
  if (date_key %in% names(shipment_counts)) {
    shipment_counts[date_key] <- shipment_calendar$n[i]
  }
}

# plot yearly calendar for the chosen year (defaults to current year)
calendR::calendR(
  year = calendar_year,
  special.days = shipment_counts,
  gradient = TRUE,
  # low.col = "#FFFFED",
  # low.col = "dodgerblue",
  low.col = "gray85",
  special.col = "brown1",
  # special.col = "#FF0000",
  legend.pos = "bottom",
  legend.title = "Number of Shipments",
  title = "VIGOR Yearly Shipment Schedule",
  subtitle = "Estimated based on First Shipments Sent"
)
```





## Returned kits


### Compliance/Success

```{r}
devices_shipped <- shipments_plot_df %>%
  transmute(
    shipment_id = shipment_id,
    # indicate kits that were shipped and have returned
    shipped = case_when(
      str_detect(shipment_status_simp, "Barcode Generated") ~ F,
      .default = T
    ),
    returned = case_when(
      !shipped ~ NA,
      shipment_status %in% c("Devices Stored", "Shipment Received") ~ T,
      shipment_status == "Barcode Generated" ~ F
    ),
    # kits sent with specific device
    sent_with_tasso = if_else(shipment_id %in% blood_clean$shipment_id, T, F),
    sent_with_saliva = if_else(shipment_id %in% saliva_clean$shipment_id, T, F),
    sent_with_tape_strips = if_else(shipment_id %in% tape_strips_clean$shipment_id, T, F),
    # kits returned with specific device
    returned_tasso = case_when(str_detect(blood_received, "^Sample collected") | serum_stored == "Yes" ~ T,
                               !sent_with_tasso | !shipped ~ NA,
                               .default = F),
    returned_saliva = case_when(str_detect(spit_tube_received, "^Sample collected") | spit_tube_stored == "Yes" ~ T, 
                                !sent_with_saliva | !shipped ~ NA,
                                .default = F),
    returned_tape_strips = case_when(str_detect(tape_strips_received, "^Sample collected") | tape_strips_stored == "Yes" ~ T, 
                                     !sent_with_tape_strips | !shipped ~ NA,
                                     .default = F)
  )

devices_shipped
```


```{r}
devices_shipped_v2 <- devices_shipped %>%
  mutate(
    devices_sent = str_c(
      case_when(sent_with_tasso ~ "tasso", !sent_with_tasso | is.na(sent_with_tasso) ~ ""),
      case_when(sent_with_saliva ~ "saliva", !sent_with_saliva | is.na(sent_with_saliva) ~ ""),
      case_when(sent_with_tape_strips ~ "tape_strips", !sent_with_tape_strips | is.na(sent_with_tape_strips) ~ ""),
      sep = ", "
    ) %>% str_remove_all("^, |, $|, ,") %>% str_remove_all("^, |, $") %>% str_replace_all("(?<=\\w) (?=\\w)", ", ") %>% str_trim(),
    devices_returned = str_c(
      case_when(returned_tasso ~ "tasso", !returned_tasso | is.na(returned_tasso) ~ ""),
      case_when(returned_saliva ~ "saliva", !returned_saliva | is.na(returned_saliva) ~ ""),
      case_when(returned_tape_strips ~ "tape_strips", !returned_tape_strips | is.na(returned_tape_strips) ~ ""),
      sep = ", "
    ) %>% str_remove_all("^, |, $|, ,") %>% str_remove_all("^, |, $") %>% str_replace_all("(?<=\\w) (?=\\w)", ", ") %>% str_trim()
  ) %>%
  relocate(devices_sent, .before = "sent_with_tasso") %>%
  relocate(devices_returned, .before = "returned_tasso") %>%
  # if no devices are sent back
  mutate(devices_returned = if_else(devices_returned == "", NA, devices_returned))

devices_shipped_v2
```





#### Tasso

```{r tasso_compliance}
# what is the compliance and success rate of Tasso and saliva collection?
tasso_compliance <- kits_received %>%
  # keep shipments that included a tasso device
  semi_join(y = blood_clean,
            by = "shipment_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # tasso_compliance = if_else(str_detect(blood_received, "^Sample collected") |
    #                              serum_stored == "Yes",
    #                            T,
    #                            F),
    tasso_compliance = case_when(str_detect(blood_received, "^Sample collected") | serum_stored == "Yes" ~ T,
                                 .default = F),
    # tasso_success = if_else(serum_stored == "Yes", T, F),
    tasso_success = case_when(serum_stored == "Yes" ~ T,
                              .default = F),
    # tasso_ideal = if_else(blood_received == "Sample collected; no concerns" & serum_stored == "Yes",
    #                         T,
    #                         F)
    tasso_ideal = case_when(str_detect(blood_received, "Sample collected; no concerns") & serum_stored == "Yes" ~ T,
                            .default = F)
  ) 


tasso_compliance_summary <- devices_shipped_v2 %>%
  left_join(y = tasso_compliance, by = "shipment_id") %>%
  mutate(
    tasso_compliance = returned_tasso,
    tasso_success = if_else(!tasso_compliance, F, tasso_success),
    tasso_ideal = if_else(!tasso_compliance, F, tasso_ideal)
  ) %>%
  summarize(
    sample = "tasso",
    devices_sent = sum(sent_with_tasso),
    devices_unsent = sum(!shipped & sent_with_tasso, na.rm = T),
    kits_returned = sum(returned & sent_with_tasso, na.rm = T),
    devices_returned = sum(returned_tasso, na.rm = T),
    # devices_unreturned = devices_sent - devices_returned,
    devices_compliant = sum(tasso_compliance, na.rm = T),
    devices_success = sum(tasso_success, na.rm = T),
    devices_ideal = sum(tasso_ideal, na.rm = T),
    prop_compliant = devices_compliant / kits_returned,
    prop_success = devices_success / kits_returned,
    prop_ideal = devices_ideal / kits_returned
  )
```

```{r tape_strip_compliance}
# compliance/success of tape strips?
tape_strips_received <- kits_received %>%
  # only keep shipments where tape strips were included
  semi_join(y = tape_strips_clean,
            by = "shipment_id") %>%
  select(
    patient_id:shipment_group, 
    str_subset(colnames(.), "tape_strip"), 
    shipment_received_comments,
    -shipment_last_updated
  )


tape_strips_compliance <- tape_strips_received %>%
  mutate(tape_strips_location = str_replace(tape_strips_location, " +- +", "-")) %>%
  # filter(str_detect(tape_strips_location, "\\w+-\\w+", negate = T)) %>%
  # select(shipment_id, tape_strips_location, shipment_received_comments) %>%
  # view()
  transmute(
    shipment_id = shipment_id,
    received = tape_strips_received,
    location = tape_strips_location,
    tape_strips_compliance = if_else(str_detect(tape_strips_received, "^Sample collected") | tape_strips_stored == "Yes", T, F),
    tape_strips_success = if_else(tape_strips_stored == "Yes", T, F),
    tape_strips_ideal = case_when(
      # ideal if sample collected and no concerns + location is <bodypart>-<side> + no "tape strip" comments
      tape_strips_received == "Sample collected; no concerns" &
        str_detect(tape_strips_location, "\\w+-\\w+") &
        str_detect(
          str_to_lower(shipment_received_comments),
          "tape strip",
          negate = T
        ) ~ T,
      # ideal if sample collected/no concerns + location is viable + no "tape strip" comments
      tape_strips_received == "Sample collected; no concerns" &
        str_detect(
          str_to_lower(tape_strips_location),
          "not designated|multiple|na",
          negate = T
        ) & !tape_strips_location %in% "" &
        str_detect(
          str_to_lower(shipment_received_comments),
          "tape strip",
          negate = T
        ) ~ T,
      # else: no success
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )



tape_strips_compliance_summary <- devices_shipped_v2 %>%

    devices_ideal = sum(tape_strips_ideal, na.rm = T),
    prop_compliant = devices_compliant / kits_returned,
```

```{r}
    num_unreturned_tasso = num_sent_tasso - num_returned_tasso,
    num_sent_saliva = sum(sent_with_saliva, na.rm = T),
    num_returned_saliva = sum(returned_saliva, na.rm = T),
    num_unreturned_saliva = num_sent_saliva - num_returned_saliva,
    num_sent_tape_strips = sum(sent_with_tape_strips, na.rm = T),
    num_returned_tape_strips = sum(returned_tape_strips, na.rm = T),
    num_unreturned_tape_strips = num_sent_tape_strips - num_returned_tape_strips,
    .by = shipment_sent_date
  ) %>%
  select(-str_subset(colnames(.), "num_sent_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = num_returned_tasso:ncol(.),
    names_to = "device",
    names_prefix = "num_",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(device = str_replace(device, "tape_strips", "tape")) %>%
  separate(
    col = "device",
    into = c("status", "device"),
    sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(device = if_else(device == "tape", "tape_strips", device)) %>%
  mutate(count = na_if(count, 0))



devices_shipped_counts_df %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  # mutate(status = if_else(is.na(count), NA, status)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = factor(shipment_sent_date),
    y = count,
    fill = status
  )) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    .~device,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Counts of VIGOR returned/unreturned devices per shipment date",
    x = "date",
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0.9, vjust = 0.8),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("returned" = "chartreuse3",
                               "unreturned" = "brown1"))
```

```{r}
### TEST ###

# identify whether a pt who needs first package already belongs to a shipment group. if so, retain that group
needs_first_package_list <- mdh_needs_first_package %>%
  inner_join(
    y = patients_clean %>% select(patient_id, shipment_group),
    by = c("ParticipantIdentifier" = "patient_id")
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    ParticipantIdentifier = ParticipantIdentifier,
    shipment_group = if_else(is.na(shipment_group), new_ship_group, shipment_group),
    shipment_batch = 1,
    shipment_cycle = 1,
    # need_tasso = T,
    # exclude Tasso if a pt opts out
    need_tasso = case_when(BloodOptOut == 1 ~ F, 
                           BloodOptOut %in% c(0, NA) ~ T),
    need_saliva = T,
    need_tapestrip = F
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    y = shipments_clean_max_batch %>% select(patient_id, shipment_batch),
    by = c("ParticipantIdentifier" = "patient_id"),
    suffix = c("", "_fdry")
  ) %>%
  # update shipment_batch for 're-do' kits
  mutate(shipment_batch = if_else(is.na(shipment_batch_fdry), shipment_batch, shipment_batch_fdry + 1)) %>%
  select(-str_subset(colnames(.), "_fdry")) %>%
  # produce the shipment ID for this next package
  mutate(new_shipment_id = str_c(ParticipantIdentifier, shipment_batch, sep = "-")) %>%
  relocate(new_shipment_id, .after = 1)
```

```{r}
  left_join(

    by = "patient_id",

  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = T)

# DF of pts with outstanding saliva errors

  anti_join(saliva_error_later_stored, "patient_id")
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
    need_saliva = case_when(
      # if most recent tube has a genetic concern that needs resequencing
      gencove_qc_contamination == "TRUE" | genetic_sex_error == "TRUE" ~ TRUE,
      # if most recent tube did not return (wasn't processed into FPro)
      fpro_box_id %in% c(NA, "") ~ TRUE,
      # else False
      .default = FALSE
    )
  )
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# DF of participants needing a regular package
needs_reg_package_list <- shipments_pt_join %>%
  # only retain every pt's most recent shipment record
  semi_join(shipments_clean_max_batch, "shipment_id") %>%
  semi_join(
    y = mdh_needs_reg_package,
    by = c("patient_id" = "ParticipantIdentifier")
  ) %>%
  # only retain most recent shipment
  arrange(patient_id) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = T) %>%
  # update shipment batch and cycle
  mutate(
    across(.cols = c(shipment_batch, shipment_cycle),
           .fns = ~.x + 1)
  ) %>%
  # update the shipment group
  mutate(shipment_group = str_replace(shipment_group, "[:upper:]$", LETTERS[shipment_cycle])) %>%
  # produce the shipment ID for this next package
  mutate(new_shipment_id = str_c(patient_id, shipment_batch, sep = "-")) %>%
  # cols to indicate which devices are needed
  mutate(
    need_tasso = !blood_opt_out,
    # need_saliva = case_when(patient_id %in% saliva_resample_pts & shipment_batch %in% c(2, 3) ~ T,
    #                         .default = F),
    need_saliva = case_when(shipment_id %in% needs_reg_package_contaminated$shipment_id ~ T,
                            patient_id %in% saliva_resample_pts & shipment_batch %in% c(2, 3) ~ T,
                            .default = F),
    need_tapestrip = T
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, new_shipment_id, shipment_group, shipment_batch, shipment_cycle, need_tasso, need_saliva, need_tapestrip)
```
