```{r}
# DF of participants needing a regular package (need_saliva updated)
needs_reg_package_list <- shipments_pt_join %>%
  # only retain every pt's most recent shipment record per cycle
  semi_join(shipments_clean_max_batch, "shipment_id") %>%
  semi_join(
    y = mdh_needs_reg_package,
    by = c("patient_id" = "ParticipantIdentifier")
  ) %>%
  # only retain most recent shipment
  arrange(patient_id, desc(shipment_id)) %>%
  # select(patient_id, shipment_id, shipment_sent_date) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  # retain relevant cols
  transmute(
    patient_id = patient_id,
    recent_shipment_id = shipment_id,
    # new_shipment_id = str_c(patient_id, shipment_batch + 1, sep = "-"),
    new_shipment_batch = shipment_batch + 1,
    # keep the same shipment cycle if the last shipment never returned (it's assumed this new shipment is a re-do in the same cycle)
    new_shipment_cycle = case_when(shipment_status %in% c("Devices Stored", "Shipment Received") ~ shipment_cycle + 1,
                                   .default = shipment_cycle),
    new_shipment_group = str_replace(shipment_group, "[:upper:]$", LETTERS[new_shipment_cycle]),
    need_tasso = !blood_opt_out,
    need_saliva = patient_id %in% saliva_errors_outstanding$patient_id,
    need_tapestrip = T,
    new_shipment_id = str_c(patient_id, new_shipment_batch, sep = "-")
  ) %>%
  relocate(new_shipment_id, .after = recent_shipment_id)

print(needs_reg_package_list)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
### Export list of pt's needing new tubes into each group directory ###


# get unique groups
ship_groups <- needs_reg_package_list %>% pull(shipment_group) %>% unique()

# function to extract the group number
extract_group_number <- function(group_name) {
  str_extract(group_name, "\\d+")
}

# loop through each group
for (group in ship_groups) {
  # subset the data for the current group
  group_data <- needs_reg_package_list %>%
    filter(shipment_group == group)
  
  # extract the group number + letter
  group_number <- extract_group_number(group)
  group_letter <- str_extract(group, "[:upper:]$")
  
  # create the subdirectory path
  subdir <- str_c("group", group_number, "/", group_letter, "/")
  subdir_full_path <- str_c(export_path, subdir)
  
  # create the subdirectory if it doesn't already exist
  # if (!dir.exists(subdir_full_path)) {
  #   dir.create(subdir_full_path)
  # }
  dir.create(subdir_full_path)
  
  # create the file path
  file_path <- str_c(export_path, 
                     subdir,
                     str_c(export_filename, str_c("group", group_number, group_letter, sep = ""), update_date, sep = "_"),
                     ext)
  
  # export the subset to CSV
  write_csv(group_data, file_path)
  
}
```



## Update Shipment Date for Kits in Transit

This was created to handle all the shipments that were originally set to be shipped on July 31, 2025 (August 1, 2025 in Foundry) but are being assembled and dropped off in waves every week.

1. Wait for Clinical Team to notify that new packages were dropped off

2. Go to MDH Designer --> Participants tab

3. Filter for Segment 22 - Packaged in Transit to Participants

4. Sort by "Added to Segment" column in descending order

5. Export the CSV 

6. Read it below and continue with the code


### MDH Participants

This approach requires exporting the CSV from the MDH participants tab and manually counting who was added

```{r}
# import all pts from MDH segment 22 (package in transit)
path <- "~/U01_PROSPECTIVE_VITILIGO/data/mdh/exported_from_mdh/"
file_base <- "vigor_prod_package_in_transit_to_pts"
file_name <- str_subset(list.files(path), file_base)

in_transit <- read_csv(
  file = str_c(path, file_name),
  show_col_types = F
)


# specify the first N rows were shipped today and their dates need to be modified
n_shipped_today <- 42


# df of updated shipment dates for each new pt 
shipped_today <- in_transit %>%
  # subset new pts in transit
  slice_head(n = n_shipped_today) %>%
  # create cols that are in Foundry
  transmute(
    patient_id = ParticipantIdentifier,
    shipment_sent_date = as.character(1 + today()),
    outgoing_tracking_number = as.character(Active_TrackingNumber)
  )

# DF of updated shipments compliant with Foundry
shipped_today_export <- shipments_plot_df %>%
  # shipment_id column is required by Foundry when uploading data to the shipments table
  select(patient_id, id=shipment_id, outgoing_tracking_number) %>%
  # subset the new pts shipped to by their VIGOR ID and tracking number
  inner_join(y = shipped_today,
             by = c("patient_id", "outgoing_tracking_number")) %>%
  rename_with(.cols = everything(),
              .fn = ~str_c("shipments", .x, sep = "."))
```



```{r eval=FALSE}
# export to FOUNDRY

export_filename <- "vigor_prod_regular_packages_update_date_shipped"
ext <- ".csv"

# move existing file 
file_to_move <- str_subset(list.files(export_path), export_filename)
file.copy(
  from = str_c(export_path, file_to_move),
  to = str_c(export_path, "old_data/", file_to_move)
)
file.remove(from = str_c(export_path, file_to_move))

write_csv(
  x = shipped_today_export,
  file = str_c(
    export_path,
    str_c(export_filename, update_date, sep = "_"),
    ext
  )
)
```

```{r}
)

# expected values for certain columns --> mislabelled cols will not have these values
correct_vals_gender <- c("F", "M", "O", NA)
correct_vals_studyendreason <- c("Deceased",
                                 "InvoluntaryWithdrawal",
                                 "SoftDrop",
                                 "VoluntaryWithdawal",
                                 NA)




# function to detect whether a column is likely to be a 'Gender' column
is_column_correct <- function(x, correct_vals) {
  all(unique(na.omit(x)) %in% correct_vals)
}

# conditional relabeling based on column values
checked_imp <- mdh_export %>%
  mutate(
    StudyEndReason_is_correct = is_column_correct(.data$StudyEndReason, correct_vals_studyendreason),
    StudyEndReason_is_gender = is_column_correct(.data$StudyEndReason, correct_vals_gender)
  )

# if StudyEndReason has correct expected values
if (checked_imp$StudyEndReason_is_correct[1]) {
  # keep imported DF as-is
  mdh_export <- mdh_export
  message("Keep DF exported from MDH as-is.")
  print(mdh_export)
} else if (checked_imp$StudyEndReason_is_gender[1]) {
  # if StudyEndReason has values we'd expect for Gender col, read it in again with custom col order
  mdh_export <- read_csv(
    file = str_c(file_path, file_basename, sep = "/"),
    show_col_types = F,
    col_names = mdh_cols_custom_order
  ) %>%
    slice_tail(n = -1)
  message("Read in MDH DF with custom column order.")
  print(mdh_export)
} else {
  stop("MDH DF's columns are mislabelled and don't match the expected or custom column order we've defined. Requires manual re-labelling (`mdh_export`).")
}
```

```{r}
# function to detect whether a column is likely to be a 'Gender' column

  all(unique(na.omit(x)) %in% correct_vals)
}

# conditional relabeling based on column values
checked_imp <- mdh_export %>%
  mutate(
    StudyEndReason_is_correct = is_column_correct(.data$StudyEndReason, correct_vals_studyendreason),
    StudyEndReason_is_gender = is_column_correct(.data$StudyEndReason, correct_vals_gender)
  )

# if StudyEndReason has correct expected values
if (checked_imp$StudyEndReason_is_correct[1]) {
  # keep imported DF as-is
  mdh_export <- mdh_export %>% mutate(DateOfBirth = as_date(DateOfBirth))
  message("Keep DF exported from MDH as-is.")

} else if (checked_imp$StudyEndReason_is_gender[1]) {
  # if StudyEndReason has values we'd expect for Gender col, read it in again with custom col order
  mdh_export <- read_csv(
    file = str_c(file_path, file_basename, sep = "/"),
    show_col_types = F,
    col_names = mdh_cols_custom_order
  ) %>% 
    mutate(DateOfBirth = as_date(DateOfBirth)) %>%
    slice_tail(n = -1)
  message("Read in MDH DF with custom column order.")
  print(mdh_export)
} else {
  stop("MDH DF's columns are mislabelled and don't match the expected or custom column order we've defined. Requires manual re-labelling (`mdh_export`).")
}
```

## Age-Matched Controls

110 affected samples + 90 age-matched control samples

1. Bin Ages for Both Groups

Decide on age bins (e.g., 5-year intervals). This keeps things simple and ensure the age profile of the controls mirrors your cases.

```{r}

# find pooled age min/max for identical bins between groups
age_min <- min(c(min(eligible_aab_vit_v2$age), min(eligible_aab_ctrl$age)))
age_max <- max(c(max(eligible_aab_vit_v2$age), min(eligible_aab_ctrl$age)))


# create age bins
age_binwidth <- 1

age_breaks <- seq(floor(age_min), ceiling(age_max) + age_binwidth, by = age_binwidth)

affected <- eligible_aab_vit_v2 %>%
  mutate(
    # age_round = round(age),
    age_bin = cut(
      # age_round, 
      age,
      # breaks = seq(min(age_round), max(age_round), by = age_binwidth),
      breaks = age_breaks,
      include.lowest = T,
      right = F
    )
  )

controls <- eligible_aab_ctrl %>%
  mutate(
    # age_round = round(age),
    age_bin = cut(
      # age_round, 
      age,
      # breaks = seq(min(age_round), max(age_round), by = age_binwidth),
      breaks = age_breaks,
      include.lowest = T,
      right = F
    )
  )
```


```{r}
### 2. Calculate Number to Sample from Each Age Bin ###
# proportionally allocate 90 controls to bins based on the distribution in the affected group


# count how many subjects in each bin in the cases
bin_table <- affected %>%
  group_by(age_bin) %>%
  tally() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    n_controls = round(prop * 90)
  )

```


```{r}
### 3. Sample Controls by Age Bin ###
# now sample the right number of controls from each bin

set.seed(15)

# bin_table %>%
#   left_join(controls, by = "age_bin") %>%
#   group_by(age_bin) %>%
#   slice_sample(n = first(n_controls)) %>%
#   ungroup()

# # fixed version - sample by iterating through each bin
# map_dfr(1:nrow(bin_table), function(i) {
#   current_bin <- bin_table$age_bin[i]
#   n_needed <- bin_table$n_controls[i]
#   
#   controls %>%
#     filter(age_bin == current_bin) %>%
#     # use min() to handle cases where n_needed > available
#     slice_sample(n = min(n_needed, n())) %>%
#     mutate(target_n = n_needed, 
#            available_n = n())
# })
# 
# 
# controls %>%
#   group_by(age_bin) %>%
#   nest() %>%
#   left_join(
#     y = bin_table %>% select(age_bin, n_controls),
#     by = "age_bin"
#   ) %>%
#   mutate(
#     sampled = map2(data, n_controls, ~slice_sample(.x, n = min(nrow(.x), .y)))
#   ) %>%
#   unnest(sampled)



matched_controls <- tibble()

for (i in 1:nrow(bin_table)) {
  current_bin <- bin_table$age_bin[i]
  n_needed <- bin_table$n_controls[i]
  
  # get available controls in this bin
  available_controls <- controls %>% filter(age_bin == current_bin)
  
  # sample the needed number (or all available if fewer than needed)
  if (nrow(available_controls) > 0 && n_needed > 0) {
    sampled <- available_controls %>%
      slice_sample(n = min(n_needed, nrow(available_controls)))
    matched_controls <- rbind(matched_controls, sampled)
  }
}


# check your results
cat("Total controls selected:", nrow(matched_controls), "\n")
cat("Target was:", sum(bin_table$n_controls), "\n")

# Show the age distribution comparison
print("Age distribution comparison:")
print(bin_table %>% select(age_bin, n, n_controls))
```


### v2

```{r}
# for each VIT sample, find the closest age control and sample without replacement
set.seed(15)


# create a pool of available controls
available_controls <- eligible_aab_ctrl %>%
  mutate(control_id = row_number()) %>%
  arrange(age)


matched_controls <- tibble()


# for each affected sample, find closes age match
for (i in 1:nrow(eligible_aab_vit_v2)) {
  target_age <- eligible_aab_vit_v2$age[i]
  
  if (nrow(available_controls) > 0) {
    # find closest age match
    closest_match <- available_controls %>%
      mutate(age_diff = abs(age - target_age)) %>%
      slice_min(age_diff, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>%
      # break ties randomly
      slice_sample(n = 1)
    
    # add to matched controls
    matched_controls <- bind_rows(matched_controls, closest_match)
    
    # remove from available pool
    available_controls <- available_controls %>%
      filter(control_id != closest_match$control_id)
  }
}

cat("Matched controls:", nrow(matched_controls), "\n")
```

```{r}
# match ages between controls and vit
set.seed(15)

# create a pool of available controls
available_controls_new <- eligible_aab_ctrl_new %>%
  mutate(control_id = row_number()) %>%
  arrange(age)

matched_controls_new <- tibble()

# for each affected sample, find closest age match
for (i in 1:nrow(eligible_aab_vit_new_not_in_og)) {
  target_age <- eligible_aab_vit_new_not_in_og$age[i]
  
  if (nrow(available_controls_new) > 0) {
    # find closest age match
    closest_match <- available_controls_new %>%
      mutate(age_diff = abs(age - target_age)) %>%
      slice_min(age_diff, n = 1, with_ties = F) %>%
      # break ties randomly
      slice_sample(n = 1)
    
    # add to matched controls
    matched_controls_new <- bind_rows(matched_controls_new, closest_match)
    
    # remove from available pool
    available_controls_new <- available_controls_new %>%
      filter(control_id != closest_match$control_id)
  }
}

cat("Matched controls:", nrow(matched_controls_new), "\n")
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
survey_tasks_big <- survey_tasks_clean %>%
  left_join(
    y = patients_clean %>% select(patient_id, enroll_date),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  relocate(enroll_date, .after = 1) %>%
  arrange(enroll_date, patient_id, task_assigned_date) %>%
  # compute 'survey quarter' based on enroll date and date that task was assigned
  mutate(
    task_status = factor(task_status, levels = c("complete", "closed", "incomplete")),
    months_since_enroll = round(time_length(task_assigned_date - (enroll_date - days(1)), unit = "month")),
    survey_cycle = case_when(months_since_enroll == 0 ~ 0,
                             months_since_enroll > 0 ~ floor(months_since_enroll / 3))
  ) %>%
  relocate(months_since_enroll, survey_cycle, .after = survey_type) %>%
  arrange(enroll_date, patient_id, desc(task_assigned_date)) %>%
  distinct(patient_id, task_status, surveyname, survey_cycle, .keep_all = T) %>%
  filter(survey_type %in% c("BL", "QT")) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, task_assigned_date) %>%
  # join cols from `patients_all` to indicate participants who have been dropped; also include their ages
  left_join(
    y = patients_all %>% select(patient_id, age, studyendreason),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  # T/F field specifying whether pt is dropped or not
  mutate(dropped = case_when(studyendreason %in% c("", NA, NULL) ~ F,
                             .default = T)) %>%
  relocate(age, dropped, studyendreason, .after = patient_id)
```

```{r}
# prepare the data -- treat "closed" as "incomplete"
survey_tasks_analysis <- survey_tasks_big %>%
  mutate(
    task_completed = task_status == "complete",
    task_status_binary = if_else(task_status == "complete",
                                 "complete",
                                 "incomplete"),
    # extract month and day for seasonal analysis
    task_month = month(task_assigned_date, label = TRUE),
    task_day_of_year = yday(task_assigned_date),
    # create a normalized date for year overlay (map all to same year)
    task_date_normalized = make_date(year = 2024, month(task_assigned_date), day(task_assigned_date))
  ) %>%
  # filter out participants who withdrew
  filter(!dropped)


# prepare data: calculate completion counts per participant per cycle
cycle_completion_data <- survey_tasks_analysis %>%
  group_by(patient_id, survey_cycle) %>%
  summarize(
    tasks_in_cycle = n(),
    tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    completion_category = case_when(tasks_in_cycle == tasks_completed & tasks_in_cycle > 0 ~ "All",
                                    tasks_completed == 0 ~ "None",
                                    between(tasks_completed, 0, tasks_in_cycle) ~ "Some"),
    completion_category = factor(completion_category, levels = c("None", "Some", "All"))
  )
```



```{r}
# function to process and plot survey tasks alluvial data + generate plot
process_survey_tasks_alluvial <- function(participant_df = NULL, flow_prop_min = 0) {
  # save OG cycle completion data
  cycle_completion_data_og <- cycle_completion_data
  
  # if participant_df is NOT NULL, filter for the participants of interest
  if (!is.null(participant_df)) {
    # 1 unique pt per row
    participant_df <- participant_df %>% distinct(patient_id)
    
    # filter for pts of interest
    cycle_completion_data <- cycle_completion_data_og %>%
      semi_join(y = participant_df, by = "patient_id")
  }
  
  flow_df <- cycle_completion_data %>%
    select(patient_id, survey_cycle, completion_category) %>%
    # create a complete grid to handle "Not Reached" status
    {
      all_participants <- unique(.$patient_id)
      all_cycles <- sort(unique(.$survey_cycle))
      
      complete_grid <- expand_grid(patient_id = all_participants,
                                   survey_cycle = all_cycles)
      
      complete_grid %>%
        left_join(
          .,
          y = cycle_completion_data %>% select(patient_id, survey_cycle, completion_category),
          by = c("patient_id", "survey_cycle")
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          completion_category = ifelse(
            is.na(completion_category),
            "Not Reached",
            as.character(completion_category)
          ),
          completion_category = factor(
            completion_category,
            levels = c("None", "Some", "All", "Not Reached")
          )
        )
    } %>%
    # convert to wide format for counting combinations
    pivot_wider(
      id_cols = patient_id,
      names_from = survey_cycle,
      names_prefix = "cycle_",
      values_from = completion_category,
      values_fill = "Not Reached"
    ) 
  
  
  # count each unique combination
  flow_counts <- flow_df %>%
    count(across(starts_with("cycle_")))
  
  
  # get cycle column names for dynamic plotting
  survey_flow_cols <- names(flow_df)[str_detect(names(flow_df), "^cycle_")]
  n_survey_cycles <- length(survey_flow_cols)
  
  # create dynamic aesthetic mapping
  aes_mapping_surv <- list(y = quote(n))
  for (i in seq_along(survey_flow_cols)) {
    aes_mapping_surv[[paste0("axis", i)]] <- as.symbol(survey_flow_cols[i])
  }
  
  
  ###### Plots #######
  
  # init. empty object to store plots
  plots <- list()
  
  
  
  ### Plot 1: Alluvial of Participants of Interest ###
  
  
  # define the minimum number of participants needed in a survey flow (keep it at 15 if it exceeds 15)
  flow_count_min <- case_when(ceiling(nrow(flow_df) * flow_prop_min) > 15 ~ 15,
              .default = ceiling(nrow(flow_df) * flow_prop_min))
  
  # create the y labels for the alluvial plot
  flow_y_labels <- flow_counts %>%
    # filter out "Not Reached" in cycle 0 and flows with fewer than the minimum number
    filter(
      cycle_0 != "Not Reached",
      n >= flow_count_min
    ) %>%
    arrange(across(.cols = starts_with("cycle_"),
                   .fns = desc)) %>%
    mutate(
      half_n = n/2,
      y_left_upper = cumsum(n),
      y_left_center = y_left_upper - half_n
    )
  
  
  # init. plot subtitle
  alluvial_subtitle <- str_glue("Only flows with {flow_count_min}+ participants are shown\n(omits participants who were withdrawn)")
  
  
  # create alluvial plot
  survey_alluvial_plot <- flow_counts %>%
    filter(n >= flow_count_min) %>%
    filter(cycle_0 != "Not Reached") %>%
    ggplot(do.call(aes, aes_mapping_surv)) +
    # use the last cycle for fill color
    geom_alluvium(
      aes(fill = !!as.symbol(survey_flow_cols[length(survey_flow_cols)])),
      width = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.75,
      curve_type = "cubic",
      color = "gray25"
    ) +
    geom_stratum(
      aes(color = after_stat(stratum)),
      width = 0.4,
      fill = "white",
      linewidth = 1.25
    ) +
    geom_text(stat = "stratum",
              aes(label = paste0(
                after_stat(stratum),
                "\n",
                after_stat(count),
                " ",
                "(",
                round(after_stat(prop) * 100, 0),
                "%)"
              )),
              size = 3.5,
              min.y = flow_count_min) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = survey_flow_cols,
      expand = c(0.05, 0.05),
      labels = paste("Cycle", str_extract(survey_flow_cols, "\\d+"))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = paste(
        "Fill = Cycle",
        str_extract(survey_flow_cols[length(survey_flow_cols)], "\\d+"),
        "Task Completion"
      ),
      values = c(
        "None" = "#A602CF",
        # Purple (viridis start)
        "Some" = "#31688e",
        # Blue-green
        "All" = "#35b779",
        # Green
        "Not Reached" = "gray75"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Outline = Completion Status in a Given Cycle",
      values = c(
        "None" = "#440154",
        # Purple (viridis start)
        "Some" = "#639FCA",
        # Blue-green
        "All" = "#257E53",
        # Darker Green
        "Not Reached" = "gray0"
      )
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = flow_y_labels,
      mapping = aes(x = 1.2,
                    y = y_left_center,
                    label = n),
      hjust = -0.5
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Participant Flow Between Survey Cycles",
      subtitle = alluvial_subtitle,
      x = "Survey Cycle",
      y = "Number of Participants",
      caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  # store alluvial plot
  plots$alluvial <- survey_alluvial_plot
  
  
  # init. return object
  result <- list(
    participant_flows = flow_df,
    all_participant_flows = cycle_completion_data_og,
    flow_counts_df = flow_counts,
    flow_count_min = flow_count_min,
    plots = plots,
    alluvial_subtitle = alluvial_subtitle,
    
    # Metadata
    analysis_date = Sys.Date(),
    parameters = list(
      participant_df = participant_df,
      flow_prop_min = flow_prop_min
    )
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# create the wide format data showing each participant's journey
survey_flow_data <- cycle_completion_data %>%
  select(patient_id, survey_cycle, completion_category) %>%
  # create a complete grid to handle "Not Reached" status
  {
    all_participants <- unique(.$patient_id)
    all_cycles <- sort(unique(.$survey_cycle))
    
    complete_grid <- expand_grid(
      patient_id = all_participants,
      survey_cycle = all_cycles
    )
    
    complete_grid %>%
      left_join(., 
                y = cycle_completion_data %>% select(patient_id, survey_cycle, completion_category),
                by = c("patient_id", "survey_cycle")) %>%
      mutate(
        completion_category = ifelse(is.na(completion_category), "Not Reached", as.character(completion_category)),
        completion_category = factor(completion_category, levels = c("None", "Some", "All", "Not Reached"))
      )
  } %>%
  # convert to wide format for counting combinations
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = patient_id,
    names_from = survey_cycle,
    names_prefix = "cycle_",
    values_from = completion_category,
    values_fill = "Not Reached"
  ) %>%
  # count each unique combination
  count(across(starts_with("cycle_")))

# get cycle column names for dynamic plotting
survey_cycle_cols <- names(survey_flow_data)[str_detect(names(survey_flow_data), "^cycle_")]
n_survey_cycles <- length(survey_cycle_cols)


# create dynamic aesthetic mapping
aes_mapping_surv <- list(y = quote(n))
for(i in seq_along(survey_cycle_cols)) {
  aes_mapping_surv[[paste0("axis", i)]] <- as.symbol(survey_cycle_cols[i])
}
```

```{r warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# define the minimum number of pts needed in a survey flow
survey_min_flow_count <- 15

# Create the y labels for the alluvial plot
survey_flow_y_labels <- survey_flow_data %>%
  # filter out "Not Reached" in cycle 0 and flows with fewer than the minimum number
  filter(
    cycle_0 != "Not Reached",
    n >= survey_min_flow_count
  ) %>%
  # get cycle columns dynamically
  # {cycle_cols <- names(.)[str_detect(names(.), "^cycle_")]; .} %>%
  # sort by all cycle columns (equivalent to the original 'arrange' but dynamic)
  # arrange(across(all_of(cycle_cols), desc)) %>%
  arrange(across(.cols = starts_with("cycle_"),
                 .fns = desc)) %>%
  mutate(
    half_n = n/2,
    y_left_upper = cumsum(n),
    y_left_center = y_left_upper - half_n
  )


survey_alluvial_plot <- survey_flow_data %>%
  filter(n >= survey_min_flow_count) %>%
  filter(cycle_0 != "Not Reached") %>%
  ggplot(do.call(aes, aes_mapping_surv)) +

  geom_alluvium(

  geom_stratum(

  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",

                       after_stat(count), " ",
                       "(", round(after_stat(prop) * 100, 0), "%)")),
    size = 3.5,

  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(

  scale_fill_manual(

      "Some" = "#31688e",     # Blue-green
      "All" = "#35b779",      # Green
      "Not Reached" = "gray75"

  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Outline = Completion Status in a Given Cycle",
    values = c(
      "None" = "#440154",     # Purple (viridis start)
      "Some" = "#639FCA",     # Blue-green
      "All" = "#257E53",      # Darker Green
      "Not Reached" = "gray0"

  geom_text(
    data = survey_flow_y_labels,

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Participant Flow Between Survey Cycles",
    subtitle = str_glue("Only flows with {survey_min_flow_count}+ participants are shown\n(omits participants who were withdrawn)"),
    x = "Survey Cycle",
    y = "Number of Participants",
    caption = last_updated_fdry_fmt
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
```

### v2


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(ggalluvial)
library(viridis)

# ============================================
# MAIN FUNCTION: survey_tasks_timespan_analysis
# ============================================

survey_tasks_timespan_analysis <- function(survey_tasks_df = survey_tasks_analysis,
                                           start_date = NULL,
                                           end_date = NULL,
                                           min_flow_count = 10,
                                           return_plots = TRUE,
                                           include_baseline = TRUE,
                                           highlight_overdue_days = 30) {
  # ============================================
  # INPUT VALIDATION & DATE HANDLING
  # ============================================
  
  # Default to last 90 days if no dates provided
  if (is.null(end_date)) {
    end_date <- Sys.Date()
  }
  if (is.null(start_date)) {
    start_date <- end_date - days(90)
  }
  
  # Convert to Date objects if necessary
  start_date <- as.Date(start_date)
  end_date <- as.Date(end_date)
  
  # Validate date order
  if (start_date > end_date) {
    stop("start_date must be before end_date")
  }
  
  # ============================================
  # DATA FILTERING & PREPARATION
  # ============================================
  
  # Filter tasks within the timespan
  tasks_in_timespan <- survey_tasks_df %>%
    filter(
      as.Date(task_assigned_date) >= start_date,
      as.Date(task_assigned_date) <= end_date
    )
  
  # If no tasks in timespan, return early with message
  if (nrow(tasks_in_timespan) == 0) {
    return(list(
      message = paste("No tasks found between", start_date, "and", end_date),
      summary = NULL,
      plots = NULL
    ))
  }
  
  # ============================================
  # CALCULATE KEY METRICS
  # ============================================
  
  # Overall summary statistics
  overall_summary <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    summarise(
      date_range = paste(start_date, "to", end_date),
      days_in_range = as.numeric(end_date - start_date) + 1,
      total_participants = n_distinct(patient_id),
      total_tasks_assigned = n(),
      total_tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
      total_tasks_incomplete = sum(!task_completed),
      overall_completion_rate = mean(task_completed),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Summary by survey cycle
  cycle_summary <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    group_by(survey_cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      participants_in_cycle = n_distinct(patient_id),
      tasks_assigned = n(),
      tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
      tasks_incomplete = sum(!task_completed),
      completion_rate = mean(task_completed),
      avg_days_to_complete = mean(as.numeric(
        difftime(enddate, task_assigned_date, units = "days")
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(survey_cycle)
  
  # Summary by survey type
  survey_type_summary <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    group_by(survey_type, surveyname) %>%
    summarise(
      tasks_assigned = n(),
      tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
      completion_rate = mean(task_completed),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(completion_rate))
  
  # define labels for completion rates
  engagement_status_list <- list("Fully Engaged" = 1,
                                 "Highly Engaged" = 0.75,
                                 "Moderately Engaged" = 0.5,
                                 "Low Engagement" = 0,
                                 "Non-responsive" = -1)
  
  # Participant-level summary
  participant_summary <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      age = first(age),
      survey_cycle = first(survey_cycle),
      enrollment_date = first(enroll_date),
      cycles_with_tasks = n_distinct(survey_cycle),
      total_tasks_assigned = n(),
      total_tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
      completion_rate = mean(task_completed),
      last_task_date = max(task_assigned_date),
      last_completed_date = max(enddate[task_completed], na.rm = TRUE),
      days_since_last_task = as.numeric(Sys.Date() - as.Date(last_task_date)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      engagement_status = case_when(
        completion_rate == engagement_status_list[["Fully Engaged"]] ~ "Fully Engaged",               # 100% completion
        completion_rate >= engagement_status_list[["Highly Engaged"]] ~ "Highly Engaged",             # >= 75% completion
        completion_rate >= engagement_status_list[["Moderately Engaged"]] ~ "Moderately Engaged",     # >= 50% completion
        completion_rate > engagement_status_list[["Low Engagement"]] ~ "Low Engagement",              # > 0% completion
        completion_rate <= engagement_status_list[["Low Engagement"]] ~ "Non-responsive"              # 0% completion 
      ),
      engagement_status = factor(
        engagement_status,
        levels = c(
          "Fully Engaged",
          "Highly Engaged",
          "Moderately Engaged",
          "Low Engagement",
          "Non-responsive"
        )
      )
    )
  
  # ============================================
  # IDENTIFY OVERDUE TASKS
  # ============================================
  
  # Find incomplete tasks that are overdue
  overdue_tasks <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    filter(!task_completed) %>%
    mutate(
      days_since_assigned = as.numeric(Sys.Date() - as.Date(task_assigned_date)),
      is_overdue = days_since_assigned > highlight_overdue_days,
      overdue_category = case_when(
        days_since_assigned <= 7 ~ "Recent (≤7 days)",
        days_since_assigned <= 14 ~ "1-2 weeks",
        days_since_assigned <= 30 ~ "2-4 weeks",
        days_since_assigned <= 60 ~ "1-2 months",
        days_since_assigned <= 90 ~ "2-3 months",
        TRUE ~ "3+ months"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      patient_id,
      survey_cycle,
      surveyname,
      task_assigned_date,
      days_since_assigned,
      is_overdue,
      overdue_category
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(days_since_assigned))
  
  # Summary of overdue by participant
  overdue_by_participant <- overdue_tasks %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      n_overdue_tasks = n(),
      oldest_overdue_days = max(days_since_assigned),
      newest_overdue_days = min(days_since_assigned),
      overdue_cycles = paste(sort(unique(survey_cycle)), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(oldest_overdue_days))
  
  # ============================================
  # CREATE ALLUVIAL FLOW DATA
  # ============================================
  
  # Prepare flow data for participants in timespan
  flow_data_timespan <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    group_by(patient_id, survey_cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      tasks_in_cycle = n(),
      tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      completion_category = case_when(
        tasks_completed == tasks_in_cycle & tasks_in_cycle > 0 ~ "All",
        tasks_completed == 0 ~ "None",
        between(tasks_completed, 0, tasks_in_cycle) ~ "Some"
      ),
      completion_category = factor(completion_category, levels = c("None", "Some", "All"))
    )
  
  # Get all cycles present in timespan
  cycles_in_timespan <-
    sort(unique(flow_data_timespan$survey_cycle))
  
  # Create complete grid for alluvial
  if (length(cycles_in_timespan) > 1) {
    alluvial_data <- expand.grid(
      patient_id = unique(flow_data_timespan$patient_id),
      survey_cycle = cycles_in_timespan
    ) %>%
      left_join(flow_data_timespan, by = c("patient_id", "survey_cycle")) %>%
      mutate(
        completion_category = ifelse(
          is.na(completion_category),
          "Not in Timespan",
          as.character(completion_category)
        ),
        completion_category = factor(
          completion_category,
          levels = c("None", "Some", "All", "Not in Timespan")
        )
      )
  } else {
    alluvial_data <- flow_data_timespan
  }
  
  # create DF of all participants in timespan for counting survey completions per cycle
  count_pts <- alluvial_data %>%
    filter(completion_category != "Not in Timespan") %>%
    summarize(num_pts = n(),
              .by = c(survey_cycle, completion_category)) %>%
    mutate(prop = num_pts / sum(num_pts),
           .by = survey_cycle) 
  
  # ============================================
  # CREATE VISUALIZATIONS
  # ============================================
  
  plots <- list()
  
  if (return_plots) {
    # Plot 1: Completion rate by cycle
    p1 <-
      ggplot(cycle_summary, aes(x = factor(survey_cycle), y = completion_rate)) +
      geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_text(aes(label = paste0(
        round(completion_rate * 100, 1),
        "%\n(n=",
        tasks_assigned,
        ")"
      )),
      vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1.2)) +
      labs(
        title = "Task Completion Rate by Survey Cycle",
        subtitle = paste("Period:", start_date, "to", end_date),
        x = "Survey Cycle",
        y = "Completion Rate"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
    
    # Plot 2: Daily task assignment and completion trends
    daily_trends <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
      mutate(assigned_date = as.Date(task_assigned_date)) %>%
      group_by(assigned_date) %>%
      summarise(
        tasks_assigned = n(),
        tasks_completed = sum(task_completed),
        completion_rate = mean(task_completed),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    p2 <- ggplot(daily_trends, aes(x = assigned_date)) +
      geom_line(aes(y = tasks_assigned, color = "Assigned"), size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = tasks_completed, color = "Completed"), size = 1) +
      geom_point(aes(y = tasks_assigned, color = "Assigned"),
                 size = 2,
                 alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_point(aes(y = tasks_completed, color = "Completed"),
                 size = 2,
                 alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(
        name = "Task Status",
        values = c(
          "Assigned" = "darkblue",
          "Completed" = "darkgreen"
        )
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Daily Task Assignment and Completion Trends",
        subtitle = paste("Rolling view from", start_date, "to", end_date),
        x = "Date",
        y = "Number of Tasks"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
            legend.position = "bottom")
    
    # Plot 3: Engagement status distribution
    p3 <-
      ggplot(participant_summary,
             aes(x = engagement_status, fill = engagement_status)) +
      geom_bar() +
      geom_text(stat = "count",
                aes(label = after_stat(count)),
                vjust = -0.5) +
      scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
      labs(
        title = "Participant Engagement Distribution",
        subtitle = paste("Based on tasks from", start_date, "to", end_date),
        x = "Engagement Status",
        y = "Number of Participants"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none"
      )
    
    # Plot 4: Overdue task heatmap
    if (nrow(overdue_tasks) > 0) {
      overdue_heatmap_data <- overdue_tasks %>%
        count(survey_cycle, overdue_category) %>%
        mutate(overdue_category = factor(
          overdue_category,
          levels = c(
            "Recent (≤7 days)",
            "1-2 weeks",
            "2-4 weeks",
            "1-2 months",
            "2-3 months",
            "3+ months"
          )
        ))
      
      p4 <- ggplot(overdue_heatmap_data,
                   aes(
                     x = factor(survey_cycle),
                     y = overdue_category,
                     fill = n
                   )) +
        geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
        geom_text(
          aes(label = n),
          color = "white",
          size = 4,
          fontface = "bold"
        ) +
        scale_fill_gradient(
          low = "lightblue",
          high = "darkred",
          name = "Count"
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Overdue Tasks by Cycle and Time Category",
          subtitle = paste("Tasks assigned but not completed as of", Sys.Date()),
          x = "Survey Cycle",
          y = "Time Since Assignment"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
              panel.grid = element_blank())
    } else {
      p4 <- ggplot() +
        annotate(
          "text",
          x = 0.5,
          y = 0.5,
          label = "No overdue tasks",
          size = 6
        ) +
        theme_void()
    }
    
    # Plot 5: Alluvial flow (if multiple cycles)
    if (length(cycles_in_timespan) > 1) {
      p5 <- alluvial_data %>%
        ggplot(
          aes(
            x = factor(survey_cycle),
            stratum = completion_category,
            alluvium = patient_id,
            fill = completion_category
          )
        ) +
        geom_alluvium(alpha = 0.5, width = 0.4) +
        geom_stratum(alpha = 0.9, width = 0.4) +
        stat_stratum(
          aes(label = paste0(
            after_stat(count),
            "\n",
            "(",
            round(after_stat(prop) * 100, 0),
            "%)"
          )),
          geom = "text",
          size = 3,
          color = "white",
          fontface = "bold"
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          name = "Completion",
          values = c(
            "None" = "#440154",
            "Some" = "#31688E",
            "All" = "#FDE725",
            "Not in Timespan" = "gray80"
          )
        ) +
        scale_x_discrete(
          labels = function(x)
            paste("Cycle", x)
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Participant Flow Through Survey Cycles",
          subtitle = paste("Tasks assigned between", start_date, "and", end_date),
          x = "Survey Cycle",
          y = "Number of Participants"
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
              legend.position = "bottom")
    } else {
      p5 <- NULL
    }
    
    
    # Plot 6: Barplot of Number of Participants completing all/some/none surveys per cycle
    p6 <- count_pts %>%
      ggplot(aes(
        x = factor(survey_cycle),
        y = num_pts,
        fill = completion_category
      )) +
      geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = num_pts),
        position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single", width = 0.9),
        size = 3,
        vjust = -0.2
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        name = "Completed Surveys",
        values = c(
          "None" = "brown3",
          "Some" = "gold1",
          "All" = "chartreuse3"
        )
      ) +
      scale_x_discrete(
        labels = function(x)
          paste("Cycle", x)
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Participants' Survey Completion Progress",
        subtitle = paste("Tasks assigned between", start_date, "and", end_date),
        x = "Survey Cycle",
        y = "Number of Participants"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
            legend.position = "bottom")
    
    
    # Plot 7: Boxplot of participant ages who were assigned each survey cycle in the given timeframe
    
    # function to map each numeric value to its corresponding completion range
    get_range <- function(x, values) {
      # hardcode the 2 edgecases (when completion% is 100 or 0)
      if (x == 1) {
        return("100%")
      } else if (x == -1) {
        return("0%")
      } else {
        # find index of current value in list
        idx <- which(values == x)
        # previous value (the one above in the sequence)
        prev_val <- values[idx - 1]
        # build the range string dynamically
        return(paste0(x * 100, "-", prev_val * 100, "%"))
      }
    }
    
    # dynamically get range labels
    engagement_status_values <- unlist(engagement_status_list)
    engagement_status_range_labels <-
      sapply(engagement_status_values, get_range, values = engagement_status_values)
    
    # create caption
    caption_text <- paste0(
      names(engagement_status_range_labels),
      " = ",
      engagement_status_range_labels,
      " completion",
      collapse = "\n"
    )
    
    p7 <- participant_summary %>%
      ggplot(aes(
        x = factor(survey_cycle),
        y = age,
        color = engagement_status
      )) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA,
                   position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single", padding = 0.1)) +
      ggbeeswarm::geom_quasirandom(size = 2,
                                   dodge.width = 0.8,
                                   alpha = 0.5) +
      scale_x_discrete(
        labels = function(x)
          paste("Cycle", x)
      ) +
      scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = 2) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        title = "Ages of Participants assigned Survey Tasks in the past week",
        subtitle = paste("Tasks assigned between", start_date, "and", end_date),
        x = "Survey Cycle",
        y = "Age",
        color = "Survey Engagement",
        caption = caption_text
      ) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    
    
    # plot 8: alluvial plot of survey trends from participants assigned a task in this timeframe
    alluvial_result <- process_survey_tasks_alluvial(participant_df = flow_data_timespan, 
                                        flow_prop_min = 0.0125)
    
    p8_subtitle <- alluvial_result$alluvial_subtitle
    p8 <- alluvial_result$plots$alluvial + 
      labs(subtitle = str_c(paste("Tasks assigned between", start_date, "and", end_date), 
                            p8_subtitle, sep = "\n"))
    
    
    # Combine plots
    if (!is.null(p5)) {
      combined_plot <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) / p5 +
        plot_annotation(
          title = "Survey Task Analysis Dashboard",
          subtitle = paste(
            "Analysis Period:",
            start_date,
            "to",
            end_date,
            "| Total Tasks:",
            overall_summary$total_tasks_assigned,
            "| Completion Rate:",
            percent(overall_summary$overall_completion_rate)
          ),
          theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
        )
    } else {
      combined_plot <- (p1 + p2) / (p3 + p4) +
        plot_annotation(
          title = "Survey Task Analysis Dashboard",
          subtitle = paste(
            "Analysis Period:",
            start_date,
            "to",
            end_date,
            "| Total Tasks:",
            overall_summary$total_tasks_assigned,
            "| Completion Rate:",
            percent(overall_summary$overall_completion_rate)
          ),
          theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
        )
    }
    
    plots$combined <- combined_plot
    plots$completion_by_cycle <- p1
    plots$daily_trends <- p2
    plots$engagement_dist <- p3
    plots$overdue_heatmap <- p4
    plots$alluvial <- p5
    plots$count_pts <- p6
    plots$ages <- p7
    plots$alluvial_trends <- p8
  }
  
  # ============================================
  # PREPARE ACTION LISTS
  # ============================================
  
  # Participants needing immediate attention (non-responsive in timespan)
  needs_attention <- participant_summary %>%
    filter(engagement_status %in% c("Non-responsive", "Low Engagement")) %>%
    arrange(desc(days_since_last_task)) %>%
    select(
      patient_id,
      enrollment_date,
      tasks_assigned = total_tasks_assigned,
      tasks_completed = total_tasks_completed,
      completion_rate,
      days_since_last_task,
      engagement_status
    )
  
  # High performers for recognition
  high_performers <- participant_summary %>%
    filter(engagement_status == "Fully Engaged",
           total_tasks_assigned >= 5) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_tasks_assigned)) %>%
    head(20) %>%
    select(patient_id,
           tasks_completed = total_tasks_completed,
           completion_rate,
           engagement_status)
  
  # ============================================
  # STATISTICAL ANALYSIS
  # ============================================
  
  # Time to completion analysis for completed tasks
  completion_time_stats <- tasks_in_timespan %>%
    filter(task_completed) %>%
    mutate(time_to_complete = as.numeric(difftime(enddate, task_assigned_date, units = "days"))) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_days = mean(time_to_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_days = median(time_to_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_days = quantile(time_to_complete, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75_days = quantile(time_to_complete, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_days = min(time_to_complete, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_days = max(time_to_complete, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # ============================================
  # COMPILE RESULTS
  # ============================================
  
  results <- list(
    # Summary statistics
    overall_summary = overall_summary,
    cycle_summary = cycle_summary,
    survey_type_summary = survey_type_summary,
    participant_summary = participant_summary,
    
    # Overdue analysis
    overdue_tasks = overdue_tasks,
    overdue_by_participant = overdue_by_participant,
    
    # Action lists
    needs_attention = needs_attention,
    high_performers = high_performers,
    
    # Statistical analysis
    completion_time_stats = completion_time_stats,
    
    # Visualizations
    plots = plots,
    
    # Metadata
    analysis_date = Sys.Date(),
    parameters = list(
      start_date = start_date,
      end_date = end_date,
      days_analyzed = as.numeric(end_date - start_date) + 1,
      highlight_overdue_days = highlight_overdue_days
    )
  )
  
  # Print summary to console
  cat("\n", paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("SURVEY TASK ANALYSIS SUMMARY\n")
  cat(paste(rep("=", 60), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Period:",
      as.character(start_date),
      "to",
      as.character(end_date),
      "\n")
  cat("Days analyzed:", results$parameters$days_analyzed, "\n\n")
  
  cat("KEY METRICS:\n")
  cat(paste(rep("-", 30), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Total participants:",
      overall_summary$total_participants,
      "\n")
  cat("Total tasks assigned:",
      overall_summary$total_tasks_assigned,
      "\n")
  cat("Total tasks completed:",
      overall_summary$total_tasks_completed,
      "\n")
  cat(
    "Overall completion rate:",
    percent(overall_summary$overall_completion_rate),
    "\n\n"
  )
  
  cat("PARTICIPANTS NEEDING ATTENTION:\n")
  cat(paste(rep("-", 30), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(
    "Non-responsive:",
    sum(participant_summary$engagement_status == "Non-responsive"),
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Low engagement:",
    sum(participant_summary$engagement_status == "Low Engagement"),
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "Overdue tasks (>",
    highlight_overdue_days,
    "days):",
    sum(overdue_tasks$is_overdue),
    "\n\n"
  )
  
  cat("TOP ISSUES BY CYCLE:\n")
  cat(paste(rep("-", 30), collapse = ""), "\n", sep = "")
  cycle_summary %>%
    arrange(completion_rate) %>%
    head(3) %>%
    mutate(issue = paste(
      "Cycle",
      survey_cycle,
      ":",
      percent(completion_rate),
      "completion"
    )) %>%
    pull(issue) %>%
    walk( ~ cat("•", ., "\n"))
  
  return(results)
}

# ============================================
# HELPER FUNCTION: Generate weekly report
# ============================================

generate_weekly_survey_report <- function(survey_tasks_df = survey_tasks_analysis,
                                          weeks_back = 1) {
  end_date <- Sys.Date()
  start_date <- end_date - weeks(weeks_back)
  
  results <- survey_tasks_timespan_analysis(
    survey_tasks_df = survey_tasks_df,
    start_date = start_date,
    end_date = end_date,
    return_plots = TRUE
  )
```

```{r}
# visualize the amount of time it takes to complete a survey task
survey_viz_data <- survey_tasks_results_last_2wks$participant_summary %>%
  # create a flag for task completion status
  mutate(
    task_completed = !is.infinite(last_completed_date),
    # calculate days to completion (or days since assignment for incomplete)
    days_to_complete = as.numeric(
      difftime(last_completed_date, last_task_date, units = "days")
    ),
    # for incomplete tasks, show time since assignment (negative for sorting purposes)
    time_for_sorting = if_else(
      task_completed,
      days_to_complete,
      as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), last_task_date, units = "days"))
    ),
    # create a row number ordered by survey_cycle and patient_id for y-axis positioning
    participant_order = row_number()
  ) %>%
  # sort by survey_cycle first, then by days_to_complete
  arrange(survey_cycle, time_for_sorting) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_order = row_number(),
    # create a factor for proper ordering on y-axis
    participant_label = fct_reorder(patient_id, participant_order)     
  )


survey_viz_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = participant_label, color = factor(survey_cycle))) +
  
  # draw the "stick" portion of the lollipop
  # for completed tasks: solid line from assignment to completion
  # for incomplete tasks: dashed line from assignment to current status
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = last_task_date,
      xend = if_else(task_completed, last_completed_date, Sys.time()),
      linetype = task_completed
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  
  # draw assignment point (the "lollipop head" at start)
  # all tasks have an assignment point
  geom_point(
    data = survey_viz_data %>% filter(task_completed),
    aes(x = last_completed_date),
    size = 3,
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    stroke = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # themeing and labels
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(`TRUE` = "solid", `FALSE` = "dotted"),
    labels = c(`TRUE` = "Completed", `FALSE` = "In Progress"),
    name = "Status"
  ) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Survey Cycle") +
  scale_x_datetime(
    date_breaks = "2 days",
    date_labels = "%m/%d",
    expand = c(0.02, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Survey Task Completion Timeline",
    subtitle = "Each lollipop shows when a task was assigned (left dot) and completed (right dot, if applicable)",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Participant ID",
    caption = "Solid lines = completed tasks | Dotted lines = incomplete tasks (still waiting for completion)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray60", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray95", linewidth = 0.2),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal"
  )
```

```{r qnaire_summary_stats, echo=FALSE}
    `qnaire_incompletion%` = pt_with_incomplete_qnaire / (pt_with_incomplete_qnaire + pt_who_completed_a_qnaire),
    avg_qnaire_completed_per_person = total_qnaires_completed / (pt_who_completed_a_qnaire + pt_with_incomplete_qnaire),

    bl_skintype_completed = nrow(filter(., surveyname == "Baseline_Survey_SkinType")),
    bl_vit_completed = nrow(filter(., surveyname == "Baseline_Vitiligo_Survey"))
  ) %>%
  rename(

    "number of enrolled pt's who completed 1+ questionnaires" = pt_who_completed_a_qnaire,
    "number of enrolled pt's who completed 0 questionnaires" = pt_with_incomplete_qnaire,
    "proportion of enrolled pt's who completed 0 questionnaires" = `qnaire_incompletion%`,
    "average number of questionnaires completed per enrolled pt (out of 7)" = avg_qnaire_completed_per_person,
    # "number of completed BL demographics questionnaires" = bl_demographics_completed,
    "number of completed BL stress quesstionnaires" = bl_stress_completed,
    "number of completed BL env. exposure questionnaires" = bl_env_exp_completed,
    "number of completed BL general health questionnaires" = bl_genhealth_completed,
    "number of completed BL life changes questionnaires" = bl_lifechanges_completed,
    "number of completed BL skin type questionnaires" = bl_skintype_completed, 
    "number of completed BL vitiligo questionnaires" = bl_vit_completed
  ))
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# compute the average survey completion rate among enrolled participants
qnaire_completion_rate_df <- qnaires_indiv %>%
  # new field `survey_cycle` to compute how many surveys have been sent based on enrollment date
  mutate(
    months_since_enroll = time_length(today() - as_date(enroll_date), unit = "month"),
    survey_cycle = floor(months_since_enroll / 3)
  ) %>%
  count(patient_id, survey_cycle, name = "surveys_completed") %>%
  mutate(
    surveys_available = 7 + (6 * survey_cycle),
    `survey_completion%` = surveys_completed / surveys_available,
    .by = c(patient_id, survey_cycle)
  )


qnaire_completion_rate_df %>%
  summarize(
    tot_surveys_completed = sum(surveys_completed),
    tot_surveys_available = sum(surveys_available),
    avg_surveys_completed = mean(surveys_completed),
    avg_surveys_available = mean(surveys_available),
    `completion%` = tot_surveys_completed / tot_surveys_available
  )
```

```{r}
  arrange(patient_id, recorded_date) %>%

                             months_since_enroll > 0 ~ 1 + floor(months_since_enroll / 3))
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, enroll_day, months_since_enroll, recorded_date, survey_cycle, survey_data)
```

```{r}
                                0,
                                surveys_completed),
    prop_complete = case_when(is.na(survey) & quarter > 0 ~ (surveys_completed / surveys_available) - quarter, 
                              .default = surveys_completed / surveys_available)
  )
```

```{r}
         complete_status = factor(complete_status) %>% fct_relevel(c("all_complete", "part_complete", "none_complete"))) %>%
  select(-c(enroll_date)) %>%

  # mutate(months_since_enroll = str_c(quarter * 3, (quarter + 1) * 3 - 1, sep = "-")) %>%
  mutate(months_since_enroll = str_c(quarter * 3, (quarter + 1) * 3 - 1, sep = "-"),
         months_since_enroll = factor(months_since_enroll, levels = c("0-2", '3-5', '6-8', '9-11', '12-14'))) %>%
```

### Per-participant


```{r}
# # survey_cycle_summary_v5_BL <- 
# survey_cycle_summary_v5 %>%
#   filter(survey == "BL")
# 
# survey_cycle_summary_v5 %>%
#   filter(survey == "QT1")


survey_cycle_per_pt <- survey_cycle_summary_v5 %>%
  # make a column for num survey completions of each survey type
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(patient_id, enroll_day, quarter),
    names_from = survey,
    names_prefix = "surveys_completed_",
    values_from = surveys_completed
  )

# get all columns that match the surveys_completed pattern
survey_cols <- names(survey_cycle_per_pt)[str_detect(names(survey_cycle_per_pt), "^surveys_completed_")]

# extract the timepoint (BL, QT1, QT2, ...) and order intelligently
survey_order <- survey_cols %>%
  tibble(col = .) %>%
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(col, "surveys_completed_")) %>%
  mutate(order = case_when(timepoint == "BL" ~ 0,
                           str_detect(timepoint, "^QT\\d+$") ~ as.integer(str_remove(timepoint, "QT")),
                           TRUE ~ Inf)) %>%
  arrange(order) %>%
  pull(col)

# use select() to arrange columns: non-survey columns, then ordered survey columns
survey_cycle_per_pt <- survey_cycle_per_pt %>%
  select(patient_id:quarter,
         all_of(survey_order),
         everything())


survey_cycle_per_pt %>%
  filter(quarter == 4) %>%
  count(quarter, surveys_completed_BL, surveys_completed_QT1, surveys_completed_QT2, surveys_completed_QT3, surveys_completed_QT4, surveys_completed_NA) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```


```{r}

# use ggsankey to make a plot for every quarter (3 plots for quarters 0-2)
# convert all NAs to 0 and remove the `surveys_completed_NA` column

# survey_sankey_df <- survey_cycle_per_pt %>%
#   # replace all 'NA's with 0
#   mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("surveys_completed"),
#                 .fns = ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x))) %>%
#   select(-surveys_completed_NA) %>%
#   make_long(surveys_completed_BL:ncol(.))

survey_sankey_df <- survey_cycle_per_pt %>%
  # -1 means survey is unavailable
  mutate(across(
    .cols = starts_with("surveys_completed"),
    # .fns = ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x),
    .fns = ~ case_when(
      is.na(.x) & str_detect(cur_column(), "BL") ~ 0,
      is.na(.x) & str_extract(cur_column(), "\\d+") <= quarter ~ 0,
      is.na(.x) & str_extract(cur_column(), "\\d+") > quarter ~ -1,
      !is.na(.x) ~ .x
    )
  )) %>%
  select(-surveys_completed_NA) %>%
  make_long(surveys_completed_BL:ncol(.))
```

```{r}
# init. how many distinct surveys we have data for
num_unique_surveys <- n_distinct(survey_sankey_df$x)

# count how many pts follow each flow pattern
flow_counts <- survey_sankey_df %>%
  # simplify --> reduce the num of completed surveys if they exceed the max for that cycle
  mutate(
    node = case_when(
      node > NUM_SURVEYS_BL & str_detect(x, "_BL") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_BL,
      node > NUM_SURVEYS_QT & str_detect(x, "_QT") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_QT,
      .default = node
    ),
    next_node = case_when(
      next_node > NUM_SURVEYS_QT & str_detect(next_x, "_QT") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_QT,
      .default = next_node
    )
  ) %>%
  count(x, next_x, node, next_node) %>%
  mutate(
    # calc percentage of pts starting from a given cycle
    pct_of_cycle = (n / (nrow(survey_sankey_df) / num_unique_surveys)) * 100,
    # create flow label
    flow_label = paste0(node, " -> ", next_node, "\n(", round(pct_of_cycle, 1), "%)")
  )

# join this info back to the og sankey data
# survey_sankey_enhanced <- survey_sankey_df %>%
#   mutate(
#     node = case_when(node > NUM_SURVEYS_BL & str_detect(x, "_BL") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_BL,
#                      node > NUM_SURVEYS_QT & str_detect(x, "_QT") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_QT,
#                      .default = node),
#     next_node = case_when(next_node > NUM_SURVEYS_QT & str_detect(next_x, "_QT") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_QT,
#                           .default = next_node)
#   ) %>%
#   # add counts and proportions to every row
#   left_join(
#     flow_counts,
#     by = c('x', 'next_x', 'node', 'next_node')
#   )

# join this info back to the og sankey data
survey_sankey_enhanced <- survey_sankey_df %>%
  mutate(
    node = case_when(
      node > NUM_SURVEYS_BL & str_detect(x, "_BL") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_BL,
      node > NUM_SURVEYS_QT & str_detect(x, "_QT") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_QT,
      .default = node
    ),
    next_node = case_when(
      next_node > NUM_SURVEYS_QT & str_detect(next_x, "_QT") ~ NUM_SURVEYS_QT,
      .default = next_node
    )
  ) %>%
  # add counts and proportions to every row
  left_join(
    y = flow_counts,
    by = c('x', 'next_x', 'node', 'next_node')
  ) %>%
  # factorize nodes
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = ends_with("node"),
      .fns = ~(fct_inseq(factor(.x)) %>% 
                 # fct_other(drop = "-1", other_level = "unavailable") %>%
                 fct_other(drop = "-1", other_level = "NA") %>%
                 # fct_na_level_to_value(extra_levels = ) %>%
                 fct_shift(-1))
    )
  )


# plot
survey_sankey_plot <- survey_sankey_enhanced %>%
  filter(n >= 5) %>%
  # mutate(
  #   node = case_when(node > 6 & str_detect(x, "_BL") ~ 6,
  #                    node > 5 & str_detect(x, "_QT") ~ 5,
  #                    .default = node),
  #   next_node = case_when(next_node > 5 & str_detect(next_x, "_QT") ~ 5,
  #                         .default = node)
  # )
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    # fill = factor(node),
    fill = node
    # scale the flows by participant count --> makes the width of the flows proportional to number of pts
    # weight = n
  )) +
  geom_sankey(
    flow.alpha = 0.7,
    node.color = "gray30",
    flow.color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_sankey_label(
    aes(label = after_stat(node)),
    size = 3.5,
    color = "white",
    fill = "gray40",
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # geom_label(
  #   data = na.omit(flow_labels %>% count(x_pos, y_pos, label_text)),
  #   mapping = aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label_text),
```

```{r}
# flow_labels <- survey_sankey_enhanced %>%
#   # filter to only include flows with 5 or more counts
#   filter(n >= 5) %>%
#   # calculate position for labels (midpoint of the flow)
#   mutate(
#     x_pos = case_when(x == "surveys_completed_BL" & next_x == "surveys_completed_QT1" ~ 1.15,
#                       x == "surveys_completed_QT1" & next_x == "surveys_completed_QT2" ~ 2.15,
#                       x == "surveys_completed_QT2" & next_x == "surveys_completed_QT3" ~ 3.15, 
#                       TRUE ~ NA_real_),
#     y_pos = case_when(node == 6 & next_node == 5 ~ 200,
#                       node == 6 & next_node == 0 ~ -100,
#                       node == 0 & next_node == 0 & x == "surveys_completed_BL" ~ -320,
#                       node == 0 & next_node == 0 ~ -200,
#                       node == 0 & next_node == 5 ~ -75,
#                       x == "surveys_completed_QT1" & node == 5 & next_node == 5 ~ 225,
#                       x == "surveys_completed_QT2" & node == 5 & next_node == 5 ~ 300,
#                       x == "surveys_completed_QT1" & node == 5 & next_node == 0 ~ 60,
#                       node == 5 & next_node == 0 ~ 150,
#                       T ~ 0),
#     # create the label text
#     label_text = paste0(n, "\n(", round(pct, 2), "%)")
#   )

# amount to shift the label horizontally
label_x_shift <- 1.15

flow_labels <- survey_sankey_enhanced %>%
  # filter to only include flows with 5 or more counts
  filter(n >= 5) %>%
  # calculate position for labels (midpoint of the flow)
  mutate(
    # x_pos = case_when(x == "surveys_completed_BL" & next_x == "surveys_completed_QT1" ~ 1.15,
    #                   x == "surveys_completed_QT1" & next_x == "surveys_completed_QT2" ~ 2.15,
    #                   x == "surveys_completed_QT2" & next_x == "surveys_completed_QT3" ~ 3.15, 
    #                   TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    x_pos = case_when(str_detect(x, "BL") ~ label_x_shift,
                      str_detect(x, "QT") ~ as.integer(str_extract(x, "\\d+")) + label_x_shift),
    y_pos = case_when(
      # positions for BL nodes
      node == 6 & next_node == 5 ~ 200,
      node == 6 & next_node == 0 ~ -100,
      # node == 6 & is.na(next_node) ~ -225,
      node == 6 & next_node == "NA" ~ -235,
      node == 0 & next_node == 0 & x == "surveys_completed_BL" ~ -300,
      node == 0 & next_node == "NA" & x == "surveys_completed_BL" ~ -360,
      
      # position for QT1 nodes
      str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == 5 & next_node == 5 ~ 300,
      str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == 5 & next_node == 0 ~ 105,
      # str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == 5 & next_node == "NA" ~ 50,
      str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == 0 & next_node == 5 ~ -60,
      str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == 0 & next_node == 0 ~ -150,
      str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == 0 & next_node == "NA" ~ -300,
      str_detect(x, "QT1") & node == "NA" & next_node == "NA" ~ -375,
      
      # position for QT2 nodes
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == 5 & next_node == 5 ~ 300,
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == 5 & next_node == 0 ~ 140,
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == 5 & next_node == "NA" ~ 80,
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == 0 & next_node == 5 ~ -20,
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == 0 & next_node == 0 ~ -110,
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == 0 & next_node == "NA" ~ -225,
      str_detect(x, "QT2") & node == "NA" & next_node == "NA" ~ -355,
      
      # position for QT3 nodes 
      str_detect(x, "QT3") & node == 5 & next_node == 5 ~ 375,
      str_detect(x, "QT3") & node == 5 & next_node == 0 ~ 310,
      str_detect(x, "QT3") & node == 5 & next_node == "NA" ~ 225,
      str_detect(x, "QT3") & node == 0 & next_node == 0 ~ 75,
      str_detect(x, "QT3") & node == 0 & next_node == "NA" ~ -60,
      str_detect(x, "QT3") & node == "NA" & next_node == "NA" ~ -345
    ),
    # create the label text
    label_text = paste0(n, "\n(", round(pct_of_cycle, 2), "%)")
  )
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
survey_cycle_per_pt %>%
  # convert NAs to 0
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("surveys_completed"),
```

```{r}
# group by each unique flow
survey_cycle_per_pt %>%
  # convert NAs to 0
  mutate(across(.cols = starts_with("surveys_completed"),
                .fns = ~ if_else(is.na(.x), 0, .x))) %>%
  # only keep flows where number of completed surveys is 0 or the max for that survey
  filter(
    surveys_completed_BL %in% c(0, NUM_SURVEYS_BL),
    if_all(.cols = contains("_QT"),
           .fns = ~ .x %in% c(0, NUM_SURVEYS_QT))
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_NA")) %>%
  # count the number of different combos of completed surveys
  mutate(
    count = n(), 
    .by = c(surveys_completed_BL:last_col())
  ) %>%
  # create a grouping variable for every 'combo'

  # ungroup() %>%
  # arrange(total_completed) %>%

  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(

      row <- list_c(list(str_subset(colnames(.), "surveys_completed") %>% str_remove_all("surveys_completed_")))
```

`num_kits` = number of registered packages in Foundry for that row

`total_kits` = sum of all registered packages in a given shipment cycle and 'combo' 

`num_kits_v2` = sum of all registered packages in a given "step" and shipment cycle


Each kit status represents:

1. Newly enrolled, did not confirm shipping address
2. Needs a package (indicated by confirming their shipping address when prompted)
3. Package is in outbound transit
4. Package is with participant
5. Participant has completed self-sampling and repackaged the kit
6. Package is in inbound transit
7. Package received at UMass

## Stress

```{r}
# questions needing reverse score
reverse_qs <- c(4, 5, 7, 8)

# unnested DF of stress responses
pss <- surveys_unnested %>%
  filter(surveyname == "Quarterly_Survey_Stress") %>%
  arrange(recorded_dttm) %>%
  select(-c(response_id, `_id`, taskid, surveydisplayname))

# clean up stress responses
pss_clean <- pss %>%
  select(-c(stepidentifier,
            any_of(c(
              colnames(patients_clean %>% select(-c(
                patient_id, vit_status_exp
              ))),
              colnames(patients_raw %>% select(-patient_id))
            )))) %>%
  mutate(
    # add question numbers for PSS
    q_num = case_match(
      resultidentifier,
      "upset_QT" ~ 1,
      "unable_to_control_QT" ~ 2,
      "nervous_and_stressed_QT" ~ 3,
      "personal_problems_QT" ~ 4,
      "going_your_way_QT" ~ 5,
      "cope_QT" ~ 6,
      "control_irritations_QT" ~ 7,
      "On_top_QT" ~ 8,
      "angered_QT" ~ 9,
      "difficulties_piling_QT" ~ 10
    ),
    # factorize answers
    score = (factor(answers) %>%
               fct_relevel(
                 c(
                   "never",
                   "almost never",
                   "sometimes",
                   "fairly often",
                   "very often"
                 )
               ) %>%
               factor(labels = 0:4)),
    # reverse score for Q4, 5, 7, 8
    score = case_when(
      q_num %in% reverse_qs ~ fct_recode(
        score,
        `0` = "4",
        `1` = '3',
        `2` = '2',
        `3` = '1',
        `4` = '0'
      ),
      .default = score
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(patient_id, recorded_dttm, q_num)
```


```{r}
pss_clean_v2 <- pss_clean %>%
  # conigure score
  mutate(score_int = 5 - as.integer(score)) %>%
  # join by DF to estimate which survey cycle does each response belong to
  left_join(
    y = survey_cycle_summary_v2,
    by = c("patient_id", "recorded_date"),
    suffix = c("", "_extra")
  ) %>%
  rename(current_quarter = quarter) %>%
  # factorize surveys
  mutate(survey = factor(survey, labels = seq(from = 0, length.out = .$survey %>% unique() %>% length()))) %>%
  select(patient_id, enroll_day, recorded_date, vit_status_exp, survey, current_quarter, q_num, answers, score, score_int)

# take average score of each question for pts with multiple records in a quarter
pss_multi_responses_same_qtr <- pss_clean_v2 %>%
  # # factorize surveys
  # mutate(survey = factor(survey, labels = seq(from = 0, length.out = pss_clean_v2$survey %>% unique() %>% length()))) %>%
  # filter for records of pts with multiple responses in the same quarter
  filter(n() > 1, .by = c(patient_id, survey, q_num)) %>%
  summarize(
    score_int = mean(score_int),
    .by = c(patient_id, vit_status_exp:q_num)
  )

# handle pts with multiple survey entries in the same quarter
pss_clean_v3 <- pss_clean_v2 %>%
  distinct(patient_id, survey, q_num, .keep_all = T) %>%
  left_join(
    y = pss_multi_responses_same_qtr,
    by = c("patient_id", "survey", "q_num"),
    suffix = c("", "_extra")
  ) %>%
  # change score_int
  mutate(
    score_int = coalesce(score_int_extra, score_int)
  ) %>%
  select(any_of(colnames(pss_clean_v2)))
```

```{r}
# calculate absolute change in stress scores per participant
pss_sharp_changes <- pss_tot_scores_plot_df %>%
  arrange(patient_id, survey) %>%
  mutate(
    stress_change = abs(tot_stress_score - lag(tot_stress_score)),
    .by = patient_id
  )

# define an outlier threshold (e.g., top 10% of stress changes)
pss_threshold <- quantile(
  pss_sharp_changes$stress_change,
  0.80,
  na.rm = T
)

# filter only participants with stress changes above the threshold
pss_outliers <- pss_sharp_changes %>%
  filter(stress_change >= pss_threshold)

# filter DF to only keep participants with a sharp stress change
total_stress_extreme_change_over_time_lineplot <- pss_tot_scores_plot_df %>%
  semi_join(y = pss_outliers,
            by = "patient_id") %>%
  rename(vit_status = vit_status_exp) %>%
  # mutate(family_id = str_extract(patient_id, "\\d+")) %>%
  # plot change in total stress score over time
  ggplot(aes(x = survey, y = tot_stress_score, color = patient_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_grid(
    # current_quarter ~ vit_status,
    . ~ vit_status,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = "label_both"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Extreme changes in reported stress among VIGOR cohort",
    # subtitle = str_glue("only showing participants reporting +/-{pss_threshold} stress score from previous survey"),
    subtitle = "extreme changes in stress are found in both healthy and vit subgroups",
    x = "Quarter",
    y = "total stress score",
    caption = str_glue("'extreme' = +/-{pss_threshold} change in stress score from previous quarter")
  )
```

```{r}
# function to plot stress change for each transition between surveys
plot_stress_change_specific <- function(type_of_change) {
  pss_stress_change_bw_surveys %>%
    filter(survey_change == type_of_change) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = vit_status_exp,
               y = stress_change,
               fill = vit_status_exp)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5,
                trim = F) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "white",
                 width = 0.1,
                 outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("healthy" = "#1B9E77", "vitiligo" = "#D95F02")) +
    labs(
      title = "Stress Change Distribution",
      subtitle = str_glue("change from {type_of_change}"),
      x = "Participant Group",
      y = "Change in Stress Score",
      fill = "vit_status",
      caption = str_glue("n = {nrow(pss_stress_change_bw_surveys %>% filter(survey_change == type_of_change))}")
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

survey_change_types <- pss_stress_change_bw_surveys %>% count(survey_change) %>% pull(survey_change)
stress_change_specific_plots <- list()

for (i in seq_along(survey_change_types)) {
  stress_change_specific_plots[[i]] <- plot_stress_change_specific(survey_change_types[i])
}
```

### Stat Tests

```{r}
# check for normality
shapiro.test(pss_tot_scores_plot_df$tot_stress_score)
```

p-value < 0.05 suggests the data is NOT normally distributed! Proceed with a wilcoxon test.

```{r eval=FALSE}
# visualize normality
pss_tot_scores_plot_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tot_stress_score)) + 
  geom_histogram() +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# wilcoxon rank-sum test for non-normal data
pss_wilcox_result <- wilcox.test(tot_stress_score ~ vit_status_exp, data = pss_tot_scores_plot_df)
print(pss_wilcox_result)
```

p-value > 0.05 suggests that stress levels are NOT significantly different between vit and healthy subgroups

```{r}
# plot categorical stress levels

  mutate(
    stress_category = case_when(

    .default = NA
    ),
    # factorize
    stress_category = factor(stress_category, levels = c("high", "moderate", "low"))

  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = survey, y = percentage, fill = stress_category)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ vit_status_exp) +
  geom_text(

    y = "Proportion",
```

### Sankey


```{r}
stress_sankey_df <- pss_tot_scores_plot_df_v2 %>%
  mutate(survey = factor(
    survey,
    levels = sort(unique(survey)),
    labels = c("BL", str_c("QT", sort(unique(
      survey
    ))[-1]))
  )) %>%
  select(patient_id, survey, stress_category, current_quarter) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(patient_id, current_quarter),
    names_from = survey,
    values_from = stress_category
  ) %>%
  # replace NAs with new levels depending on whether a survey was sent to a pt
  mutate(across(
    .cols = BL:ncol(.),
    .fns = ~ case_when(
      # if there's an NA for the BL survey
      is.na(.x) &
        str_detect(cur_column(), "BL") ~ fct_na_value_to_level(.x, level = "no response"),
      # if there's an NA for a survey that was sent
      is.na(.x) &
        str_extract(cur_column(), "\\d+") <= current_quarter ~ fct_na_value_to_level(.x, level = "no response"),
      # if there's an NA for a survey that was not yet sent
      is.na(.x) &
        str_extract(cur_column(), "\\d+") > current_quarter ~ fct_na_value_to_level(.x, level = "unavailable"),!is.na(.x) ~ .x
    )
  )) %>%
  make_long(BL:ncol(.))

stress_sankey_plot <- stress_sankey_df %>%
  # factorize the nodes
  mutate(node = factor(node, levels = c("high", "moderate", "low", "no response", "unavailable")) %>% fct_rev) %>%
  # filter out flows with fewer than 5 counts
  mutate(n = n(), .by = c(x, next_x, node, next_node)) %>%
  # filter(n > 1) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = x,
    next_x = next_x,
    node = node,
    next_node = next_node,
    fill = node,
    # weight = n
  )) +
  geom_sankey(
    flow.alpha = 0.5,
    # node.color = "gray30",
    # flow.color = "black"
  ) +
  # geom_sankey_label(
  #   aes(label = after_stat(node)),
  #   size = 3.5,
  #   color = "white",
  #   fill = "gray40",
  #   fontface = "bold"
  # ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "high" = "#bc2a22",
      # "moderate" = "#FC8D59",
      "moderate" = "#f9ad4e",
      "low" = "#91CF60",
      "no response" = "#3592dd",
      "unavailable" = "#bdb9b9"
    )
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = "How stressed is the VIGOR cohort?",
    # subtitle = "",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "reported stress"
  ) +
  theme_sankey(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    # plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
  )

stress_sankey_plot
```

## General Health

```{r gen_health_pivot, include=FALSE}
gen_health <- surveys_unnested %>%
  filter(surveyname == "Baseline_Survey_GenHealth") %>%
  arrange(recorded_dttm) %>%
  select(-c(response_id, `_id`, taskid, surveydisplayname))

gen_health_nested <- gen_health %>%
  select(-c(recorded_dttm, stepidentifier,
            any_of(c(
              colnames(patients_clean %>% select(-c(patient_id, vit_status_exp, plex))),
              colnames(patients_raw %>% select(-patient_id))
            )))) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = resultidentifier,
    values_from = answers,
    values_fn = list
  ) %>%
  select(
    patient_id:vit_status_exp, plex,
    condition_BL, Other_autoimmune_BL, Type_1_or_2_BL, Diabetes_onset_BL, Insulin_BL,
    cancer_BL, melanoma_BL, CPI_BL, 
    # other_CPI_BL
    everything()
  )
```

```{r}
# compare people who got sick over past 3 mos
gen_health_nested_qt %>%
  count(sick_past_3_months_QT, vit_status_exp) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sick_past_3_months_QT = case_when("false" %in% sick_past_3_months_QT ~ F, "true" %in% sick_past_3_months_QT ~ T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(sick_past_3_months_QT)) %>%
  summarize(num_pts = sum(n), .by = c(sick_past_3_months_QT, vit_status_exp)) %>%
  mutate(prop = num_pts / sum(num_pts), .by = sick_past_3_months_QT) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sick_past_3_months_QT, y = prop, fill = vit_status_exp)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(prop, 3)),
    position = position_fill(0.5)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "'Have you been sick in the last 3 months?'",
    subtitle = "breakdown of responses from QT survey",
    x = "response",
    fill = "status",
    caption = last_updated_surveys_fmt
  )
```
